verses.lat: Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, neque in ira tua corrípias me.
verses.eng: O Lord, rebuke me not in Thy indignation, nor chastise me in Thy wrath.

verses.lat: Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam infírmus sum; sana me, Dómine, quóniam conturbáta sunt ossa mea.
verses.eng: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am weak: heal me, O Lord, for my bones are troubled.

verses.lat: Et ánima mea turbáta est valde; sed tu, Dómine, úsquequo?
verses.eng: And my soul is troubled exceedingly: but Thou, O Lord, how long?

verses.lat: Convértere, Dómine, et éripe ánimam meam; salvum me fac propter misericórdiam tuam.
verses.eng: Turn to me, O Lord, and deliver my soul: O save me for Thy mercy's sake.

verses.lat: Quóniam non est in morte qui memor sit tui; in inférno autem quis confitébitur tibi?
verses.eng: For there is no one in death that is mindful of Thee: and who shall confess to Thee in hell?

verses.lat: Laborávi in gémitu meo, lavábo per síngulas noctes lectum meum; lácrimis meis stratum meum rigábo.
verses.eng: I have laboured in my groanings, every night I will wash my bed: I will water my couch with my tears.

verses.lat: Turbátus est a furóre óculus meus; inveterávi inter omnes inimícos meos.
verses.eng: My eye is troubled through indignation: I have grown old amongst all my enemies.

verses.lat: Discédite a me, omnes qui operámini iniquitátem, quóniam exaudívit Dóminus vocem fletus mei.
verses.eng: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity: for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.lat: Exaudívit Dóminus deprecatiónem meam; Dóminus oratiónem meam suscépit.
verses.eng: The Lord hath heard my supplication: the Lord hath received my prayer.

verses.lat: Erubéscant et conturbéntur veheménter omnes inimíci mei; convertántur et erubéscant valde velóciter.
verses.eng: Let all my enemies be ashamed and be very much troubled: let them be turned back, and be ashamed very speedily.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo; narrábo ómnia mirabília tua.
verses.eng: I will give praise to Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart: I will relate all Thy wonders.

verses.lat: Lætábor et exsultábo in te; psallam nómini tuo, Altíssime.
verses.eng: I will be glad and rejoice in Thee: I will sing to Thy name, O Thou most High.

verses.lat: In converténdo inimícum meum retrorsum; infirmabúntur et períbunt a fácie tua.
verses.eng: When my enemy shall be turned back: they shall be weakened and perish before Thy face.

verses.lat: Quóniam fecísti judícium meum et causam meam; sedísti super thronum, qui júdicas justítiam.
verses.eng: For Thou hast maintained my judgment and my cause: Thou hast sat on the throne, who judgest justice.

verses.lat: Increpásti gentes, et périit ímpius; nomen eórum delésti in ætérnum et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: Thou hast rebuked the Gentiles, and the wicked one hath perished: Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Inimíci defecérunt frámeæ in finem, et civitátes eórum destruxísti. Périit memória eórum cum sónitu;
verses.eng: The swords of the enemy have failed unto the end: and their cities Thou hast destroyed. Their memory hath perished with a noise;

verses.lat: Et Dóminus in ætérnum pérmanet. Parávit in judício thronum suum;
verses.eng: But the Lord remaineth for ever. He hath prepared His throne in judgment;

verses.lat: Et ipse judicábit orbem terræ in æquitáte, judicábit pópulos in justítia.
verses.eng: And He shall judge the world in equity, He shall judge the people in justice.

verses.lat: Et factus est Dóminus refúgium páuperi, adjútor in opportunitátibus, in tribulatióne.
verses.eng: And the Lord is become a refuge for the poor: a helper in due time in tribulation.

verses.lat: Et sperent in te qui novérunt nomen tuum, quóniam non dereliquísti quæréntes te, Dómine.
verses.eng: And let them trust in Thee who know Thy name: for Thou hast not forsaken them that seek Thee, O Lord.

verses.lat: Psállite Dómino, qui hábitat in Sion; annuntiáte inter gentes stúdia ejus.
verses.eng: Sing ye to the Lord, who dwelleth in Sion: declare His ways among the Gentiles.

verses.lat: Quóniam requírens sánguinem eórum recordátus est; non est oblítus clamórem páuperum.
verses.eng: For requiring their blood He hath remembered them: He hath not forgotten the cry of the poor.

verses.lat: Miserére mei, Dómine; vide humilitátem meam de inimícis meis.
verses.eng: Have mercy on me, O Lord: see my humiliation which I suffer from my enemies.

verses.lat: Qui exáltas me de portis mortis, ut annúntiem omnes laudatiónes tuas in portis fíliæ Sion.
verses.eng: Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death, that I may declare all Thy praises in the gates of the daughter of Sion.

verses.lat: Exsultábo in salutári tuo. Infíxæ sunt gentes in intéritu quem fecérunt.
verses.eng: I will rejoice in Thy salvation. The Gentiles have stuck fast in the destruction which they have prepared.

verses.lat: In láqueo isto quem abscondérunt, comprehénsus est pes eórum.
verses.eng: Their foot hath been taken in the very snare which they hid.

verses.lat: Cognoscétur Dóminus judícia fáciens; in opéribus mánuum suárum comprehénsus est peccátor.
verses.eng: The Lord shall be known when He executeth judgments: the sinner hath been caught in the works of his own hands.

verses.lat: Convertántur peccatóres in inférnum, omnes gentes quæ obliviscúntur Deum.
verses.eng: The wicked shall be turned into hell, all the nations that forget God.

verses.lat: Quóniam non in finem oblívio erit páuperis; patiéntia páuperum non períbit in finem.
verses.eng: For the poor man shall not be forgotten to the end: the patience of the poor shall not perish for ever.

verses.lat: Exsúrge, Dómine, non confortétur homo; judicéntur gentes in conspéctu tuo.
verses.eng: Arise, O Lord, let not man be strengthened: let the Gentiles be judged in Thy sight.

verses.lat: Constítue, Dómine, legislatórem super eos, ut sciant gentes quóniam hómines sunt.
verses.eng: Appoint, O Lord, a lawgiver over them: that the Gentiles may know themselves to be but men.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Ut quid, Dómine, recessísti longe, déspicis in opportunitátibus, in tribulatióne?
verses.eng: Why, O Lord, hast Thou retired afar off? Why dost Thou slight us in our wants, in the time of trouble?

verses.lat: Dum supérbit ímpius, incénditur pauper; comprehendúntur in consíliis quibus cógitant.
verses.eng: Whilst the wicked man is proud, the poor is set on fire: they are caught in the counsels which they devise.

verses.lat: Quóniam laudátur peccátor in desidériis ánimæ suæ, et iníquus benedícitur.
verses.eng: For the sinner is praised in the desires of his soul: and the unjust man is blessed.

verses.lat: Exacerbávit Dóminum peccátor: secúndum multitúdinem iræ suæ non quǽret.
verses.eng: The sinner hath provoked the Lord: according to the multitude of His wrath He will not seek him.

verses.lat: Non est Deus in conspéctu ejus; inquinátæ sunt viæ illíus in omni témpore.
verses.eng: God is not before his eyes: his ways are filthy at all times.

verses.lat: Auferúntur judícia tua a fácie ejus; ómnium inimicórum suórum dominábitur.
verses.eng: Thy judgments are removed from his sight: he shall rule over all his enemies.

verses.lat: Dixit enim in corde suo: Non movébor a generatióne in generatiónem sine malo.
verses.eng: For he hath said in his heart: I shall not be moved from generation to generation, and shall be without evil.

verses.lat: Cujus maledictióne os plenum est et amaritúdine et dolo; sub lingua ejus labor et dolor.
verses.eng: His mouth is full of cursing and of bitterness and of deceit: under his tongue are labour and sorrow.

verses.lat: Sedet in insídiis cum divítibus in occúltis, ut interfíciat innocéntem.
verses.eng: He sitteth in ambush with the rich in private places, that he may kill the innocent.

verses.lat: Óculi ejus in páuperem respíciunt; insidiátur in abscóndito, quasi leo in spelúnca sua.
verses.eng: His eyes are upon the poor man: he lieth in wait in secret like a lion in his den.

verses.lat: Insidiátur ut rápiat páuperem; rápere páuperem dum áttrahit eum.
verses.eng: He lieth in ambush that he may catch the poor man: to catch the poor, whilst he draweth him to him.

verses.lat: In láqueo suo humiliábit eum; inclinábit se et cadet, cum dominátus fúerit páuperum.
verses.eng: In his net he will bring him down, he will crouch and fall, when he shall have power over the poor.

verses.lat: Dixit enim in corde suo: Oblítus est Deus, avértit fáciem suam ne vídeat in finem.
verses.eng: For he hath said in his heart: God hath forgotten, He hath turned away His face not to see to the end.

verses.lat: Exsúrge, Dómine Deus, exaltétur manus tua; ne obliviscáris páuperum.
verses.eng: Arise, O Lord God, let Thy hand be exalted: forget not the poor.

verses.lat: Propter quid irritávit ímpius Deum? Dixit enim in corde suo: Non requíret.
verses.eng: Wherefore hath the wicked provoked God? For he hath said in his heart: He will not require it.

verses.lat: Vides, quóniam tu labórem et dolórem consíderas, ut tradas eos in manus tuas.
verses.eng: Thou seest it, for Thou considerest labour and sorrow: that Thou mayst deliver them into Thy hands.

verses.lat: Tibi derelíctus est pauper; órphano tu eris adjútor.
verses.eng: To Thee is the poor man left: Thou wilt be a helper to the orphan.

verses.lat: Cóntere brácchium peccatóris et malígni; quærétur peccátum illíus et non inveniétur.
verses.eng: Break Thou the arm of the sinner and of the malignant: his sin shall be sought, and shall not be found.

verses.lat: Dóminus regnábit in ætérnum et in sǽculum sǽculi; períbitis, gentes, de terra illíus.
verses.eng: The Lord shall reign to eternity, yea, for ever and ever: ye Gentiles shall perish from His land.

verses.lat: Desidérium páuperum exaudívit Dóminus; præparatiónem cordis eórum audívit auris tua.
verses.eng: The Lord hath heard the desire of the poor: Thy ear hath heard the preparation of their heart.

verses.lat: Judicáre pupíllo et húmili, ut non appónat ultra magnificáre se homo super terram.
verses.eng: To judge for the fatherless and for the humble, that man may no more presume to magnify himself upon earth.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Díligam te, Dómine, fortitúdo mea.
verses.eng: I will love Thee, O Lord, my strength.

verses.lat: Dóminus firmaméntum meum, et refúgium meum, et liberátor meus.
verses.eng: The Lord is my firmament, my refuge, and my deliverer.

verses.lat: Deus meus, adjútor meus, et sperábo in eum. Protéctor meus, et cornu salútis meæ, et suscéptor meus.
verses.eng: My God is my helper, and in Him will I put my trust. My protector, and the horn of my salvation, and my support.

verses.lat: Laudans invocábo Dóminum, et ab inimícis meis salvus ero.
verses.eng: Praising, I will call upon the Lord: and I shall be saved from my enemies.

verses.lat: Circumdedérunt me dolóres mortis, et torréntes iniquitátis conturbavérunt me.
verses.eng: The sorrows of death surrounded me: and the torrents of iniquity troubled me.

verses.lat: Dolóres inférni circumdedérunt me; præoccupavérunt me láquei mortis.
verses.eng: The sorrows of hell encompassed me: and the snares of death prevented me.

verses.lat: In tribulatióne mea invocávi Dóminum, et ad Deum meum clamávi.
verses.eng: In my affliction I called upon the Lord, and I cried to my God.

verses.lat: Et exaudívit de templo sancto suo vocem meam, et clamor meus in conspéctu ejus introívit in aures ejus.
verses.eng: And He heard my voice from His holy temple: and my cry before Him came into His ears.

verses.lat: Commóta est et contrémuit terra; fundaménta móntium conturbáta sunt et commóta sunt, quóniam irátus est eis.
verses.eng: The earth shook and trembled: the foundations of the mountains were troubled and were moved, because He was angry with them.

verses.lat: Ascéndit fumus in ira ejus, et ignis a fácie ejus exársit; carbónes succénsi sunt ab eo.
verses.eng: There went up a smoke in His wrath: and a fire flamed from His face: coals were kindled by it.

verses.lat: Inclinávit cælos et descéndit, et calígo sub pédibus ejus.
verses.eng: He bowed the heavens and came down: and darkness was under His feet.

verses.lat: Et ascéndit super chérubim et volávit; volávit super pennas ventórum.
verses.eng: And He ascended upon the cherubim and flew: He flew upon the wings of the winds.

verses.lat: Et pósuit ténebras latíbulum suum; in circúitu ejus tabernáculum ejus, tenebrósa aqua in núbibus áëris.
verses.eng: And He made darkness His covert, His pavilion round about Him: dark waters in the clouds of the air.

verses.lat: Præ fulgóre in conspéctu ejus nubes transiérunt, grando et carbónes ignis.
verses.eng: At the brightness that was before Him the clouds passed, hail and coals of fire.

verses.lat: Et intónuit de cælo Dóminus, et Altíssimus dedit vocem suam; grando et carbónes ignis.
verses.eng: And the Lord thundered from heaven, and the Highest gave His voice: hail and coals of fire.

verses.lat: Et misit sagíttas suas et dissipávit eos; fúlgura multiplicávit et conturbávit eos.
verses.eng: And He sent forth His arrows and He scattered them: He multiplied lightnings, and troubled them.

verses.lat: Et apparuérunt fontes aquárum, et reveláta sunt fundaménta orbis terrárum.
verses.eng: Then the fountains of waters appeared, and the foundations of the world were discovered.

verses.lat: Ab increpatióne tua, Dómine, ab inspiratióne spíritus iræ tuæ.
verses.eng: At Thy rebuke, O Lord, at the blast of the spirit of Thy wrath.

verses.lat: Misit de summo et accépit me, et assúmpsit me de aquis multis.
verses.eng: He sent from on high, and took me: and received me out of many waters.

verses.lat: Erípuit me de inimícis meis fortíssimis, et ab his qui odérunt me, quóniam confortáti sunt super me.
verses.eng: He delivered me from my strongest enemies, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.

verses.lat: Prævenérunt me in die afflictiónis meæ; et factus est Dóminus protéctor meus.
verses.eng: They prevented me in the day of my affliction: and the Lord became my protector.

verses.lat: Et edúxit me in latitúdinem; salvum me fecit, quóniam vóluit me.
verses.eng: And He brought me forth into a large place: He saved me, because He was well pleased with me.

verses.lat: Et retríbuet mihi Dóminus secúndum justítiam meam, et secúndum puritátem mánuum meárum retríbuet mihi.
verses.eng: And the Lord will reward me according to my justice: and will repay me according to the cleanness of my hands.

verses.lat: Quia custodívi vias Dómini, nec ímpie gessi a Deo meo.
verses.eng: Because I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not done wickedly against my God.

verses.lat: Quóniam ómnia judícia ejus in conspéctu meo, et justítias ejus non répuli a me.
verses.eng: For all His judgments are in my sight: and His justices I have not put away from me.

verses.lat: Et ero immaculátus cum eo, et observábo me ab iniquitáte mea.
verses.eng: And I shall be spotless with Him: and I shall keep myself from my iniquity.

verses.lat: Et retríbuet mihi Dóminus secúndum justítiam meam, et secúndum puritátem mánuum meárum in conspéctu oculórum ejus.
verses.eng: And the Lord will reward me according to my justice: and according to the cleanness of my hands before His eyes.

verses.lat: Cum sancto sanctus eris, et cum viro innocénte ínnocens eris.
verses.eng: With the holy Thou wilt be holy: and with the innocent man Thou wilt be innocent.

verses.lat: Et cum elécto eléctus eris, et cum pervérso pervertéris.
verses.eng: And with the elect Thou wilt be elect: and with the perverse Thou wilt be perverted.

verses.lat: Quóniam tu pópulum húmilem salvum fácies, et óculos superbórum humiliábis.
verses.eng: For Thou wilt save the humble people: but wilt bring down the eyes of the proud.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Deus, impollúta via ejus; elóquia Dómini igne examináta: protéctor est ómnium speántium in se.
verses.eng: As for my God, His way is undefiled: the words of the Lord are fire-tried: He is the protector of all that trust in Him.

verses.lat: Quóniam quis Deus præter Dóminum? Aut quis Deus præter Deum nostrum?
verses.eng: For who is God but the Lord? Or who is God but our God?

verses.lat: Deus qui præcínxit me virtúte, et pósuit immaculátam viam meam.
verses.eng: God who hath girt me with strength, and made my way blameless.

verses.lat: Qui perfécit pedes meos tamquam cervórum, et super excélsa státuens me.
verses.eng: Who hath made my feet like the feet of harts, and who setteth me upon high places.

verses.lat: Qui docet manus meas ad prǽlium; et posuísti, ut arcum ǽreum, bráchia mea.
verses.eng: Who teacheth my hands to war: and Thou hast made my arms like a brazen bow.

verses.lat: Et dedísti mihi protectiónem salútis tuæ, et déxtera tua suscépit me.
verses.eng: And Thou hast given me the protection of Thy salvation: and Thy right hand hath held me up.

verses.lat: Et disiplína tua corréxit me in finem, et disciplína tua ipsa me docébit.
verses.eng: And Thy discipline hath corrected me unto the end: and Thy discipline, the same shall teach me.

verses.lat: Dilatásti gressus meos subtus me, et non sunt infirmáta vestígia mea.
verses.eng: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me: and my feet are not weakened.

verses.lat: Pérsequar inimícos meos et comprehéndam illos, et non convértar donec defíciant.
verses.eng: I will pursue after my enemies and overtake them: and I will not turn again till they are consumed.

verses.lat: Confríngam illos, nec póterunt stare; cadent subtus pedes meos.
verses.eng: I will break them, and they shall not be able to stand: they shall fall under my feet.

verses.lat: Et præcinxísti me virtúte ad bellum, et supplantásti insurgéntes in me subtus me.
verses.eng: And Thou hast girded me with strength unto battle: and hast subdued under me them that rose up against me.

verses.lat: Et inimícos meos dedísti mihi dorsum, et odiéntes me disperdidísti.
verses.eng: And Thou hast made my enemies turn their back upon me, and hast destroyed them that hated me.

verses.lat: Clamavérunt, nec erat qui salvos fáceret; ad Dóminum, nec exaudívit eos.
verses.eng: They cried, but there was none to save them; to the Lord, but He heard them not.

verses.lat: Et commínuam eos ut púlverem ante fáciem venti; ut lutum plateárum delébo eos.
verses.eng: And I shall beat them as small as the dust before the wind: I shall bring them to nought, like the dirt in the streets.

verses.lat: Erípies me de contradictiónibus pópuli; constítues me in caput géntium.
verses.eng: Thou wilt deliver me from the contradictions of the people: Thou wilt make me head of the Gentiles.

verses.lat: Pópulus quem non cognóvi servívit mihi; in audítu auris obœdívit mihi.
verses.eng: A people which I knew not hath served me: at the hearing of the ear they have obeyed me.

verses.lat: Fílii aliéni mentíti sunt mihi; fílii aliéni inveteráti sunt et claudicavérunt a sémitis suis.
verses.eng: The children that are strangers have lied to me; strange children have faded away, and have halted from their paths.

verses.lat: Vivit Dóminus, et benedíctus Deus meus, et exaltétur Deus salútis meæ.
verses.eng: The Lord liveth, and blessed be my God: and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

verses.lat: Deus qui das vindíctas mihi et subdis pópulos sub me, liberátor meus de inimícis meis iracúndis.
verses.eng: O God, who avengest me and subduest the people under me, my deliverer from my enraged enemies.

verses.lat: Et ab insurgéntibus in me exaltábis me; a viro iníquo erípies me.
verses.eng: And Thou wilt lift me up above them that rise up against me: from the unjust man Thou wilt deliver me.

verses.lat: Proptérea confitébor tibi in natiónibus, Dómine, et nómini tuo psalmum dicam.
verses.eng: Therefore will I give glory to Thee, O Lord, among the nations: and I will sing a psalm to Thy name.

verses.lat: Magníficans salútes regis ejus, et fáciens misericórdiam christo suo David, et sémini ejus usque in sǽculum.
verses.eng: Giving great deliverance to His king, and showing mercy to David, His anointed, and to his seed for ever.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Exáudiat te Dóminus in die tribulatiónis; prótegat te nomen Dei Jacob.
verses.eng: May the Lord hear thee in the day of tribulation: may the name of the God of Jacob protect thee.

verses.lat: Mittat tibi auxílium de sancto, et de Sion tueátur te.
verses.eng: May He send thee help from the sanctuary, and defend thee out of Sion.

verses.lat: Memor sit omnis sacrifícii tui, et holocáustum tuum píngue fiat.
verses.eng: May He be mindful of all thy sacrifices, and may thy whole burnt offering be made fat.

verses.lat: Tríbuat tibi secúndum cor tuum, et omne consílium tuum confírmet.
verses.eng: May He give thee according to thy own heart, and confirm all thy counsels.

verses.lat: Lætábimur in salutári tuo; et in nómine Dei nostri magnificábimur.
verses.eng: We will rejoice in thy salvation: and in the name of our God we shall be exalted.

verses.lat: Ímpleat Dóminus omnes petitiónes tuas. Nunc cognóvi quóniam salvum fecit Dóminus christum suum.
verses.eng: The Lord fulfil all thy petitions. Now have I known that the Lord hath saved His anointed.

verses.lat: Exáudiet illum de cælo sancto suo, in poténtátibus salus déxteræ ejus.
verses.eng: He will hear him from His holy heaven: the salvation of His right hand is in powers.

verses.lat: Hi in cúrribus et hi in equis; nos autem in nómine Dómini Dei nostri invocábimus.
verses.eng: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will call upon the name of the Lord our God.

verses.lat: Ipsi obligáti sunt et cecidérunt; nos autem surréximus et erécti sumus.
verses.eng: They are bound and have fallen: but we are risen and are set upright.

verses.lat: Dómine, salvum fac regem, et exáudi nos in die qua invocavérimus te.
verses.eng: O Lord, save the king, and hear us in the day that we shall call upon Thee.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Dómine, in virtúte tua lætábitur rex, et super salutáre tuum exsultábit veheménter.
verses.eng: In Thy strength, O Lord, the king shall joy: and in Thy salvation he shall rejoice exceedingly.

verses.lat: Desidérium cordis ejus tribuísti ei, et voluntáte labiórum ejus non fraudásti eum.
verses.eng: Thou hast given him his heart's desire: and hast not withholden from him the will of his lips.

verses.lat: Quóniam prævenísti eum in benedictiónibus dulcédinis; posuísti in cápite ejus corónam de lápide pretióso.
verses.eng: For Thou hast prevented him with blessings of sweetness: Thou hast set on his head a crown of precious stones.

verses.lat: Vitam pétiit a te, et tribuísti ei longitúdinem diérum in sǽculum et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: He asked life of Thee: and Thou hast given him length of days for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Magna est glória ejus in salutári tuo; glóriam et magnum decórem impónes super eum.
verses.eng: His glory is great in Thy salvation: glory and great beauty shalt Thou lay upon him.

verses.lat: Quóniam dabis eum in benedictiónem in sǽculum sǽculi; lætificábis eum in gáudio cum vultu tuo.
verses.eng: For Thou shalt give him to be a blessing for ever and ever: Thou shalt make him joyful in gladness with Thy countenance.

verses.lat: Quóniam rex sperat in Dómino, et in misericórdia Altíssimi non commovébitur.
verses.eng: For the king hopeth in the Lord: and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

verses.lat: Inveniátur manus tua ómnibus inimícis tuis; déxtera tua invéniat omnes qui te odérunt.
verses.eng: Let Thy hand be found by all Thy enemies: let Thy right hand find out all them that hate Thee.

verses.lat: Pones eos ut clíbanum ignis in témpore vultus tui: Dóminus in ira sua conturbábit eos, et devorábit eos ignis.
verses.eng: Thou shalt make them as an oven of fire in the time of Thy anger: the Lord shall trouble them in His wrath, and fire shall devour them.

verses.lat: Fructum eórum de terra perdes, et semen eórum a fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: Their fruit shalt Thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

verses.lat: Quóniam declinavérunt in te mala; cogitavérunt consília quæ non potuérunt stabilíre.
verses.eng: For they have intended evils against Thee: they have devised counsels which they have not been able to establish.

verses.lat: Quóniam pones eos dorsum; in relíquiis tuis præparábis vultum eórum.
verses.eng: For Thou shalt make them turn their back: in Thy remnants Thou shalt prepare their face.

verses.lat: Exaltáre, Dómine, in virtúte tua; cantábimus et psallémus virtútes tuas.
verses.eng: Be Thou exalted, O Lord, in Thy own strength: we will sing and praise Thy power.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Deus, Deus meus, réspice in me: quare me dereliquísti? Longe a salúte mea verba delictórum meórum.
verses.eng: O God, my God, look upon me: why hast Thou forsaken me? Far from my salvation are the words of my sins.

verses.lat: Deus meus, clamábo per diem, et non exáudies; et nocte, et non ad insipiéntiam mihi.
verses.eng: O my God, I shall cry by day, and Thou wilt not hear: and by night, and it shall not be reputed as folly in me.

verses.lat: Tu autem in sancto hábitas, laus Israël.
verses.eng: But Thou dwellest in the holy place, the praise of Israel.

verses.lat: In te speravérunt patres nostri; speravérunt, et liberásti eos.
verses.eng: In Thee have our fathers hoped: they have hoped, and Thou hast delivered them.

verses.lat: Ad te clamavérunt et salvi facti sunt; in te speravérunt et non sunt confúsi.
verses.eng: They cried to Thee, and they were saved: they trusted in Thee, and were not confounded.

verses.lat: Ego autem sum vermis et non homo; oppróbrium hóminum et abjéctio plebis.
verses.eng: But I am a worm, and no man: the reproach of men and the outcast of the people.

verses.lat: Omnes vidéntes me derisérunt me; locúti sunt lábiis et movérunt caput.
verses.eng: All they that saw me have laughed me to scorn: they have spoken with the lips and wagged the head.

verses.lat: Sperávit in Dómino, erípiat eum; salvum fáciat eum, quóniam vult eum.
verses.eng: He hoped in the Lord, let Him deliver him: let Him save him, seeing He delighteth in him.

verses.lat: Quóniam tu es qui extraxísti me de ventre; spes mea ab ubéribus matris meæ.
verses.eng: For Thou art He that hast drawn me out of the womb: my hope from the breasts of my mother.

verses.lat: In te projéctus sum ex útero; de ventre matris meæ Deus meus es tu.
verses.eng: I was cast upon Thee from the womb; from my mother's womb Thou art my God.

verses.lat: Ne discésseris a me, quóniam tribulátio próxima est, quóniam non est qui ádjuvet.
verses.eng: Depart not from me, for tribulation is very near: for there is none to help me.

verses.lat: Circumdedérunt me vítuli multi; tauri pingues obsedérunt me.
verses.eng: Many calves have surrounded me: fat bulls have besieged me.

verses.lat: Aperuérunt super me os suum, sicut leo rápiens et rúgiens.
verses.eng: They have opened their mouths against me, as a lion ravening and roaring.

verses.lat: Sicut aqua effúsus sum, et dispérsa sunt ómnia ossa mea.
verses.eng: I am poured out like water: and all my bones are scattered.

verses.lat: Factum est cor meum tamquam cera liquéscens in médio ventris mei.
verses.eng: My heart is become like wax melting in the midst of my bowels.

verses.lat: Áruit tamquam testa virtus mea, et lingua mea adhǽsit fáucibus meis; et in púlverem mortis deduxísti me.
verses.eng: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue hath cleaved to my jaws: and Thou hast brought me down into the dust of death.

verses.lat: Quóniam circumdedérunt me canes multi; concílium malignántium obsédit me.
verses.eng: For many dogs have encompassed me: the council of the malignant hath besieged me.

verses.lat: Fodérunt manus meas et pedes meos; dinumeravérunt ómnia ossa mea.
verses.eng: They have dug my hands and feet: they have numbered all my bones.

verses.lat: Ipsi vero consideravérunt et inspexérunt me; divisérunt sibi vestiménta mea, et super vestem meam misérunt sortem.
verses.eng: And they have looked and stared upon me: they parted my garments amongst them, and upon my vesture they cast lots.

verses.lat: Tu autem, Dómine, ne elongáveris auxílium tuum a me; ad defensiónem meam cónspice.
verses.eng: But Thou, O Lord, remove not Thy help to a distance from me: look towards my defence.

verses.lat: Érue a frámea, Deus, ánimam meam, et de manu canis únicam meam.
verses.eng: Deliver, O God, my soul from the sword: my only one from the hand of the dog.

verses.lat: Salva me ex ore leónis, et a córnibus unicórnium humilitátem meam.
verses.eng: Save me from the lion's mouth: and my lowness from the horns of the unicorns.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Narrábo nomen tuum frátribus meis; in médio ecclésiæ laudábo te.
verses.eng: I will declare Thy name to my brethren: in the midst of the church will I praise Thee.

verses.lat: Qui timétis Dóminum, laudáte eum; univérsum semen Jacob, glorificáte eum.
verses.eng: Ye that fear the Lord, praise Him: all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify Him.

verses.lat: Tímeat eum omne semen Israël, quóniam non sprevit neque despéxit deprecatiónem páuperis.
verses.eng: Let all the seed of Israel fear Him: because He hath not slighted nor despised the supplication of the poor man.

verses.lat: Nec avértit fáciem suam a me; et cum clamárem ad eum, exaudívit me.
verses.eng: Neither hath He turned away His face from me: and when I cried to Him, He heard me.

verses.lat: Apud te laus mea in ecclésia magna; vota mea reddam in conspéctu timéntium eum.
verses.eng: With Thee is my praise in a great church: I will pay my vows in the sight of them that fear Him.

verses.lat: Edent páuperes et saturabúntur, et laudábunt Dóminum qui requírunt eum: vivent corda eórum in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: The poor shall eat and shall be filled: and they shall praise the Lord that seek Him: their hearts shall live for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Reminiscéntur et converténtur ad Dóminum univérsi fines terræ.
verses.eng: All the ends of the earth shall remember and shall be converted to the Lord.

verses.lat: Et adorábunt in conspéctu ejus univérsæ famíliæ géntium.
verses.eng: And all the kindreds of the Gentiles shall adore in His sight.

verses.lat: Quóniam Dómini est regnum, et ipse dominábitur géntium.
verses.eng: For the kingdom is the Lord's: and He shall have dominion over the nations.

verses.lat: Manducavérunt et adoravérunt omnes pingues terræ; in conspéctu ejus cadent omnes qui descéndunt in terram.
verses.eng: All the fat ones of the earth have eaten and have adored: all they that go down to the earth shall fall before Him.

verses.lat: Et ánima mea illi vivet, et semen meum sérviet ipsi.
verses.eng: And to Him my soul shall live: and my seed shall serve Him.

verses.lat: Annuntiábitur Dómino generátio ventúra; et annuntiábunt cæli justítiam ejus pópulo qui nascétur, quem fecit Dóminus.
verses.eng: There shall be declared to the Lord a generation to come: and the heavens shall show forth His justice to a people that shall be born, which the Lord hath made.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

vesperae.psalm1.label: Psalmus 114
vesperae.psalm1.antiphonEng: The Lord hath inclined * his ear unto me.

verses.lat: 114:1 Diléxi, quóniam exáudiet Dóminus * vocem oratiónis meæ.
verses.eng: 114:1 I have loved, because the Lord will hear * the voice of my prayer.

verses.lat: 114:2 Quia inclinávit aurem suam mihi: * et in diébus meis invocábo.
verses.eng: 114:2 Because he hath inclined his ear unto me: * and in my days I will call upon him.

verses.lat: 114:3a Circumdedérunt me dolóres mortis: * et perícula inférni invenérunt me.
verses.eng: 114:3a The sorrows of death have compassed me: * and the perils of hell have found me.

verses.lat: 114:3b Tribulatiónem et dolórem invéni: * (4a) et nomen Dómini invocávi.
verses.eng: 114:3b I met with trouble and sorrow: * (4a) and I called upon the name of the Lord.

verses.lat: 114:4b O Dómine, líbera ánimam meam: ‡ (5) miséricors Dóminus, et justus, * et Deus noster miserétur.
verses.eng: 114:4b O Lord, deliver my soul. ‡ (5) The Lord is merciful and just, * and our God sheweth mercy.

verses.lat: 114:6 Custódiens párvulos Dóminus: * humiliátus sum, et liberávit me.
verses.eng: 114:6 The Lord is the keeper of little ones: * I was humbled, and he delivered me.

verses.lat: 114:7 Convértere, ánima mea, in réquiem tuam: * quia Dóminus benefécit tibi.
verses.eng: 114:7 Turn, O my soul, into thy rest: * for the Lord hath been bountiful to thee.

verses.lat: 114:8 Quia erípuit ánimam meam de morte: ‡ óculos meos a lácrimis, * pedes meos a lapsu.
verses.eng: 114:8 For he hath delivered my soul from death: ‡ my eyes from tears, * my feet from falling.

verses.lat: 114:9 Placébo Dómino * in regióne vivórum.
verses.eng: 114:9 I will please the Lord * in the land of the living.

vesperae.psalm2.label: Psalmus 115
vesperae.psalm2.antiphonLat: Vota mea * Dómino reddam coram omni pópulo ejus.
vesperae.psalm2.antiphonEng: I will pay my vows * in the sight of all his people.

verses.lat: 115:1 Crédidi, propter quod locútus sum: * ego autem humiliátus sum nimis.
verses.eng: 115:1 I have believed, therefore have I spoken; * but I have been humbled exceedingly.

verses.lat: 115:2 Ego dixi in excéssu meo: * Omnis homo mendax.
verses.eng: 115:2 I said in my excess: * Every man is a liar.

verses.lat: 115:3 Quid retríbuam Dómino, * pro ómnibus, quæ retríbuit mihi?
verses.eng: 115:3 What shall I render to the Lord, * for all the things that he hath rendered to me?

verses.lat: 115:4 Cálicem salutáris accípiam: * et nomen Dómini invocábo.
verses.eng: 115:4 I will take the chalice of salvation; * and I will call upon the name of the Lord.

verses.lat: 115:5 Vota mea Dómino reddam coram omni pópulo ejus: * (6) pretiósa in conspéctu Dómini mors sanctórum ejus:
verses.eng: 115:5 I will pay my vows to the Lord before all his people: * (6) precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.

verses.lat: 115:7a O Dómine, quia ego servus tuus: * ego servus tuus, et fílius ancíllæ tuæ.
verses.eng: 115:7a O Lord, for I am thy servant: * I am thy servant, and the son of thy handmaid.

verses.lat: 115:7b Dirupísti víncula mea: ‡ (8) tibi sacrificábo hóstiam laudis, * et nomen Dómini invocábo.
verses.eng: 115:7b Thou hast broken my bonds: ‡ (8) I will sacrifice to thee the sacrifice of praise, * and I will call upon the name of the Lord.

verses.lat: 115:9 Vota mea Dómino reddam in conspéctu omnis pópuli ejus: * (10) in átriis domus Dómini, in médio tui, Jerúsalem.
verses.eng: 115:9 I will pay my vows to the Lord in the sight of all his people: * (10) in the courts of the house of the Lord, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem.

vesperae.psalm3.label: Psalmus 119
vesperae.psalm3.antiphonEng: I have cried to the Lord, * and he hath heard me.

verses.lat: 119:1 Ad Dóminum cum tribulárer clamávi: * et exaudívit me.
verses.eng: 119:1 In my trouble I cried to the Lord: * and he heard me.

verses.lat: 119:2 Dómine, líbera ánimam meam a lábiis iníquis, * et a lingua dolósa.
verses.eng: 119:2 O Lord, deliver my soul from wicked lips, * and a deceitful tongue.

verses.lat: 119:3 Quid detur tibi, aut quid apponátur tibi * ad linguam dolósam?
verses.eng: 119:3 What shall be given to thee, or what shall be added to thee, * to a deceitful tongue?

verses.lat: 119:4 Sagíttæ poténtis acútæ, * cum carbónibus desolatóriis.
verses.eng: 119:4 The sharp arrows of the mighty, * with coals that lay waste.

verses.lat: 119:5 Heu mihi, quia incolátus meus prolongátus est: † habitávi cum habitántibus Cedar: * (6) multum íncola fuit ánima mea.
verses.eng: 119:5 Woe is me, that my sojourning is prolonged! † I have dwelt with the inhabitants of Cedar: * (6) my soul hath been long a sojourner.

verses.lat: 119:7 Cum his, qui odérunt pacem, eram pacíficus: * cum loquébar illis, impugnábant me gratis.
verses.eng: 119:7 With them that hated peace I was peaceable: * when I spoke to them they fought against me without cause.

vesperae.psalm4.label: Psalmus 120
vesperae.psalm4.antiphonLat: Auxílium meum * a Dómino, qui fecit cælum et terram.
vesperae.psalm4.antiphonEng: My help is from the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

verses.lat: 120:1 Levávi óculos meos in montes, * unde véniet auxílium mihi.
verses.eng: 120:1 I have lifted up my eyes to the mountains, * from whence help shall come to me.

verses.lat: 120:2 Auxílium meum a Dómino, * qui fecit cælum et terram.
verses.eng: 120:2 My help is from the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

verses.lat: 120:3 Non det in commotiónem pedem tuum: * neque dormítet qui custódit te.
verses.eng: 120:3 May he not suffer thy foot to be moved: * neither let him slumber that keepeth thee.

verses.lat: 120:4 Ecce, non dormitábit neque dórmiet, * qui custódit Israël.
verses.eng: 120:4 Behold he shall neither slumber nor sleep, * that keepeth Israel.

verses.lat: 120:5 Dóminus custódit te, Dóminus protéctio tua, * super manum déxteram tuam.
verses.eng: 120:5 The Lord is thy keeper, the Lord is thy protection * upon thy right hand.

verses.lat: 120:6 Per diem sol non uret te: * neque luna per noctem.
verses.eng: 120:6 The sun shall not burn thee by day: * nor the moon by night.

verses.lat: 120:7 Dóminus custódit te ab omni malo: * custódiat ánimam tuam Dóminus.
verses.eng: 120:7 The Lord keepeth thee from all evil: * may the Lord keep thy soul.

verses.lat: 120:8 Dóminus custódiat intróitum tuum, et éxitum tuum: * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.
verses.eng: 120:8 May the Lord keep thy coming in and thy going out; * from henceforth now and for ever.

vesperae.antiphon.psalm1.label: Antíphona
vesperae.antiphon.psalm1.eng: The Lord hath inclined * his ear unto me.

vesperae.antiphon.psalm2.label: Antíphona
vesperae.antiphon.psalm2.lat: Vota mea * Dómino reddam coram omni pópulo ejus.
vesperae.antiphon.psalm2.eng: I will pay my vows * in the sight of all his people.

vesperae.antiphon.psalm3.label: Antíphona
vesperae.antiphon.psalm3.eng: I have cried to the Lord, * and he hath heard me.

vesperae.antiphon.psalm4.label: Antíphona
vesperae.antiphon.psalm4.lat: Auxílium meum * a Dómino, qui fecit cælum et terram.
vesperae.antiphon.psalm4.eng: My help is from the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

vesperae.psalm5.label: Psalmus 121
vesperae.psalm5.antiphonLat: Lætátus sum * in his, quæ dicta sunt mihi.
vesperae.psalm5.antiphonEng: I rejoiced * at the things that were said to me.

verses.lat: 121:1 Lætátus sum in his, quæ dicta sunt mihi: * In domum Dómini íbimus.
verses.eng: 121:1 I rejoiced at the things that were said to me: * We shall go into the house of the Lord.

verses.lat: 121:2 Stantes erant pedes nostri, * in átriis tuis, Jerúsalem.
verses.eng: 121:2 Our feet were standing * in thy courts, O Jerusalem.

verses.lat: 121:3 Jerúsalem, quæ ædificátur ut cívitas: * cujus participátio ejus in idípsum.
verses.eng: 121:3 Jerusalem, which is built as a city, * which is compact together.

verses.lat: 121:4 Illuc enim ascendérunt tribus, tribus Dómini: * testimónium Israël ad confiténdum nómini Dómini.
verses.eng: 121:4 For thither did the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord: * the testimony of Israel, to praise the name of the Lord.

verses.lat: 121:5 Quia illic sedérunt sedes in judício, * sedes super domum David.
verses.eng: 121:5 Because their seats have sat in judgment, * seats upon the house of David.

verses.lat: 121:6 Rogáte quæ ad pacem sunt Jerúsalem: * et abundántia diligéntibus te:
verses.eng: 121:6 Pray ye for the things that are for the peace of Jerusalem: * and abundance for them that love thee.

verses.lat: 121:7 Fiat pax in virtúte tua: * et abundántia in túrribus tuis.
verses.eng: 121:7 Let peace be in thy strength: * and abundance in thy towers.

verses.lat: 121:8 Propter fratres meos, et próximos meos, * loquébar pacem de te:
verses.eng: 121:8 For the sake of my brethren, and of my neighbours, * I spoke peace of thee.

verses.lat: 121:9 Propter domum Dómini, Dei nostri, * quæsívi bona tibi.
verses.eng: 121:9 Because of the house of the Lord our God, * I have sought good things for thee.

vesperae.antiphon.psalm5.label: Antíphona
vesperae.antiphon.psalm5.lat: Lætátus sum * in his, quæ dicta sunt mihi.
vesperae.antiphon.psalm5.eng: I rejoiced * at the things that were said to me.

ant_prima.label: Antíphona
ant_prima.lat: Ínnocens mánibus * et mundo corde ascéndet in montem Dómini.
ant_prima.eng: The innocent in hands * and clean of heart shall ascend the mountain of the Lord.

verses.lat: 23:1 Dómini est terra, et plenitúdo ejus: * orbis terrárum, et univérsi qui hábitant in eo.
verses.eng: 23:1 The earth is the Lord’s and the fulness thereof: * the world, and all they that dwell therein.

verses.lat: 23:2 Quia ipse super mária fundávit eum: * et super flúmina præparávit eum.
verses.eng: 23:2 For he hath founded it upon the seas; * and hath prepared it upon the rivers.

verses.lat: 23:3 Quis ascéndet in montem Dómini? * aut quis stabit in loco sancto ejus?
verses.eng: 23:3 Who shall ascend into the mountain of the Lord: * or who shall stand in his holy place?

verses.lat: 23:4 Ínnocens mánibus et mundo corde, * qui non accépit in vano ánimam suam, nec jurávit in dolo próximo suo.
verses.eng: 23:4 The innocent in hands, and clean of heart, * who hath not taken his soul in vain, nor sworn deceitfully to his neighbour.

verses.lat: 23:5 Hic accípiet benedictiónem a Dómino: * et misericórdiam a Deo, salutári suo.
verses.eng: 23:5 He shall receive a blessing from the Lord, * and mercy from God his Saviour.

verses.lat: 23:6 Hæc est generátio quæréntium eum, * quæréntium fáciem Dei Jacob.
verses.eng: 23:6 This is the generation of them that seek him, * of them that seek the face of the God of Jacob.

verses.lat: 23:7 Attóllite portas, príncipes, vestras, et elevámini, portæ æternáles: * et introíbit Rex glóriæ.
verses.eng: 23:7 Lift up your gates, O ye princes, and be ye lifted up, O eternal gates: * and the King of Glory shall enter in.

verses.lat: 23:8 Quis est iste Rex glóriæ? * Dóminus fortis et potens: Dóminus potens in prǽlio.
verses.eng: 23:8 Who is this King of Glory? * the Lord who is strong and mighty: the Lord mighty in battle.

verses.lat: 23:9 Attóllite portas, príncipes, vestras, et elevámini, portæ æternáles: * et introíbit Rex glóriæ.
verses.eng: 23:9 Lift up your gates, O ye princes, and be ye lifted up, O eternal gates: * and the King of Glory shall enter in.

verses.lat: 23:10 Quis est iste Rex glóriæ? * Dóminus virtútum ipse est Rex glóriæ.
verses.eng: 23:10 Who is this King of Glory? * the Lord of hosts, he is the King of Glory.

verses.lat: 18:2 Cæli enárrant glóriam Dei: * et ópera mánuum ejus annúntiat firmaméntum.
verses.eng: 18:2 The heavens shew forth the glory of God, * and the firmament declareth the work of his hands.

verses.lat: 18:3 Dies diéi erúctat verbum, * et nox nocti índicat sciéntiam.
verses.eng: 18:3 Day to day uttereth speech, * and night to night sheweth knowledge.

verses.lat: 18:4 Non sunt loquélæ, neque sermónes, * quorum non audiántur voces eórum.
verses.eng: 18:4 There are no speeches nor languages, * where their voices are not heard.

verses.lat: 18:5 In omnem terram exívit sonus eórum: * et in fines orbis terræ verba eórum.
verses.eng: 18:5 Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth: * and their words unto the ends of the world.

verses.lat: 18:6a In sole pósuit tabernáculum suum: * et ipse tamquam sponsus procédens de thálamo suo:
verses.eng: 18:6a He hath set his tabernacle in the sun: * and he, as a bridegroom coming out of his bride chamber,

verses.lat: 18:6b Exsultávit ut gigas ad curréndam viam, * (7a) a summo cælo egréssio ejus:
verses.eng: 18:6b Hath rejoiced as a giant to run the way: * (7a) his going out is from the end of heaven,

verses.lat: 18:7b Et occúrsus ejus usque ad summum ejus: * nec est qui se abscóndat a calóre ejus.
verses.eng: 18:7b And his circuit even to the end thereof: * and there is no one that can hide himself from his heat.

verses.lat: 18:8 Lex Dómini immaculáta, convértens ánimas: * testimónium Dómini fidéle, sapiéntiam præstans párvulis.
verses.eng: 18:8 The law of the Lord is unspotted, converting souls: * the testimony of the Lord is faithful, giving wisdom to little ones.

verses.lat: 18:9 Justítiæ Dómini rectæ, lætificántes corda: * præcéptum Dómini lúcidum, illúminans óculos.
verses.eng: 18:9 The justices of the Lord are right, rejoicing hearts: * the commandment of the Lord is lightsome, enlightening the eyes.

verses.lat: 18:10 Timor Dómini sanctus, pérmanens in sǽculum sǽculi: * judícia Dómini vera, justificáta in semetípsa.
verses.eng: 18:10 The fear of the Lord is holy, enduring for ever and ever: * the judgments of the Lord are true, justified in themselves.

verses.lat: 18:11 Desiderabília super aurum et lápidem pretiósum multum: * et dulcióra super mel et favum.
verses.eng: 18:11 More to be desired than gold and many precious stones: * and sweeter than honey and the honeycomb.

verses.lat: 18:12 Étenim servus tuus custódit ea, * in custodiéndis illis retribútio multa.
verses.eng: 18:12 For thy servant keepeth them, * and in keeping them there is a great reward.

verses.lat: 18:13 Delícta quis intéllegit? † ab occúltis meis munda me: * (14a) et ab aliénis parce servo tuo.
verses.eng: 18:13 Who can understand sins? † from my secret ones cleanse me, O Lord: * (14a) and from those of others spare thy servant.

verses.lat: 18:14b Si mei non fúerint domináti, tunc immaculátus ero: * et emundábor a delícto máximo.
verses.eng: 18:14b If they shall have no dominion over me, then shall I be without spot: * and I shall be cleansed from the greatest sin.

verses.lat: 18:15a Et erunt ut compláceant elóquia oris mei: * et meditátio cordis mei in conspéctu tuo semper.
verses.eng: 18:15a And the words of my mouth shall be such as may please: * and the meditation of my heart always in thy sight.

verses.lat: 18:15b Dómine, adjútor meus, * et redémptor meus.
verses.eng: 18:15b O Lord, my helper, * and my redeemer.

ant_tertia.label: Antíphona
ant_tertia.lat: Illuminátio mea * et salus mea Dóminus.
ant_tertia.eng: My light * and my salvation is the Lord.

verses.lat: 26:1 Dóminus illuminátio mea, et salus mea, * quem timébo?
verses.eng: 26:1 The Lord is my light and my salvation, * whom shall I fear?

verses.lat: 26:1 Dóminus protéctor vitæ meæ, * a quo trepidábo?
verses.eng: 26:1 The Lord is the protector of my life: * of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.lat: 26:2 Dum apprópiant super me nocéntes, * ut edant carnes meas:
verses.eng: 26:2 Whilst the wicked draw near against me, * to eat my flesh.

verses.lat: 26:2 Qui tríbulant me inimíci mei, * ipsi infirmáti sunt, et cecidérunt.
verses.eng: 26:2 My enemies that trouble me, * have themselves been weakened, and have fallen.

verses.lat: 26:3 Si consístant advérsum me castra, * non timébit cor meum.
verses.eng: 26:3 If armies in camp should stand together against me, * my heart shall not fear.

verses.lat: 26:3 Si exsúrgat advérsum me prǽlium, * in hoc ego sperábo.
verses.eng: 26:3 If a battle should rise up against me, * in this will I be confident.

verses.lat: 26:4 Unam pétii a Dómino, hanc requíram, * ut inhábitem in domo Dómini ómnibus diébus vitæ meæ:
verses.eng: 26:4 One thing I have asked of the Lord, this will I seek after; * that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life.

verses.lat: 26:4 Ut vídeam voluptátem Dómini, * et vísitem templum ejus.
verses.eng: 26:4 That I may see the delight of the Lord, * and may visit his temple.

verses.lat: 26:5 Quóniam abscóndit me in tabernáculo suo: * in die malórum protéxit me in abscóndito tabernáculi sui.
verses.eng: 26:5 For he hath hidden me in his tabernacle; * in the day of evils, he hath protected me in the secret place of his tabernacle.

verses.lat: 26:6 In petra exaltávit me: * et nunc exaltávit caput meum super inimícos meos.
verses.eng: 26:6 He hath exalted me upon a rock: * and now he hath lifted up my head above my enemies.

verses.lat: 26:6 Circuívi, et immolávi in tabernáculo ejus hóstiam vociferatiónis: * cantábo, et psalmum dicam Dómino.
verses.eng: 26:6 I have gone round, and have offered up in his tabernacle a sacrifice of jubilation: * I will sing, and recite a psalm to the Lord.

verses.lat: 26:7 Exáudi, Dómine, vocem meam, qua clamávi ad te: * miserére mei, et exáudi me.
verses.eng: 26:7 Hear, O Lord, my voice, with which I have cried to thee: * have mercy on me and hear me.

verses.lat: 26:8 Tibi dixit cor meum, exquisívit te fácies mea: * fáciem tuam, Dómine, requíram.
verses.eng: 26:8 My heart hath said to thee: My face hath sought thee: * thy face, O Lord, will I still seek.

verses.lat: 26:9 Ne avértas fáciem tuam a me: * ne declínes in ira a servo tuo.
verses.eng: 26:9 Turn not away thy face from me; * decline not in thy wrath from thy servant.

verses.lat: 26:9 Adjútor meus esto: * ne derelínquas me, neque despícias me, Deus, salutáris meus.
verses.eng: 26:9 Be thou my helper, * forsake me not; do not thou despise me, O God my Saviour.

verses.lat: 26:10 Quóniam pater meus, et mater mea dereliquérunt me: * Dóminus autem assúmpsit me.
verses.eng: 26:10 For my father and my mother have left me: * but the Lord hath taken me up.

verses.lat: 26:11 Legem pone mihi, Dómine, in via tua: * et dírige me in sémitam rectam propter inimícos meos.
verses.eng: 26:11 Set me, O Lord, a law in thy way, * and guide me in the right path, because of my enemies.

verses.lat: 26:12 Ne tradíderis me in ánimas tribulántium me: * quóniam insurrexérunt in me testes iníqui, et mentíta est iníquitas sibi.
verses.eng: 26:12 Deliver me not over to the will of them that trouble me; * for unjust witnesses have risen up against me; and iniquity hath lied to itself.

verses.lat: 26:13 Credo vidére bona Dómini * in terra vivéntium.
verses.eng: 26:13 I believe to see the good things of the Lord * in the land of the living.

verses.lat: 26:14 Exspécta Dóminum, viríliter age: * et confortétur cor tuum, et sústine Dóminum.
verses.eng: 26:14 Expect the Lord, do manfully, * and let thy heart take courage, and wait thou for the Lord.

verses.lat: 27:1 Ad te, Dómine, clamábo, Deus meus, ne síleas a me: * nequándo táceas a me, et assimilábor descendéntibus in lacum.
verses.eng: 27:1 Unto thee will I cry, O Lord: my God, be not thou silent to me: * lest if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

verses.lat: 27:2 Exáudi, Dómine, vocem deprecatiónis meæ dum oro ad te: * dum extóllo manus meas ad templum sanctum tuum.
verses.eng: 27:2 Hear, O Lord, the voice of my supplication, when I pray to thee; * when I lift up my hands to thy holy temple.

verses.lat: 27:3 Ne simul trahas me cum peccatóribus: * et cum operántibus iniquitátem ne perdas me.
verses.eng: 27:3 Draw me not away together with the wicked; * and with the workers of iniquity destroy me not:

verses.lat: 27:3 Qui loquúntur pacem cum próximo suo, * mala autem in córdibus eórum.
verses.eng: 27:3 Who speak peace with their neighbour, * but evils are in their hearts.

verses.lat: 27:4 Da illis secúndum ópera eórum, * et secúndum nequítiam adinventiónum ipsórum.
verses.eng: 27:4 Give them according to their works, * and according to the wickedness of their inventions.

verses.lat: 27:4 Secúndum ópera mánuum eórum tríbue illis: * redde retributiónem eórum ipsis.
verses.eng: 27:4 According to the works of their hands give thou to them: * render to them their reward.

verses.lat: 27:5 Quóniam non intellexérunt ópera Dómini, et in ópera mánuum ejus * déstrues illos, et non ædificábis eos.
verses.eng: 27:5 Because they have not understood the works of the Lord, and the operations of his hands: * thou shalt destroy them, and shalt not build them up.

verses.lat: 27:6 Benedíctus Dóminus: * quóniam exaudívit vocem deprecatiónis meæ.
verses.eng: 27:6 Blessed be the Lord, * for he hath heard the voice of my supplication.

verses.lat: 27:7 Dóminus adjútor meus, et protéctor meus: * in ipso sperávit cor meum, et adjútus sum.
verses.eng: 27:7 The Lord is my helper and my protector: * in him hath my heart confided, and I have been helped.

verses.lat: 27:7 Et reflóruit caro mea: * et ex voluntáte mea confitébor ei.
verses.eng: 27:7 And my flesh hath flourished again, * and with my will I will give praise to him.

verses.lat: 27:8 Dóminus fortitúdo plebis suæ: * et protéctor salvatiónum Christi sui est.
verses.eng: 27:8 The Lord is the strength of his people, * and the protector of the salvation of his anointed.

verses.lat: 27:9 Salvum fac pópulum tuum, Dómine, et bénedic hereditáti tuæ: * et rege eos, et extólle illos usque in ætérnum.
verses.eng: 27:9 Save, O Lord, thy people, and bless thy inheritance: * and rule them and exalt them for ever.

ant_sexta.label: Antíphona
ant_sexta.lat: In tua justítia * líbera me, Dómine.
ant_sexta.eng: Deliver me * in thy justice, O Lord.

verses.lat: 30:2 In te, Dómine, sperávi, non confúndar in ætérnum: * in justítia tua líbera me.
verses.eng: 30:2 In thee, O Lord, have I hoped, let me never be confounded: * deliver me in thy justice.

verses.lat: 30:3 Inclína ad me aurem tuam, * accélera ut éruas me.
verses.eng: 30:3 Bow down thy ear to me: * make haste to deliver me.

verses.lat: 30:3 Esto mihi in Deum protectórem, et in domum refúgii: * ut salvum me fácias.
verses.eng: 30:3 Be thou unto me a God, a protector, and a house of refuge, * to save me.

verses.lat: 30:4 Quóniam fortitúdo mea, et refúgium meum es tu: * et propter nomen tuum dedúces me, et enútries me.
verses.eng: 30:4 For thou art my strength and my refuge; * and for thy name’s sake thou wilt lead me, and nourish me.

verses.lat: 30:5 Edúces me de láqueo hoc, quem abscondérunt mihi: * quóniam tu es protéctor meus.
verses.eng: 30:5 Thou wilt bring me out of this snare, which they have hidden for me: * for thou art my protector.

verses.lat: 30:6 In manus tuas comméndo spíritum meum: * redemísti me, Dómine, Deus veritátis.
verses.eng: 30:6 Into thy hands I commend my spirit: * thou hast redeemed me, O Lord, the God of truth.

verses.lat: 30:7 Odísti observántes vanitátes, * supervácue.
verses.eng: 30:7 Thou hast hated them that regard vanities, * to no purpose.

verses.lat: 30:7 Ego autem in Dómino sperávi: * exsultábo, et lætábor in misericórdia tua.
verses.eng: 30:7 But I have hoped in the Lord: * I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy.

verses.lat: 30:8 Quóniam respexísti humilitátem meam, * salvásti de necessitátibus ánimam meam.
verses.eng: 30:8 For thou hast regarded my humility, * thou hast saved my soul out of distresses.

verses.lat: 30:9 Nec conclusísti me in mánibus inimíci: * statuísti in loco spatióso pedes meos.
verses.eng: 30:9 And thou hast not shut me up in the hands of the enemy: * thou hast set my feet in a spacious place.

verses.lat: 30:10 Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam tríbulor: * conturbátus est in ira óculus meus, ánima mea, et venter meus:
verses.eng: 30:10 Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am afflicted: * my eye is troubled with wrath, my soul, and my belly:

verses.lat: 30:11 Quóniam defécit in dolóre vita mea: * et anni mei in gemítibus.
verses.eng: 30:11 For my life is wasted with grief: * and my years in sighs.

verses.lat: 30:11 Infirmáta est in paupertáte virtus mea: * et ossa mea conturbáta sunt.
verses.eng: 30:11 My strength is weakened through poverty * and my bones are disturbed.

verses.lat: 30:12 Super omnes inimícos meos factus sum oppróbrium et vicínis meis valde: * et timor notis meis.
verses.eng: 30:12 I am become a reproach among all my enemies, and very much to my neighbours; * and a fear to my acquaintance.

verses.lat: 30:12 Qui vidébant me, foras fugérunt a me: * oblivióni datus sum, tamquam mórtuus a corde.
verses.eng: 30:12 They that saw me without fled from me. * I am forgotten as one dead from the heart.

verses.lat: 30:13 Factus sum tamquam vas pérditum: * quóniam audívi vituperatiónem multórum commorántium in circúitu.
verses.eng: 30:13 I am become as a vessel that is destroyed. * For I have heard the blame of many that dwell round about.

verses.lat: 30:14 In eo dum convenírent simul advérsum me, * accípere ánimam meam consiliáti sunt.
verses.eng: 30:14 While they assembled together against me, * they consulted to take away my life.

verses.lat: 30:15 Ego autem in te sperávi, Dómine: * dixi: Deus meus es tu: in mánibus tuis sortes meæ.
verses.eng: 30:15 But I have put my trust in thee, O Lord: * I said: Thou art my God. My lots are in thy hands.

verses.lat: 30:16 Éripe me de manu inimicórum meórum, * et a persequéntibus me.
verses.eng: 30:16 Deliver me out of the hands of my enemies; * and from them that persecute me

verses.lat: 30:17 Illústra fáciem tuam super servum tuum, salvum me fac in misericórdia tua: * Dómine, non confúndar, quóniam invocávi te.
verses.eng: 30:17 Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; save me in thy mercy. * Let me not be confounded, O Lord, for I have called upon thee.

verses.lat: 30:18 Erubéscant ímpii, et deducántur in inférnum: * muta fiant lábia dolósa.
verses.eng: 30:18 Let the wicked be ashamed, and be brought down to hell. * Let deceitful lips be made dumb.

verses.lat: 30:19 Quæ loquúntur advérsus justum iniquitátem: * in supérbia, et in abusióne.
verses.eng: 30:19 Which speak iniquity against the just, * with pride and abuse.

verses.lat: 30:20 Quam magna multitúdo dulcédinis tuæ, Dómine, * quam abscondísti timéntibus te.
verses.eng: 30:20 How great is the multitude of thy sweetness, O Lord, * which thou hast hidden for them that fear thee!

verses.lat: 30:20 Perfecísti eis, qui sperant in te, * in conspéctu filiórum hóminum.
verses.eng: 30:20 Which thou hast wrought for them that hope in thee, * in the sight of the sons of men.

verses.lat: 30:21 Abscóndes eos in abscóndito faciéi tuæ * a conturbatióne hóminum.
verses.eng: 30:21 Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy face, * from the disturbance of men.

verses.lat: 30:21 Próteges eos in tabernáculo tuo * a contradictióne linguárum.
verses.eng: 30:21 Thou shalt protect them in thy tabernacle * from the contradiction of tongues.

verses.lat: 30:22 Benedíctus Dóminus: * quóniam mirificávit misericórdiam suam mihi in civitáte muníta.
verses.eng: 30:22 Blessed be the Lord, * for he hath shewn his wonderful mercy to me in a fortified city.

verses.lat: 30:23 Ego autem dixi in excéssu mentis meæ: * Projéctus sum a fácie oculórum tuórum.
verses.eng: 30:23 But I said in the excess of my mind: * I am cast away from before thy eyes.

verses.lat: 30:23 Ídeo exaudísti vocem oratiónis meæ, * dum clamárem ad te.
verses.eng: 30:23 Therefore thou hast heard the voice of my prayer, * when I cried to thee.

verses.lat: 30:24 Dilígite Dóminum omnes sancti ejus: * quóniam veritátem requíret Dóminus, et retríbuet abundánter faciéntibus supérbiam.
verses.eng: 30:24 O love the Lord, all ye his saints: * for the Lord will require truth, and will repay them abundantly that act proudly.

verses.lat: 30:25 Viríliter ágite, et confortétur cor vestrum, * omnes, qui sperátis in Dómino.
verses.eng: 30:25 Do ye manfully, and let your heart be strengthened, * all ye that hope in the Lord.

ant_nona.label: Antíphona
ant_nona.lat: Exsultáte, justi, * et gloriámini, omnes recti corde.
ant_nona.eng: Rejoice ye  just, * and glory, all ye right of heart.

verses.lat: 31:1 Beáti quorum remíssæ sunt iniquitátes: * et quorum tecta sunt peccáta.
verses.eng: 31:1 Blessed are those whose iniquities are forgiven * and whose sins are covered.

verses.lat: 31:2 Beátus vir, cui non imputávit Dóminus peccátum, * nec est in spíritu ejus dolus.
verses.eng: 31:2 Blessed is the man to whom the Lord hath not imputed sin, * and in whose spirit there is no guile.

verses.lat: 31:3 Quóniam tácui, inveteravérunt ossa mea, * dum clamárem tota die.
verses.eng: 31:3 Because I was silent my bones grew old; * whilst I cried out all the day long.

verses.lat: 31:4 Quóniam die ac nocte graváta est super me manus tua: * convérsus sum in ærúmna mea, dum confígitur spina.
verses.eng: 31:4 For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: * I am turned in my anguish, whilst the thorn is fastened.

verses.lat: 31:5 Delíctum meum cógnitum tibi feci: * et injustítiam meam non abscóndi.
verses.eng: 31:5 I have acknowledged my sin to thee, * and my injustice I have not concealed.

verses.lat: 31:5 Dixi: Confitébor advérsum me injustítiam meam Dómino: * et tu remisísti impietátem peccáti mei.
verses.eng: 31:5 I said I will confess against myself my injustice to the Lord: * and thou hast forgiven the wickedness of my sin.

verses.lat: 31:6 Pro hac orábit ad te omnis sanctus, * in témpore opportúno.
verses.eng: 31:6 For this shall every one that is holy pray to thee * in a seasonable time.

verses.lat: 31:6 Verúmtamen in dilúvio aquárum multárum, * ad eum non approximábunt.
verses.eng: 31:6 And yet in a flood of many waters, * they shall not come nigh unto him.

verses.lat: 31:7 Tu es refúgium meum a tribulatióne, quæ circúmdedit me: * exsultátio mea, érue me a circumdántibus me.
verses.eng: 31:7 Thou art my refuge from the trouble which hath encompassed me: * my joy, deliver me from them that surround me.

verses.lat: 31:8 Intelléctum tibi dabo, et ínstruam te in via hac, qua gradiéris: * firmábo super te óculos meos.
verses.eng: 31:8 I will give thee understanding, and I will instruct thee in this way, in which thou shalt go: * I will fix my eyes upon thee.

verses.lat: 31:9 Nolíte fíeri sicut equus et mulus, * quibus non est intelléctus.
verses.eng: 31:9 Do not become like the horse and the mule, * who have no understanding.

verses.lat: 31:9 In camo et freno maxíllas eórum constrínge, * qui non appróximant ad te.
verses.eng: 31:9 With bit and bridle bind fast their jaws, * who come not near unto thee.

verses.lat: 31:10 Multa flagélla peccatóris, * sperántem autem in Dómino misericórdia circúmdabit.
verses.eng: 31:10 Many are the scourges of the sinner, * but mercy shall encompass him that hopeth in the Lord.

verses.lat: 31:11 Lætámini in Dómino et exsultáte, justi, * et gloriámini, omnes recti corde.
verses.eng: 31:11 Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye just, * and glory, all ye right of heart.

verses.lat: 32:1 Exsultáte, justi, in Dómino: * rectos decet collaudátio.
verses.eng: 32:1 Rejoice in the Lord, O ye just: * praise becometh the upright.

verses.lat: 32:2 Confitémini Dómino in cíthara: * in psaltério decem chordárum psállite illi.
verses.eng: 32:2 Give praise to the Lord on the harp; * sing to him with the psaltery, the instrument of ten strings.

verses.lat: 32:3 Cantáte ei cánticum novum: * bene psállite ei in vociferatióne.
verses.eng: 32:3 Sing to him a new canticle, * sing well unto him with a loud noise.

verses.lat: 32:4 Quia rectum est verbum Dómini, * et ómnia ópera ejus in fide.
verses.eng: 32:4 For the word of the Lord is right, * and all his works are done with faithfulness.

verses.lat: 32:5 Díligit misericórdiam et judícium: * misericórdia Dómini plena est terra.
verses.eng: 32:5 He loveth mercy and judgment; * the earth is full of the mercy of the Lord.

verses.lat: 32:6 Verbo Dómini cæli firmáti sunt: * et spíritu oris ejus omnis virtus eórum.
verses.eng: 32:6 By the word of the Lord the heavens were established; * and all the power of them by the spirit of his mouth:

verses.lat: 32:7 Cóngregans sicut in utre aquas maris: * ponens in thesáuris abýssos.
verses.eng: 32:7 Gathering together the waters of the sea, as in a vessel; * laying up the depths in storehouses.

verses.lat: 32:8 Tímeat Dóminum omnis terra: * ab eo autem commoveántur omnes inhabitántes orbem.
verses.eng: 32:8 Let all the earth fear the Lord, * and let all the inhabitants of the world be in awe of him.

verses.lat: 32:9 Quóniam ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.
verses.eng: 32:9 For he spoke and they were made: * he commanded and they were created.

verses.lat: 32:10 Dóminus díssipat consília géntium: * réprobat autem cogitatiónes populórum, et réprobat consília príncipum.
verses.eng: 32:10 The Lord bringeth to nought the counsels of nations; * and he rejecteth the devices of people, and casteth away the counsels of princes.

verses.lat: 32:11 Consílium autem Dómini in ætérnum manet: * cogitatiónes cordis ejus in generatióne et generatiónem.
verses.eng: 32:11 But the counsel of the Lord standeth for ever: * the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

verses.lat: 32:12 Beáta gens, cujus est Dóminus, Deus ejus: * pópulus, quem elégit in hereditátem sibi.
verses.eng: 32:12 Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord: * the people whom he hath chosen for his inheritance.

verses.lat: 32:13 De cælo respéxit Dóminus: * vidit omnes fílios hóminum.
verses.eng: 32:13 The Lord hath looked from heaven: * he hath beheld all the sons of men.

verses.lat: 32:14 De præparáto habitáculo suo * respéxit super omnes, qui hábitant terram.
verses.eng: 32:14 From his habitation which he hath prepared, * he hath looked upon all that dwell on the earth.

verses.lat: 32:15 Qui finxit sigillátim corda eórum: * qui intéllegit ómnia ópera eórum.
verses.eng: 32:15 He who hath made the hearts of every one of them: * who understandeth all their works.

verses.lat: 32:16 Non salvátur rex per multam virtútem: * et gigas non salvábitur in multitúdine virtútis suæ.
verses.eng: 32:16 The king is not saved by a great army: * nor shall the giant be saved by his own great strength.

verses.lat: 32:17 Fallax equus ad salútem: * in abundántia autem virtútis suæ non salvábitur.
verses.eng: 32:17 Vain is the horse for safety: * neither shall he be saved by the abundance of his strength.

verses.lat: 32:18 Ecce, óculi Dómini super metuéntes eum: * et in eis, qui sperant super misericórdia ejus:
verses.eng: 32:18 Behold the eyes of the Lord are on them that fear him: * and on them that hope in his mercy.

verses.lat: 32:19 Ut éruat a morte ánimas eórum: * et alat eos in fame.
verses.eng: 32:19 To deliver their souls from death; * and feed them in famine.

verses.lat: 32:20 Ánima nostra sústinet Dóminum: * quóniam adjútor et protéctor noster est.
verses.eng: 32:20 Our soul waiteth for the Lord: * for he is our helper and protector.

verses.lat: 32:21 Quia in eo lætábitur cor nostrum: * et in nómine sancto ejus sperávimus.
verses.eng: 32:21 For in him our heart shall rejoice: * and in his holy name we have trusted.

verses.lat: 32:22 Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos: * quemádmodum sperávimus in te.
verses.eng: 32:22 Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, * as we have hoped in thee.

completorium.antiphon.label: Antíphona
completorium.antiphon.lat: Salvum me fac, * Dómine, propter misericórdiam tuam.
completorium.antiphon.eng: Deliver my soul, * O Lord, save me for thy mercy's sake.

verses.lat: 6:2 Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, * neque in ira tua corrípias me.
verses.eng: 6:2 Lord, rebuke me not in thy indignation, * nor chastise me in thy wrath.

verses.lat: 6:3 Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam infírmus sum: * sana me, Dómine, quóniam conturbáta sunt ossa mea.
verses.eng: 6:3 Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am weak: * heal me, O Lord, for my bones are troubled.

verses.lat: 6:4 Et ánima mea turbáta est valde: * sed tu, Dómine, úsquequo?
verses.eng: 6:4 And my soul is troubled exceedingly: * but thou, O Lord, how long?

verses.lat: 6:5 Convértere, Dómine, et éripe ánimam meam: * salvum me fac propter misericórdiam tuam.
verses.eng: 6:5 Turn to me, O Lord, and deliver my soul: * O save me for thy mercy’s sake.

verses.lat: 6:6 Quóniam non est in morte qui memor sit tui: * in inférno autem quis confitébitur tibi?
verses.eng: 6:6 For there is no one in death, that is mindful of thee: * and who shall confess to thee in hell?

verses.lat: 6:7 Laborávi in gémitu meo, † lavábo per síngulas noctes lectum meum: * lácrimis meis stratum meum rigábo.
verses.eng: 6:7 I have laboured in my groanings, † every night I will wash my bed: * I will water my couch with my tears.

verses.lat: 6:8 Turbátus est a furóre óculus meus: * inveterávi inter omnes inimícos meos.
verses.eng: 6:8 My eye is troubled through indignation: * I have grown old amongst all my enemies.

verses.lat: 6:9 Discédite a me, omnes, qui operámini iniquitátem: * quóniam exaudívit Dóminus vocem fletus mei.
verses.eng: 6:9 Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity: * for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.lat: 6:10 Exaudívit Dóminus deprecatiónem meam, * Dóminus oratiónem meam suscépit.
verses.eng: 6:10 The Lord hath heard my supplication: * the Lord hath received my prayer.

verses.lat: 6:11 Erubéscant, et conturbéntur veheménter omnes inimíci mei: * convertántur et erubéscant valde velóciter.
verses.eng: 6:11 Let all my enemies be ashamed, and be very much troubled: * let them be turned back, and be ashamed very speedily.

verses.lat: 7:2 Dómine, Deus meus, in te sperávi: * salvum me fac ex ómnibus persequéntibus me, et líbera me.
verses.eng: 7:2 O Lord my God, in thee have I put my trust: * save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me.

verses.lat: 7:3 Nequándo rápiat ut leo ánimam meam, * dum non est qui rédimat, neque qui salvum fáciat.
verses.eng: 7:3 Lest at any time he seize upon my soul like a lion, * while there is no one to redeem me, nor to save.

verses.lat: 7:4 Dómine, Deus meus, si feci istud, * si est iníquitas in mánibus meis:
verses.eng: 7:4 O Lord my God, if I have done this thing, * if there be iniquity in my hands:

verses.lat: 7:5 Si réddidi retribuéntibus mihi mala, * décidam mérito ab inimícis meis inánis.
verses.eng: 7:5 If I have rendered to them that repaid me evils, * let me deservedly fall empty before my enemies.

verses.lat: 7:6 Persequátur inimícus ánimam meam, † et comprehéndat, et concúlcet in terra vitam meam, * et glóriam meam in púlverem dedúcat.
verses.eng: 7:6 Let the enemy pursue my soul, † and take it, and tread down my life on the earth, * and bring down my glory to the dust.

verses.lat: 7:7a Exsúrge, Dómine, in ira tua: * et exaltáre in fínibus inimicórum meórum.
verses.eng: 7:7a Rise up, O Lord, in thy anger: * and be thou exalted in the borders of my enemies.

verses.lat: 7:7b Et exsúrge, Dómine, Deus meus, in præcépto quod mandásti: * (8a) et synagóga populórum circúmdabit te.
verses.eng: 7:7b And arise, O Lord my God, in the precept which thou hast commanded: * (8a) and a congregation of people shall surround thee.

verses.lat: 7:8b Et propter hanc in altum regrédere: * (9a) Dóminus júdicat pópulos.
verses.eng: 7:8b And for their sakes return thou on high. * (9a) The Lord judgeth the people.

verses.lat: 7:9b Júdica me, Dómine, secúndum justítiam meam, * et secúndum innocéntiam meam super me.
verses.eng: 7:9b Judge me, O Lord, according to my justice, * and according to my innocence in me.

verses.lat: 7:10 Consumétur nequítia peccatórum, et díriges justum, * scrutans corda et renes, Deus.
verses.eng: 7:10 The wickedness of sinners shall be brought to nought: and thou shalt direct the just: * the searcher of hearts and reins is God.

verses.lat: 7:11 Justum adjutórium meum a Dómino, * qui salvos facit rectos corde.
verses.eng: 7:11 Just is my help from the Lord: * who saveth the upright of heart.

verses.lat: 7:12 Deus judex justus, fortis, et pátiens: * numquid iráscitur per síngulos dies?
verses.eng: 7:12 God is a just judge, strong and patient: * is he angry every day?

verses.lat: 7:13 Nisi convérsi fuéritis, gládium suum vibrábit: * arcum suum teténdit, et parávit illum.
verses.eng: 7:13 Except you will be converted, he will brandish his sword: * he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

verses.lat: 7:14 Et in eo parávit vasa mortis: * sagíttas suas ardéntibus effécit.
verses.eng: 7:14 And in it he hath prepared the instruments of death, * he hath made ready his arrows for them that burn.

verses.lat: 7:15 Ecce, partúriit injustítiam: * concépit dolórem, et péperit iniquitátem.
verses.eng: 7:15 Behold he hath been in labour with injustice; * he hath conceived sorrow, and brought forth iniquity.

verses.lat: 7:16 Lacum apéruit, et effódit eum: * et íncidit in fóveam quam fecit.
verses.eng: 7:16 He hath opened a pit and dug it: * and he is fallen into the hole he made.

verses.lat: 7:17 Convertétur dolor ejus in caput ejus: * et in vérticem ipsíus iníquitas ejus descéndet.
verses.eng: 7:17 His sorrow shall be turned on his own head: * and his iniquity shall come down upon his crown.

verses.lat: 7:18 Confitébor Dómino secúndum justítiam ejus: * et psallam nómini Dómini altíssimi.
verses.eng: 7:18 I will give glory to the Lord according to his justice: * and will sing to the name of the Lord the most High.

tertia.capitulum.label: Capitulum
tertia.capitulum.lat: Sana me, Dómine, et sanábor: salvum me fac, et salvus ero: quóniam laus mea tu es.
tertia.capitulum.eng: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed: save me, and I shall be saved, for Thou art my praise.

responsory_breve_tertia.label: Responsory
responsory_breve_tertia.lat:
℟.br. Sana ánimam meam, * quia peccávi tibi.
℣. Ego dixi: Dómine, miserére mei.
℟. Quia peccávi tibi.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Sana ánimam meam, * quia peccávi tibi.
responsory_breve_tertia.eng:
℟.br. Heal my soul, * for I have sinned against Thee.
℣. I said: O Lord, be Thou merciful to me.
℟. For I have sinned against Thee.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Heal my soul, * for I have sinned against Thee.

capitulum_sexta.label: Capitulum
capitulum_sexta.lat: Némini quidquam debeátis, nisi ut ínvicem diligátis: qui enim díligit próximum, legem implévit.
capitulum_sexta.eng: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another. For he that loveth his neighbour, hath fulfilled the law.

responsory_breve_sexta.label: Responsory
responsory_breve_sexta.lat:
℟.br. Benedícam Dóminum * in omni témpore.
℣. Semper laus ejus in ore meo.
℟. In omni témpore.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Benedícam Dóminum * in omni témpore.
responsory_breve_sexta.eng:
℟.br. I will bless the Lord * at all times.
℣. His praise shall be always in my mouth.
℟. At all times.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. I will bless the Lord * at all times.

capitulum_nona.label: Capitulum
capitulum_nona.lat: In timóre incolátus vestri témpore conversámini: sciéntes quod non corruptibílibus auro vel argénto redémpti estis, sed pretióso sánguine quasi Agni immaculáti Christi.
capitulum_nona.eng: Converse in fear during the time of your sojourning here. Knowing that you were not redeemed with corruptible things as gold or silver, but with the precious blood of Christ.

responsory_breve_nona.label: Responsory
responsory_breve_nona.lat:
℟.br. Rédime me, Dómine, * et miserére mei.
℣. Pes enim meus stetit in via recta.
℟. Et miserére mei.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Rédime me, Dómine, * et miserére mei.
responsory_breve_nona.eng:
℟.br. Redeem me, O Lord, * and have mercy on me.
℣. For my feet stood in the right way.
℟. And have mercy on me.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Redeem me, O Lord, * and have mercy on me.

laudes.psalm1.label: Psalmus 46
laudes.psalm1.antiphonEng: All ye nations * shout unto God with the voice of joy.

verses.lat: 46:2 Omnes gentes, pláudite mánibus: * jubiláte Deo in voce exsultatiónis.
verses.eng: 46:2 O clap your hands, all ye nations: * shout unto God with the voice of joy,

verses.lat: 46:3 Quóniam Dóminus excélsus, terríbilis: * Rex magnus super omnem terram.
verses.eng: 46:3 For the Lord is high, terrible: * a great king over all the earth.

verses.lat: 46:4 Subjécit pópulos nobis: * et gentes sub pédibus nostris.
verses.eng: 46:4 He hath subdued the people under us; * and the nations under our feet.

verses.lat: 46:5 Elégit nobis hereditátem suam: * spéciem Jacob, quam diléxit.
verses.eng: 46:5 He hath chosen for us his inheritance, * the beauty of Jacob which he hath loved.

verses.lat: 46:6 Ascéndit Deus in júbilo: * et Dóminus in voce tubæ.
verses.eng: 46:6 God is ascended with jubilee, * and the Lord with the sound of trumpet.

verses.lat: 46:7 Psállite Deo nostro, psállite: * psállite Regi nostro, psállite.
verses.eng: 46:7 Sing praises to our God, sing ye: * sing praises to our king, sing ye.

verses.lat: 46:8 Quóniam Rex omnis terræ Deus: * psállite sapiénter.
verses.eng: 46:8 For God is the king of all the earth: * sing ye wisely.

verses.lat: 46:9 Regnábit Deus super gentes: * Deus sedet super sedem sanctam suam.
verses.eng: 46:9 God shall reign over the nations: * God sitteth on his holy throne.

verses.lat: 46:10 Príncipes populórum congregáti sunt cum Deo Ábraham: * quóniam dii fortes terræ veheménter eleváti sunt.
verses.eng: 46:10 The princes of the people are gathered together, with the God of Abraham: * for the strong gods of the earth are exceedingly exalted.

laudes.antiphon.psalm1.label: Antíphona
laudes.antiphon.psalm1.eng: All ye nations * shout unto God with the voice of joy.

laudes.psalm2.label: Psalmus 5
laudes.psalm2.antiphonLat: Inténde * voci oratiónis meæ, Rex meus et Deus meus.
laudes.psalm2.antiphonEng: Hearken to the voice * of my prayer, O my King and my God.

verses.lat: 5:2 Verba mea áuribus pércipe, Dómine, * intéllege clamórem meum.
verses.eng: 5:2 Give ear, O Lord, to my words * understand my cry.

verses.lat: 5:3 Inténde voci oratiónis meæ, * Rex meus et Deus meus.
verses.eng: 5:3 Hearken to the voice of my prayer, * O my King and my God.

verses.lat: 5:4 Quóniam ad te orábo: * Dómine, mane exáudies vocem meam.
