verses.eng: 56:12 Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: * and thy glory above all the earth.

verses.lat: 57:2 Si vere útique justítiam loquímini: * recta judicáte, fílii hóminum.
verses.eng: 57:2 If in very deed you speak justice: * judge right things, ye sons of men.

verses.lat: 57:3 Étenim in corde iniquitátes operámini: * in terra injustítias manus vestræ concínnant.
verses.eng: 57:3 For in your heart you work iniquity: * your hands forge injustice in the earth.

verses.lat: 57:4 Alienáti sunt peccatóres a vulva, erravérunt ab útero: * locúti sunt falsa.
verses.eng: 57:4 The wicked are alienated from the womb; they have gone astray from the womb: * they have spoken false things.

verses.lat: 57:5 Furor illis secúndum similitúdinem serpéntis: * sicut áspidis surdæ, et obturántis aures suas,
verses.eng: 57:5 Their madness is according to the likeness of a serpent: * like the deaf asp that stoppeth her ears:

verses.lat: 57:6 Quæ non exáudiet vocem incantántium: * et venéfici incantántis sapiénter.
verses.eng: 57:6 Which will not hear the voice of the charmers; * nor of the wizard that charmeth wisely.

verses.lat: 57:7 Deus cónteret dentes eórum in ore ipsórum: * molas leónum confrínget Dóminus.
verses.eng: 57:7 God shall break in pieces their teeth in their mouth: * the Lord shall break the grinders of the lions.

verses.lat: 57:8 Ad níhilum devénient tamquam aqua decúrrens: * inténdit arcum suum donec infirméntur.
verses.eng: 57:8 They shall come to nothing, like water running down; * he hath bent his bow till they be weakened.

verses.lat: 57:9 Sicut cera, quæ fluit, auferéntur: * supercécidit ignis, et non vidérunt solem.
verses.eng: 57:9 Like wax that melteth they shall be taken away: * fire hath fallen on them, and they shall not see the sun.

verses.lat: 57:10 Priúsquam intellégerent spinæ vestræ rhamnum: * sicut vivéntes, sic in ira absórbet eos.
verses.eng: 57:10 Before your thorns could know the brier; he swalloweth them up, * as alive, in his wrath.

verses.lat: 57:11 Lætábitur justus cum víderit vindíctam: * manus suas lavábit in sánguine peccatóris.
verses.eng: 57:11 The just shall rejoice when he shall see the revenge: * he shall wash his hands in the blood of the sinner.

verses.lat: 57:12 Et dicet homo: Si útique est fructus justo: * útique est Deus júdicans eos in terra.
verses.eng: 57:12 And man shall say: If indeed there be fruit to the just: * there is indeed a God that judgeth them on the earth.

ant_nona.label: Antíphona
ant_nona.lat: Deus meus * misericórdia tua prævéniet me.
ant_nona.eng: My God, * his mercy shall prevent me.

verses.lat: 58:2 Éripe me de inimícis meis, Deus meus: * et ab insurgéntibus in me líbera me.
verses.eng: 58:2 Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; * and defend me from them that rise up against me.

verses.lat: 58:3 Éripe me de operántibus iniquitátem: * et de viris sánguinum salva me.
verses.eng: 58:3 Deliver me from them that work iniquity, * and save me from bloody men.

verses.lat: 58:4 Quia ecce cepérunt ánimam meam: * irruérunt in me fortes.
verses.eng: 58:4 For behold they have caught my soul: * the mighty have rushed in upon me:

verses.lat: 58:5 Neque iníquitas mea, neque peccátum meum, Dómine: * sine iniquitáte cucúrri, et diréxi.
verses.eng: 58:5 Neither is it my iniquity, nor my sin, O Lord: * without iniquity have I run, and directed my steps.

verses.lat: 58:6 Exsúrge in occúrsum meum, et vide: * et tu, Dómine, Deus virtútum, Deus Israël,
verses.eng: 58:6 Rise up thou to meet me, and behold: * even thou, O Lord, the God of hosts, the God of Israel.

verses.lat: 58:6 Inténde ad visitándas omnes gentes: * non misereáris ómnibus, qui operántur iniquitátem.
verses.eng: 58:6 Attend to visit all the nations: * have no mercy on all them that work iniquity.

verses.lat: 58:7 Converténtur ad vésperam: et famem patiéntur ut canes, * et circuíbunt civitátem.
verses.eng: 58:7 They shall return at evening, and shall suffer hunger like dogs: * and shall go round about the city.

verses.lat: 58:8 Ecce, loquéntur in ore suo, et gládius in lábiis eórum: * quóniam quis audívit?
verses.eng: 58:8 Behold they shall speak with their mouth, and a sword is in their lips: * for who, say they, hath heard us?

verses.lat: 58:9 Et tu, Dómine, deridébis eos: * ad níhilum dedúces omnes gentes.
verses.eng: 58:9 But thou, O Lord, shalt laugh at them: * thou shalt bring all the nations to nothing.

verses.lat: 58:10 Fortitúdinem meam ad te custódiam, quia, Deus, suscéptor meus es: * Deus meus, misericórdia ejus prævéniet me.
verses.eng: 58:10 I will keep my strength to thee: for thou art my protector: * my God, his mercy shall prevent me.

verses.lat: 58:12 Deus osténdet mihi super inimícos meos, ne occídas eos: * nequándo obliviscántur pópuli mei.
verses.eng: 58:12 God shall let me see over my enemies: slay them not, * lest at any time my people forget.

verses.lat: 58:12 Dispérge illos in virtúte tua: * et depóne eos, protéctor meus, Dómine:
verses.eng: 58:12 And scatter them by thy power; * and bring them down, O Lord, my protector:

verses.lat: 58:13 Delíctum oris eórum, sermónem labiórum ipsórum: * et comprehendántur in supérbia sua.
verses.eng: 58:13 For the sin of their mouth, and the word of their lips: * and let them be taken in their pride.

verses.lat: 58:13 Et de exsecratióne et mendácio annuntiabúntur in consummatióne: * in ira consummatiónis, et non erunt.
verses.eng: 58:13 And for their cursing and lying they shall be talked of, when they are consumed: * when they are consumed by thy wrath, and they shall be no more.

verses.lat: 58:14 Et scient quia Deus dominábitur Jacob: * et fínium terræ.
verses.eng: 58:14 And they shall know that God will rule Jacob, * and all the ends of the earth.

verses.lat: 58:15 Converténtur ad vésperam: et famem patiéntur ut canes, * et circuíbunt civitátem.
verses.eng: 58:15 They shall return at evening and shall suffer hunger like dogs: * and shall go round about the city.

verses.lat: 58:16 Ipsi dispergéntur ad manducándum: * si vero non fúerint saturáti, et murmurábunt.
verses.eng: 58:16 They shall be scattered abroad to eat, * and shall murmur if they be not filled.

verses.lat: 58:17 Ego autem cantábo fortitúdinem tuam: * et exsultábo mane misericórdiam tuam.
verses.eng: 58:17 But I will sing thy strength: * and will extol thy mercy in the morning.

verses.lat: 58:17 Quia factus es suscéptor meus, * et refúgium meum, in die tribulatiónis meæ.
verses.eng: 58:17 For thou art become my support, * and my refuge, in the day of my trouble.

verses.lat: 58:18 Adjútor meus, tibi psallam, quia, Deus, suscéptor meus es: * Deus meus, misericórdia mea.
verses.eng: 58:18 Unto thee, O my helper, will I sing, for thou art God my defence: * my God my mercy.

verses.lat: 59:3 Deus, repulísti nos, et destruxísti nos: * irátus es, et misértus es nobis.
verses.eng: 59:3 God, thou hast cast us off, and hast destroyed us; * thou hast been angry, and hast had mercy on us.

verses.lat: 59:4 Commovísti terram, et conturbásti eam: * sana contritiónes ejus, quia commóta est.
verses.eng: 59:4 Thou hast moved the earth, and hast troubled it: * heal thou the breaches thereof, for it has been moved.

verses.lat: 59:5 Ostendísti pópulo tuo dura: * potásti nos vino compunctiónis.
verses.eng: 59:5 Thou hast shewn thy people hard things; * thou hast made us drink the wine of sorrow.

verses.lat: 59:6 Dedísti metuéntibus te significatiónem: * ut fúgiant a fácie arcus:
verses.eng: 59:6 Thou hast given a warning to them that fear thee: * that they may flee from before the bow:

verses.lat: 59:7 Ut liberéntur dilécti tui: * salvum fac déxtera tua, et exáudi me.
verses.eng: 59:7 That thy beloved may be delivered. * Save me with thy right hand, and hear me.

verses.lat: 59:8 Deus locútus est in sancto suo: * lætábor, et partíbor Síchimam: et convállem tabernaculórum metíbor.
verses.eng: 59:8 God hath spoken in his holy place: * I will rejoice, and I will divide Sichem; and will mete out the vale of tabernacles.

verses.lat: 59:9 Meus est Gálaad, et meus est Manásses: * et Éphraim fortitúdo cápitis mei.
verses.eng: 59:9 Galaad is mine, and Manasses is mine: * and Ephraim is the strength of my head.

verses.lat: 59:9 Juda rex meus: * Moab olla spei meæ.
verses.eng: 59:9 Juda is my king: * Moab is the pot of my hope.

verses.lat: 59:10 In Idumǽam exténdam calceaméntum meum: * mihi alienígenæ súbditi sunt.
verses.eng: 59:10 Into Edom will I stretch out my shoe: * to me the foreigners are made subject.

verses.lat: 59:11 Quis dedúcet me in civitátem munítam? * quis dedúcet me usque in Idumǽam?
verses.eng: 59:11 Who will bring me into the strong city? * who will lead me into Edom?

verses.lat: 59:12 Nonne tu, Deus, qui repulísti nos? * et non egrediéris, Deus, in virtútibus nostris?
verses.eng: 59:12 Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? * and wilt not thou, O God, go out with our armies?

verses.lat: 59:13 Da nobis auxílium de tribulatióne: * quia vana salus hóminis.
verses.eng: 59:13 Give us help from trouble: * for vain is the salvation of man.

verses.lat: 59:14 In Deo faciémus virtútem: * et ipse ad níhilum dedúcet tribulántes nos.
verses.eng: 59:14 Through God we shall do mightily: * and he shall bring to nothing them that afflict us.

completorium.antiphon.label: Antíphona
completorium.antiphon.lat: Immíttet Ángelus Dómini * in circúitu timéntium eum: et erípiet eos.
completorium.antiphon.eng: The angel of the Lord * shall encamp round about them that fear him: and shall deliver them.

verses.lat: 33:2 Benedícam Dóminum in omni témpore: * semper laus ejus in ore meo.
verses.eng: 33:2 I will bless the Lord at all times, * his praise shall be always in my mouth.

verses.lat: 33:3 In Dómino laudábitur ánima mea: * áudiant mansuéti, et læténtur.
verses.eng: 33:3 In the Lord shall my soul be praised: * let the meek hear and rejoice.

verses.lat: 33:4 Magnificáte Dóminum mecum: * et exaltémus nomen ejus in idípsum.
verses.eng: 33:4 O magnify the Lord with me; * and let us extol his name together.

verses.lat: 33:5 Exquisívi Dóminum, et exaudívit me: * et ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus meis erípuit me.
verses.eng: 33:5 I sought the Lord, and he heard me; * and he delivered me from all my troubles.

verses.lat: 33:6 Accédite ad eum, et illuminámini: * et fácies vestræ non confundéntur.
verses.eng: 33:6 Come ye to him and be enlightened: * and your faces shall not be confounded.

verses.lat: 33:7 Iste pauper clamávit, et Dóminus exaudívit eum: * et de ómnibus tribulatiónibus ejus salvávit eum.
verses.eng: 33:7 This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him: * and saved him out of all his troubles.

verses.lat: 33:8 Immíttet Ángelus Dómini in circúitu timéntium eum: * et erípiet eos.
verses.eng: 33:8 The Angel of the Lord shall encamp round about them that fear him: * and shall deliver them.

verses.lat: 33:9 Gustáte, et vidéte quóniam suávis est Dóminus: * beátus vir, qui sperat in eo.
verses.eng: 33:9 O taste, and see that the Lord is sweet: * blessed is the man that hopeth in him.

verses.lat: 33:10 Timéte Dóminum, omnes sancti ejus: * quóniam non est inópia timéntibus eum.
verses.eng: 33:10 Fear the Lord, all ye his saints: * for there is no want to them that fear him.

verses.lat: 33:11 Dívites eguérunt et esuriérunt: * inquiréntes autem Dóminum non minuéntur omni bono.
verses.eng: 33:11 The rich have wanted, and have suffered hunger: * but they that seek the Lord shall not be deprived of any good.

verses.lat: 33:12 Veníte, fílii, audíte me: * timórem Dómini docébo vos.
verses.eng: 33:12 Come, children, hearken to me: * I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

verses.lat: 33:13 Quis est homo qui vult vitam: * díligit dies vidére bonos?
verses.eng: 33:13 Who is the man that desireth life: * who loveth to see good days?

verses.lat: 33:14 Próhibe linguam tuam a malo: * et lábia tua ne loquántur dolum.
verses.eng: 33:14 Keep thy tongue from evil, * and thy lips from speaking guile.

verses.lat: 33:15 Divérte a malo, et fac bonum: * inquíre pacem, et perséquere eam.
verses.eng: 33:15 Turn away from evil and do good: * seek after peace and pursue it.

verses.lat: 33:16 Óculi Dómini super justos: * et aures ejus in preces eórum.
verses.eng: 33:16 The eyes of the Lord are upon the just: * and his ears unto their prayers.

verses.lat: 33:17 Vultus autem Dómini super faciéntes mala: * ut perdat de terra memóriam eórum.
verses.eng: 33:17 But the countenance of the Lord is against them that do evil things: * to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

verses.lat: 33:18 Clamavérunt justi, et Dóminus exaudívit eos: * et ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus eórum liberávit eos.
verses.eng: 33:18 The just cried, and the Lord heard them: * and delivered them out of all their troubles.

verses.lat: 33:19 Juxta est Dóminus iis, qui tribuláto sunt corde: * et húmiles spíritu salvábit.
verses.eng: 33:19 The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a contrite heart: * and he will save the humble of spirit.

verses.lat: 33:20 Multæ tribulatiónes justórum: * et de ómnibus his liberábit eos Dóminus.
verses.eng: 33:20 Many are the afflictions of the just; * but out of them all will the Lord deliver them.

verses.lat: 33:21 Custódit Dóminus ómnia ossa eórum: * unum ex his non conterétur.
verses.eng: 33:21 The Lord keepeth all their bones, * not one of them shall be broken.

verses.lat: 33:22 Mors peccatórum péssima: * et qui odérunt justum, delínquent.
verses.eng: 33:22 The death of the wicked is very evil: * and they that hate the just shall be guilty.

verses.lat: 33:23 Rédimet Dóminus ánimas servórum suórum: * et non delínquent omnes qui sperant in eo.
verses.eng: 33:23 The Lord will redeem the souls of his servants: * and none of them that trust in him shall offend.

verses.lat: 60:2 Exáudi, Deus, deprecatiónem meam: * inténde oratióni meæ.
verses.eng: 60:2 Hear, O God, my supplication: * be attentive to my prayer.

verses.lat: 60:3 A fínibus terræ ad te clamávi: * dum anxiarétur cor meum, in petra exaltásti me.
verses.eng: 60:3 To thee have I cried from the ends of the earth: * when my heart was in anguish, thou hast exalted me on a rock.

verses.lat: 60:4 Deduxísti me, quia factus es spes mea: * turris fortitúdinis a fácie inimíci.
verses.eng: 60:4 Thou hast conducted me; for thou hast been my hope: * a tower of strength against the face of the enemy.

verses.lat: 60:5 Inhabitábo in tabernáculo tuo in sǽcula: * prótegar in velaménto alárum tuárum.
verses.eng: 60:5 In thy tabernacle I shall dwell for ever: * I shall be protected under the covert of thy wings.

verses.lat: 60:6 Quóniam tu, Deus meus, exaudísti oratiónem meam: * dedísti hereditátem timéntibus nomen tuum.
verses.eng: 60:6 For thou, my God, hast heard my prayer: * thou hast given an inheritance to them that fear thy name.

verses.lat: 60:7 Dies super dies regis adícies: * annos ejus usque in diem generatiónis et generatiónis.
verses.eng: 60:7 Thou wilt add days to the days of the king: * his years even to generation and generation.

verses.lat: 60:8 Pérmanet in ætérnum in conspéctu Dei: * misericórdiam et veritátem ejus quis requíret?
verses.eng: 60:8 He abideth for ever in the sight of God: * his mercy and truth who shall search?

verses.lat: 60:9 Sic psalmum dicam nómini tuo in sǽculum sǽculi: * ut reddam vota mea de die in diem.
verses.eng: 60:9 So will I sing a psalm to thy name for ever and ever: * that I may pay my vows from day to day.

tertia.capitulum.label: Capitulum
tertia.capitulum.lat: Sana me, Dómine, et sanábor: salvum me fac, et salvus ero: quóniam laus mea tu es.
tertia.capitulum.eng: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed: save me, and I shall be saved, for Thou art my praise.

responsory_breve_tertia.label: Responsory
responsory_breve_tertia.lat:
℟.br. Sana ánimam meam, * quia peccávi tibi.
℣. Ego dixi: Dómine, miserére mei.
℟. Quia peccávi tibi.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Sana ánimam meam, * quia peccávi tibi.
responsory_breve_tertia.eng:
℟.br. Heal my soul, * for I have sinned against Thee.
℣. I said: O Lord, be Thou merciful to me.
℟. For I have sinned against Thee.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Heal my soul, * for I have sinned against Thee.

capitulum_sexta.label: Capitulum
capitulum_sexta.lat: Némini quidquam debeátis, nisi ut ínvicem diligátis: qui enim díligit próximum, legem implévit.
capitulum_sexta.eng: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another. For he that loveth his neighbour, hath fulfilled the law.

responsory_breve_sexta.label: Responsory
responsory_breve_sexta.lat:
℟.br. Benedícam Dóminum * in omni témpore.
℣. Semper laus ejus in ore meo.
℟. In omni témpore.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Benedícam Dóminum * in omni témpore.
responsory_breve_sexta.eng:
℟.br. I will bless the Lord * at all times.
℣. His praise shall be always in my mouth.
℟. At all times.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. I will bless the Lord * at all times.

capitulum_nona.label: Capitulum
capitulum_nona.lat: In timóre incolátus vestri témpore conversámini: sciéntes quod non corruptibílibus auro vel argénto redémpti estis, sed pretióso sánguine quasi Agni immaculáti Christi.
capitulum_nona.eng: Converse in fear during the time of your sojourning here. Knowing that you were not redeemed with corruptible things as gold or silver, but with the precious blood of Christ.

responsory_breve_nona.label: Responsory
responsory_breve_nona.lat:
℟.br. Rédime me, Dómine, * et miserére mei.
℣. Pes enim meus stetit in via recta.
℟. Et miserére mei.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Rédime me, Dómine, * et miserére mei.
responsory_breve_nona.eng:
℟.br. Redeem me, O Lord, * and have mercy on me.
℣. For my feet stood in the right way.
℟. And have mercy on me.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Redeem me, O Lord, * and have mercy on me.

laudes.psalm1.label: Psalmus 96
laudes.psalm1.antiphonEng: The Lord hath reigned * let the earth rejoice.

verses.lat: 96:1 Dóminus regnávit, exsúltet terra: * læténtur ínsulæ multæ.
verses.eng: 96:1 The Lord hath reigned, let the earth rejoice: * let many islands be glad.

verses.lat: 96:2 Nubes, et calígo in circúitu ejus: * justítia, et judícium corréctio sedis ejus.
verses.eng: 96:2 Clouds and darkness are round about him: * justice and judgment are the establishment of his throne.

verses.lat: 96:3 Ignis ante ipsum præcédet, * et inflammábit in circúitu inimícos ejus.
verses.eng: 96:3 A fire shall go before him, * and shall burn his enemies round about.

verses.lat: 96:4 Illuxérunt fúlgura ejus orbi terræ: * vidit, et commóta est terra.
verses.eng: 96:4 His lightnings have shone forth to the world: * the earth saw and trembled.

verses.lat: 96:5 Montes, sicut cera fluxérunt a fácie Dómini: * a fácie Dómini omnis terra.
verses.eng: 96:5 The mountains melted like wax, at the presence of the Lord: * at the presence of the Lord of all the earth.

verses.lat: 96:6 Annuntiavérunt cæli justítiam ejus: * et vidérunt omnes pópuli glóriam ejus.
verses.eng: 96:6 The heavens declared his justice: * and all people saw his glory.

verses.lat: 96:7 Confundántur omnes, qui adórant sculptília: * et qui gloriántur in simulácris suis.
verses.eng: 96:7 Let them be all confounded that adore graven things, * and that glory in their idols.

verses.lat: 96:7 Adoráte eum, omnes Ángeli ejus: * audívit, et lætáta est Sion.
verses.eng: 96:7 Adore him, all you his angels: * Sion heard, and was glad.

verses.lat: 96:8 Et exsultavérunt fíliæ Judæ, * propter judícia tua, Dómine:
verses.eng: 96:8 And the daughters of Juda rejoiced, * because of thy judgments, O Lord.

verses.lat: 96:9 Quóniam tu Dóminus Altíssimus super omnem terram: * nimis exaltátus es super omnes deos.
verses.eng: 96:9 For thou art the most high Lord over all the earth: * thou art exalted exceedingly above all gods.

verses.lat: 96:10 Qui dilígitis Dóminum, odíte malum: * custódit Dóminus ánimas sanctórum suórum, de manu peccatóris liberábit eos.
verses.eng: 96:10 You that love the Lord, hate evil: * the Lord preserveth the souls of his saints, he will deliver them out of the hand of the sinner.

verses.lat: 96:11 Lux orta est justo, * et rectis corde lætítia.
verses.eng: 96:11 Light is risen to the just, * and joy to the right of heart.

verses.lat: 96:12 Lætámini, justi, in Dómino: * et confitémini memóriæ sanctificatiónis ejus.
verses.eng: 96:12 Rejoice, ye just, in the Lord: * and give praise to the remembrance of his holiness.

laudes.antiphon.psalm1.label: Antíphona
laudes.antiphon.psalm1.eng: The Lord hath reigned * let the earth rejoice.

laudes.psalm2.label: Psalmus 64
laudes.psalm2.antiphonLat: Te decet hymnus, * Deus, in Sion.
laudes.psalm2.antiphonEng: A hymn, O God, * becometh thee in Sion.

verses.lat: 64:2 Te decet hymnus, Deus, in Sion: * et tibi reddétur votum in Jerúsalem.
verses.eng: 64:2 A hymn, O God, becometh thee in Sion: * and a vow shall be paid to thee in Jerusalem.

verses.lat: 64:3 Exáudi oratiónem meam: * ad te omnis caro véniet.
verses.eng: 64:3 O hear my prayer: * all flesh shall come to thee.

verses.lat: 64:4 Verba iniquórum prævaluérunt super nos: * et impietátibus nostris tu propitiáberis.
verses.eng: 64:4 The words of the wicked have prevailed over us: * and thou wilt pardon our transgressions.

verses.lat: 64:5 Beátus, quem elegísti, et assumpsísti: * inhabitábit in átriis tuis.
verses.eng: 64:5 Blessed is he whom thou hast chosen and taken to thee: * he shall dwell in thy courts.

verses.lat: 64:5 Replébimur in bonis domus tuæ: * sanctum est templum tuum, mirábile in æquitáte.
verses.eng: 64:5 We shall be filled with the good things of thy house; holy is thy temple, * wonderful in justice.

verses.lat: 64:6 Exáudi nos, Deus, salutáris noster, * spes ómnium fínium terræ, et in mari longe.
verses.eng: 64:6 Hear us, O God our saviour, * who art the hope of all the ends of the earth, and in the sea afar off.

verses.lat: 64:7 Prǽparans montes in virtúte tua, accínctus poténtia: * qui contúrbas profúndum maris sonum flúctuum ejus.
verses.eng: 64:7 Thou who preparest the mountains by thy strength, being girded with power: * who troublest the depth of the sea, the noise of its waves.

verses.lat: 64:8 Turbabúntur gentes, et timébunt qui hábitant términos a signis tuis: * éxitus matutíni, et véspere delectábis.
verses.eng: 64:8 The Gentiles shall be troubled, and they that dwell in the uttermost borders shall be afraid at thy signs: * thou shalt make the outgoings of the morning and of the evening to be joyful.

verses.lat: 64:10 Visitásti terram, et inebriásti eam: * multiplicásti locupletáre eam.
verses.eng: 64:10 Thou hast visited the earth, and hast plentifully watered it; * thou hast many ways enriched it.

verses.lat: 64:10 Flumen Dei replétum est aquis, parásti cibum illórum: * quóniam ita est præparátio ejus.
verses.eng: 64:10 The river of God is filled with water, thou hast prepared their food; * for so is its preparation.

verses.lat: 64:11 Rivos ejus inébria, multíplica genímina ejus: * in stillicídiis ejus lætábitur gérminans.
verses.eng: 64:11 Fill up plentifully the streams thereof, multiply its fruits; * it shall spring up and rejoice in its showers.

verses.lat: 64:12 Benedíces corónæ anni benignitátis tuæ: * et campi tui replebúntur ubertáte.
verses.eng: 64:12 Thou shalt bless the crown of the year of thy goodness: * and thy fields shall be filled with plenty.

verses.lat: 64:13 Pinguéscent speciósa desérti: * et exsultatióne colles accingéntur.
verses.eng: 64:13 The beautiful places of the wilderness shall grow fat: * and the hills shall be girded about with joy.

verses.lat: 64:14 Indúti sunt aríetes óvium, et valles abundábunt fruménto: * clamábunt, étenim hymnum dicent.
verses.eng: 64:14 The rams of the flock are clothed, and the vales shall abound with corn: * they shall shout, yea they shall sing a hymn.

laudes.antiphon.psalm2.label: Antíphona
laudes.antiphon.psalm2.lat: Te decet hymnus, * Deus, in Sion.
laudes.antiphon.psalm2.eng: A hymn, O God, * becometh thee in Sion.

laudes.psalm3.label: Psalmus 100
laudes.psalm3.antiphonLat: Tibi, Dómine, psallam, * et intéllegam in via immaculáta.
laudes.psalm3.antiphonEng: I shall sing to thee, O Lord * and I shall understand with a perfect heart.

verses.lat: 100:1 Misericórdiam, et judícium * cantábo tibi, Dómine:
verses.eng: 100:1 Mercy and judgment * I will sing to thee, O Lord:

verses.lat: 100:2 Psallam, et intéllegam in via immaculáta, * quando vénies ad me.
verses.eng: 100:2 I will sing, and I will understand in the unspotted way, * when thou shalt come to me.

verses.lat: 100:2 Perambulábam in innocéntia cordis mei, * in médio domus meæ.
verses.eng: 100:2 I walked in the innocence of my heart, * in the midst of my house.

verses.lat: 100:3 Non proponébam ante óculos meos rem injústam: * faciéntes prævaricatiónes odívi.
verses.eng: 100:3 I did not set before my eyes any unjust thing: * I hated the workers of iniquities.

verses.lat: 100:4 Non adhǽsit mihi cor pravum: * declinántem a me malígnum non cognoscébam.
verses.eng: 100:4 The perverse heart did not cleave to me: * and the malignant, that turned aside from me, I would not know.

verses.lat: 100:5 Detrahéntem secréto próximo suo, * hunc persequébar.
verses.eng: 100:5 The man that in private detracted his neighbour, * him did I persecute.

verses.lat: 100:5 Supérbo óculo, et insatiábili corde, * cum hoc non edébam.
verses.eng: 100:5 With him that had a proud eye, and an unsatiable heart, * I would not eat.

verses.lat: 100:6 Óculi mei ad fidéles terræ ut sédeant mecum: * ámbulans in via immaculáta, hic mihi ministrábat.
verses.eng: 100:6 My eyes were upon the faithful of the earth, to sit with me: * the man that walked in the perfect way, he served me.

verses.lat: 100:7 Non habitábit in médio domus meæ qui facit supérbiam: * qui lóquitur iníqua, non diréxit in conspéctu oculórum meórum.
verses.eng: 100:7 He that worketh pride shall not dwell in the midst of my house: * he that speaketh unjust things did not prosper before my eyes.

verses.lat: 100:8 In matutíno interficiébam omnes peccatóres terræ: * ut dispérderem de civitáte Dómini omnes operántes iniquitátem.
verses.eng: 100:8 In the morning I put to death all the wicked of the land: * that I might cut off all the workers of iniquity from the city of the Lord.

laudes.antiphon.psalm3.label: Antíphona
laudes.antiphon.psalm3.lat: Tibi, Dómine, psallam, * et intéllegam in via immaculáta.
laudes.antiphon.psalm3.eng: I shall sing to thee, O Lord * and I shall understand with a perfect heart.

laudes.canticle1.label: Canticum 213
laudes.canticle1.antiphonLat: Dómine, magnus es tu, * et præclárus in virtúte tua.
laudes.canticle1.antiphonEng: O Lord, great art thou * and glorious in thy power.

verses.lat: (Canticum Judith * Judith 16:15-22)
verses.eng: (Canticle of_Judith * Judith 16:15-22)

verses.lat: 16:15 Hymnum cantémus Dómino, * hymnum novum cantémus Deo nostro.
verses.eng: 16:15 Let us sing a hymn to the Lord, * let us sing a new hymn to our God.

verses.lat: 16:16 Adonái, Dómine, magnus es tu, et præclárus in virtúte tua, * et quem superáre nemo potest.
verses.eng: 16:16 O Adonai, Lord, great art thou, and glorious in thy power, * and no one can overcome thee.

verses.lat: 16:17 Tibi sérviat omnis creatúra tua: * quia dixísti, et facta sunt:
verses.eng: 16:17 Let all thy creatures serve thee: * because thou hast spoken, and they were made:

verses.lat: 16:18 Misísti spíritum tuum, et creáta sunt, * et non est qui resístat voci tuæ.
verses.eng: 16:18 Thou didst send forth thy spirit, and they were created, * and there is no one that can resist thy voice.

verses.lat: 16:19 Montes a fundaméntis movebúntur cum aquis: * petræ, sicut cera, liquéscent ante fáciem tuam.
verses.eng: 16:19 The mountains shall be moved from the foundations with the waters: * the rocks shall melt as wax before thy face.

verses.lat: 16:20 Qui autem timent te, * magni erunt apud te per ómnia.
verses.eng: 16:20 But they that fear thee, * shall be great with thee in all things.

verses.lat: 16:21 Væ genti insurgénti super genus meum: Dóminus enim omnípotens vindicábit in eis, * in die judícii visitábit illos.
verses.eng: 16:21 Woe be to the nation that riseth up against my people: for the Lord almighty will take revenge on them, * in the day of judgment he will visit them.

verses.lat: 16:22 Dabit enim ignem, et vermes in carnes eórum, * ut urántur, et séntiant usque in sempitérnum.
verses.eng: 16:22 For he will give fire, and worms into their flesh, * that they may burn, and may feel for ever.

laudes.antiphon.psalm4.label: Antíphona
laudes.antiphon.psalm4.lat: Dómine, magnus es tu, * et præclárus in virtúte tua.
laudes.antiphon.psalm4.eng: O Lord, great art thou * and glorious in thy power.

laudes.psalm4.label: Psalmus 145
laudes.psalm4.antiphonLat: Laudábo Deum meum * in vita mea.
laudes.psalm4.antiphonEng: I shall praise the Lord * in my life.

verses.lat: 145:2a Lauda, ánima mea, Dóminum, † laudábo Dóminum in vita mea: * psallam Deo meo quámdiu fúero.
verses.eng: 145:2a Praise the Lord, O my soul, † in my life I will praise the Lord: * I will sing to my God as long as I shall be.

verses.lat: 145:2b Nolíte confídere in princípibus: * (3) in fíliis hóminum, in quibus non est salus.
verses.eng: 145:2b Put not your trust in princes: * (3) in the children of men, in whom there is no salvation.

verses.lat: 145:4 Exíbit spíritus ejus, et revertétur in terram suam: * in illa die períbunt omnes cogitatiónes eórum.
verses.eng: 145:4 His spirit shall go forth, and he shall return into his earth: * in that day all their thoughts shall perish.

verses.lat: 145:5 Beátus, cujus Deus Jacob adjútor ejus, † spes ejus in Dómino, Deo ipsíus: * (6) qui fecit cælum et terram, mare, et ómnia, quæ in eis sunt.
verses.eng: 145:5 Blessed is he who hath the God of Jacob for his helper, † whose hope is in the Lord his God: * (6) who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all things that are in them.

verses.lat: 145:7a Qui custódit veritátem in sǽculum, † facit judícium injúriam patiéntibus: * dat escam esuriéntibus.
verses.eng: 145:7a Who keepeth truth for ever: † who executeth judgment for them that suffer wrong: * who giveth food to the hungry.

verses.lat: 145:7b Dóminus solvit compedítos: * (8a) Dóminus illúminat cæcos.
verses.eng: 145:7b The Lord looseth them that are fettered: * (8a) the Lord enlighteneth the blind.

verses.lat: 145:8b Dóminus érigit elísos, * Dóminus díligit justos.
verses.eng: 145:8b The Lord lifteth up them that are cast down: * the Lord loveth the just.

verses.lat: 145:9 Dóminus custódit ádvenas, † pupíllum et víduam suscípiet: * et vias peccatórum dispérdet.
verses.eng: 145:9 The Lord keepeth the strangers, † he will support the fatherless and the widow: * and the ways of sinners he will destroy.

verses.lat: 145:10 Regnábit Dóminus in sǽcula, Deus tuus, Sion, * in generatiónem et generatiónem.
verses.eng: 145:10 The Lord shall reign for ever: thy God, O Sion, * unto generation and generation.

laudes.antiphon.psalm5.label: Antíphona
laudes.antiphon.psalm5.lat: Laudábo Deum meum * in vita mea.
laudes.antiphon.psalm5.eng: I shall praise the Lord * in my life.

vesperae.capitulum.label: Capitulum (2 Cor 1:3-4)
vesperae.capitulum.lat: Benedíctus Deus, et Pater Dómini nostri Jesu Christi, Pater misericordiárum, et Deus totíus consolatiónis, qui consolátur nos in omni tribulatióne nostra.
vesperae.capitulum.eng: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort, who comforteth us in all our tribulation.

capitulum_laudes.label: Capitulum (Rom 13:12-13)
capitulum_laudes.lat: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
capitulum_laudes.eng: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

responsory_vespera_1.label: Responsorium Breve
responsory_vespera_1.lat:
R.br. Benedícam Dóminum * In omni témpore.
R. Benedícam Dóminum * In omni témpore.
V. Semper laus ejus in ore meo.
R. In omni témpore.
&Gloria
R. Benedícam Dóminum * In omni témpore.
responsory_vespera_1.eng:
R.br. I will bless the Lord * at all times.
R. I will bless the Lord * at all times.
V. His praise shall be always in my mouth.
R. At all times
&Gloria
R. I will bless the Lord * at all times.

versum_tertia.label: Versiculus
versum_tertia.lat: ℣. Adjútor meus, esto, ne derelínquas me.
versum_tertia.eng: ℣. Be Thou my helper, forsake me not.
versum_tertia.latR: ℟. Neque despícias me, Deus, salutáris meus.
versum_tertia.engR: ℟. Do not Thou despise me, O God my Saviour.

versum_sexta.label: Versiculus
versum_sexta.lat: ℣. Dóminus regit me, et nihil mihi déerit.
versum_sexta.eng: ℣. The Lord ruleth me: and I shall want nothing.
versum_sexta.latR: ℟. In loco páscuæ ibi me collocávit.
versum_sexta.engR: ℟. He hath set me in a place of pasture.

versum_nona.label: Versiculus
versum_nona.lat: ℣. Ab occúltis meis munda me, Dómine.
versum_nona.eng: ℣. From my secret ones cleanse me, O Lord.
versum_nona.latR: ℟. Et ab aliénis parce servo tuo.
versum_nona.engR: ℟. And from those of others spare Thy servant.

ant_1.label: Antíphona
ant_1.lat: Speciósus forma * præ fíliis hóminum, diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
ant_1.eng: Thou art beautiful * above the sons of men: grace is poured abroad in thy lips.

ant_2.label: Antíphona
ant_2.lat: Magnus Dóminus * et laudábilis nimis in civitáte Dei nostri.
ant_2.eng: Great is the Lord * and exceedingly to be praised in the city of our God.

ant_3.label: Antíphona
ant_3.eng: The God of gods, * the Lord hath spoken.

nocturn_1_versum.label: Versicle after Nocturn I
nocturn_1_versum.eng: ℣. The Lord of armies is with us.
nocturn_1_versum.engR: ℟. The God of Jacob is our protector.

nocturn_2_versum.label: Versicle after Nocturn II
nocturn_2_versum.lat: ℣. Deus rédimet ánimam meam de manu ínferi.
nocturn_2_versum.eng: ℣. God will redeem my soul from the hand of hell.

nocturn_3_versum.label: Versicle after Nocturn III
nocturn_3_versum.lat: ℣. Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam.
nocturn_3_versum.eng: ℣. To my hearing thou shalt give joy and gladness.
nocturn_3_versum.engR: ℟. And the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.

verses.lat: Dóminus illuminátio mea et salus mea, quem timébo? Dóminus protéctor vitæ meæ, a quo trepidábo?
verses.eng: The Lord is my light and my salvation, whom shall I fear? The Lord is the protector of my life, of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.lat: Dum apprópiant super me nocéntes, ut edant carnes meas: Qui tríbulant me inimíci mei, ipsi infirmáti sunt et cecidérunt.
verses.eng: Whilst the wicked draw near against me, to eat my flesh: My enemies that trouble me, have themselves been weakened and have fallen.

verses.lat: Si consístant advérsum me castra, non timébit cor meum. Si exsúrgat advérsum me prǽlium, in hoc ego sperábo.
verses.eng: If armies in camp should stand together against me, my heart shall not fear. If a battle should rise up against me, in this will I be confident.

verses.lat: Unam pétii a Dómino, hanc requíram: ut inhábitem in domo Dómini ómnibus diébus vitæ meæ: Ut vídeam voluptátem Dómini, et vísitem templum ejus.
verses.eng: One thing I have asked of the Lord, this will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life. That I may see the delight of the Lord, and may visit His temple.

verses.lat: Quóniam abscóndit me in tabernáculo suo: in die malórum protéxit me in abscóndito tabernáculi sui.
verses.eng: For He hath hidden me in His tabernacle; in the day of evils, He hath protected me in the secret place of His tabernacle.

verses.lat: In petra exaltávit me: et nunc exaltávit caput meum super inimícos meos. Circuívi, et immolávi in tabernáculo ejus hóstiam vociferatiónis: cantábo, et psalmum dicam Dómino.
verses.eng: He hath exalted me upon a rock: and now He hath lifted up my head above my enemies. I have gone round, and have offered up in His tabernacle a sacrifice of jubilation: I will sing, and recite a psalm to the Lord.

verses.lat: Exáudi, Dómine, vocem meam, qua clamávi ad te: miserére mei, et exáudi me.
verses.eng: Hear, O Lord, my voice, with which I have cried to Thee: have mercy on me, and hear me.

verses.lat: Tibi dixit cor meum, exquisívit te fácies mea: fáciem tuam, Dómine, requíram.
verses.eng: My heart hath said to Thee: My face hath sought Thee: Thy face, O Lord, will I still seek.

verses.lat: Ne avértas fáciem tuam a me: ne declínes in ira a servo tuo. Adjútor meus esto: ne derelínquas me, neque despícias me, Deus, salutáris meus.
verses.eng: Turn not away Thy face from me; decline not in Thy wrath from Thy servant. Be Thou my helper, forsake me not; do not Thou despise me, O God my Saviour.

verses.lat: Quóniam pater meus et mater mea dereliquérunt me: Dóminus autem assúmpsit me.
verses.eng: For my father and my mother have left me: but the Lord hath taken me up.

verses.lat: Legem pone mihi, Dómine, in via tua: et dírige me in sémitam rectam propter inimícos meos.
verses.eng: Set me, O Lord, a law in Thy way, and guide me in the right path, because of my enemies.

verses.lat: Ne tradíderis me in ánimas tribulántium me: quóniam insurrexérunt in me testes iníqui, et mentíta est iníquitas sibi.
verses.eng: Deliver me not over to the will of them that trouble me; for unjust witnesses have risen up against me, and iniquity hath lied to itself.

verses.lat: Credo vidére bona Dómini in terra vivéntium.
verses.eng: I believe to see the good things of the Lord in the land of the living.

verses.lat: Exspécta Dóminum, viríliter age: et confortétur cor tuum, et sústine Dóminum.
verses.eng: Expect the Lord, do manfully: and let thy heart take courage, and wait thou for the Lord.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Ad te, Dómine, clamábo, Deus meus, ne síleas a me: nequándo táceas a me, et assimilábor descendéntibus in lacum.
verses.eng: Unto Thee will I cry, O Lord: O my God, be not Thou silent to me: lest if Thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

verses.lat: Exáudi, Dómine, vocem deprecatiónis meæ dum oro ad te: dum extóllo manus meas ad templum sanctum tuum.
verses.eng: Hear, O Lord, the voice of my supplication, when I pray to Thee; when I lift up my hands to Thy holy temple.

verses.lat: Ne simul trahas me cum peccatóribus: et cum operántibus iniquitátem ne perdas me: Qui loquúntur pacem cum próximo suo, mala autem in córdibus eórum.
verses.eng: Draw me not away together with the wicked; and with the workers of iniquity destroy me not: Who speak peace with their neighbour, but evils are in their hearts.

verses.lat: Da illis secúndum ópera eórum, et secúndum nequítiam adinventiónum ipsórum. Secúndum ópera mánuum eórum tríbue illis: redde retributiónem eórum ipsis.
verses.eng: Give them according to their works, and according to the wickedness of their inventions. According to the works of their hands give Thou to them: render to them their reward.

verses.lat: Quóniam non intellexérunt ópera Dómini, et in ópera mánuum ejus: déstrues illos, et non ædificábis eos.
verses.eng: Because they have not understood the works of the Lord, and the operations of His hands: Thou shalt destroy them, and shalt not build them up.

verses.lat: Benedíctus Dóminus: quóniam exaudívit vocem deprecatiónis meæ.
verses.eng: Blessed be the Lord, for He hath heard the voice of my supplication.

verses.lat: Dóminus adjútor meus, et protéctor meus: in ipso sperávit cor meum, et adjútus sum. Et reflóruit caro mea: et ex voluntáte mea confitébor ei.
verses.eng: The Lord is my helper and my protector: in Him hath my heart confided, and I have been helped. And my flesh hath flourished again: and with my will I will give praise to Him.

verses.lat: Dóminus fortitúdo plebis suæ: et protéctor salvatiónum christi sui est.
verses.eng: The Lord is the strength of His people, and the protector of the salvation of His anointed.

verses.lat: Salvum fac pópulum tuum, Dómine, et bénedic hereditáti tuæ: et rege eos, et extólle illos usque in ætérnum.
verses.eng: Save, O Lord, Thy people, and bless Thy inheritance: and rule them, and exalt them for ever.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Exaltábo te, Dómine, quóniam suscepísti me: nec delectásti inimícos meos super me.
verses.eng: I will extol Thee, O Lord, for Thou hast upheld me: and hast not made my enemies to rejoice over me.

verses.lat: Dómine, Deus meus, clamávi ad te, et sanásti me.
verses.eng: O Lord my God, I have cried to Thee, and Thou hast healed me.

verses.lat: Dómine, eduxísti ab inférno ánimam meam: salvásti me a descendéntibus in lacum.
verses.eng: Thou hast brought forth, O Lord, my soul from hell: Thou hast saved me from them that go down into the pit.

verses.lat: Psállite Dómino, sancti ejus: et confitémini memóriæ sanctitátis ejus.
verses.eng: Sing to the Lord, O ye His saints: and give praise to the memory of His holiness.

verses.lat: Quóniam ira in indignatióne ejus: et vita in voluntáte ejus. Ad vésperam demorábitur fletus: et ad matutínum lætítia.
verses.eng: For wrath is in His indignation; and life in His good will. In the evening weeping shall have place, and in the morning gladness.

verses.lat: Ego autem dixi in abundántia mea: Non movébor in ætérnum.
verses.eng: And in my abundance I said: I shall never be moved.

verses.lat: Dómine, in voluntáte tua, præstitísti decóri meo virtútem. Avertísti fáciem tuam a me, et factus sum conturbátus.
verses.eng: O Lord, in Thy favour, Thou gavest strength to my beauty. Thou turnedst away Thy face from me, and I became troubled.

verses.lat: Ad te, Dómine, clamábo: et ad Deum meum deprecábor.
verses.eng: To Thee, O Lord, will I cry: and I will make supplication to my God.

verses.lat: Quæ utílitas in sánguine meo, dum descéndo in corruptiónem? Numquid confitébitur tibi pulvis, aut annuntiábit veritátem tuam?
verses.eng: What profit is there in my blood, whilst I go down to corruption? Shall dust confess to Thee, or declare Thy truth?

verses.lat: Audívit Dóminus, et misértus est mei: Dóminus factus est adjútor meus.
verses.eng: The Lord hath heard, and hath had mercy on me: the Lord became my helper.

verses.lat: Convertísti planctum meum in gáudium mihi: conscidísti saccum meum, et circumdedísti me lætítia:
verses.eng: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into joy: Thou hast cut my sackcloth, and hast compassed me with gladness:

verses.lat: Ut cantet tibi glória mea, et non compúngar: Dómine, Deus meus, in ætérnum confitébor tibi.
verses.eng: To the end that my glory may sing to Thee, and I may not regret: O Lord my God, I will give praise to Thee for ever.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: In te, Dómine, sperávi, non confúndar in ætérnum: in justítia tua líbera me.
verses.eng: In Thee, O Lord, have I hoped, let me never be confounded: deliver me in Thy justice.

verses.lat: Inclína ad me aurem tuam, accélera ut éruas me. Esto mihi in Deum protectórem, et in domum refúgii, ut salvum me fácias.
verses.eng: Bow down Thy ear to me: make haste to deliver me. Be Thou unto me a God, a protector, and a house of refuge, to save me.

verses.lat: Quóniam fortitúdo mea et refúgium meum es tu: et propter nomen tuum dedúces me, et enútries me.
verses.eng: For Thou art my strength and my refuge; and for Thy name's sake Thou wilt lead me and nourish me.

verses.lat: Edúces me de láqueo hoc, quem abscondérunt mihi: quóniam tu es protéctor meus.
verses.eng: Thou wilt bring me out of this snare, which they have hidden for me: for Thou art my protector.

verses.lat: In manus tuas comméndo spíritum meum: redemísti me, Dómine, Deus veritátis.
verses.eng: Into Thy hands I commend my spirit: Thou hast redeemed me, O Lord, the God of truth.

verses.lat: Odísti observántes vanitátes supervácue. Ego autem in Dómino sperávi:
verses.eng: Thou hast hated them that regard vanities to no purpose. But I have hoped in the Lord:

verses.lat: Exsultábo et lætábor in misericórdia tua. Quóniam respexísti humilitátem meam, salvásti de necessitátibus ánimam meam.
verses.eng: I will be glad and rejoice in Thy mercy. For Thou hast regarded my humility, Thou hast saved my soul out of distresses.

verses.lat: Nec conclusísti me in mánibus inimíci: statuísti in loco spatióso pedes meos.
verses.eng: And Thou hast not shut me up in the hands of the enemy: Thou hast set my feet in a spacious place.

verses.lat: Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam tríbulor: conturbátus est in ira óculus meus, ánima mea, et venter meus.
verses.eng: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am afflicted: my eye is troubled with wrath, my soul, and my belly.

verses.lat: Quóniam defécit in dolóre vita mea: et anni mei in gemítibus. Infirmáta est in paupertáte virtus mea: et ossa mea conturbáta sunt.
verses.eng: For my life is wasted with grief: and my years in sighs. My strength is weakened through poverty: and my bones are disturbed.

verses.lat: Super omnes inimícos meos factus sum oppróbrium et vicínis meis valde: et timor notis meis. Qui vidébant me, foras fugérunt a me.
verses.eng: I am become a reproach among all my enemies, and very much to my neighbours: and a fear to my acquaintance. They that saw me without fled from me.

verses.lat: Oblívioni datus sum, tamquam mórtuus a corde. Factus sum tamquam vas pérditum:
verses.eng: I am forgotten as one dead from the heart. I am become as a vessel that is destroyed.

verses.lat: Quóniam audívi vituperatiónem multórum commorántium in circúitu: in eo dum convenírent simul advérsum me, accípere ánimam meam consiliáti sunt.
verses.eng: For I have heard the blame of many that dwell round about: while they assembled together against me, they consulted to take away my life.

verses.lat: Ego autem in te sperávi, Dómine: dixi: Deus meus es tu: in mánibus tuis sortes meæ.
verses.eng: But I have put my trust in Thee, O Lord: I said: Thou art my God. My lots are in Thy hands.

verses.lat: Eripe me de manu inimicórum meórum, et a persequéntibus me.
verses.eng: Deliver me out of the hands of my enemies; and from them that persecute me.

verses.lat: Illústra fáciem tuam super servum tuum, salvum me fac in misericórdia tua: Dómine, non confúndar, quóniam invocávi te.
verses.eng: Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant; save me in Thy mercy. Let me not be confounded, O Lord, for I have called upon Thee.

verses.lat: Erubéscant ímpii, et deducántur in inférnum: muta fiant lábia dolósa.
verses.eng: Let the wicked be ashamed, and be brought down to hell. Let deceitful lips be made dumb.

verses.lat: Quæ loquúntur advérsus justum iniquitátem: in supérbia, et in abusióne.
verses.eng: Which speak iniquity against the just, with pride and abuse.

verses.lat: Quam magna multitúdo dulcédinis tuæ, Dómine, quam abscondísti timéntibus te! Perfecísti eis, qui sperant in te, in conspéctu filiórum hóminum.
verses.eng: O how great is the multitude of Thy sweetness, O Lord, which Thou hast hidden for them that fear Thee! Which Thou hast wrought for them that hope in Thee, in the sight of the sons of men.

verses.lat: Abscóndes eos in abscóndito faciéi tuæ a conturbatióne hóminum. Próteges eos in tabernáculo tuo a contradictióne linguárum.
verses.eng: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of Thy face, from the disturbance of men. Thou shalt protect them in Thy tabernacle from the contradiction of tongues.

verses.lat: Benedíctus Dóminus: quóniam mirificávit misericórdiam suam mihi in civitáte muníta.
verses.eng: Blessed be the Lord, for He hath shown His wonderful mercy to me in a fortified city.

verses.lat: Ego autem dixi in excéssu mentis meæ: Projéctus sum a fácie oculórum tuórum. Ideo exaudísti vocem oratiónis meæ, dum clamárem ad te.
verses.eng: But I said in the excess of my mind: I am cast away from before Thy eyes. Therefore Thou hast heard the voice of my prayer, when I cried to Thee.

verses.lat: Dilígite Dóminum, omnes sancti ejus: quóniam veritátem requíret Dóminus, et retríbuet abundánter faciéntibus supérbiam.
verses.eng: O love the Lord, all ye His saints: for the Lord will require truth, and will repay them abundantly that act proudly.

verses.lat: Viríliter ágite, et confortétur cor vestrum, omnes qui sperátis in Dómino.
verses.eng: Do ye manfully, and let your heart be strengthened, all ye that hope in the Lord.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Júdica, Dómine, nocéntes me, expúgna impugnántes me.
verses.eng: Judge thou, O Lord, them that wrong me: overthrow them that fight against me.

verses.lat: Apprehénde arma et scutum: et exsúrge in adjutórium mihi.
verses.eng: Take hold of arms and shield: and rise up to help me.

verses.lat: Effúnde frámeam, et conclúde advérsus eos qui persequúntur me: dic ánimæ meæ: Salus tua ego sum.
verses.eng: Bring out the sword, and shut up the way against them that persecute me: say to my soul: I am thy salvation.

verses.lat: Confundántur et revereántur, quæréntes ánimam meam. Avertántur retrórsum, et confundántur cogitántes mihi mala.
verses.eng: Let them be confounded and ashamed that seek after my soul. Let them be turned back and be confounded that devise evil against me.

verses.lat: Fiant tamquam pulvis ante fáciem venti: et Ángelus Dómini coárctans eos.
verses.eng: Let them become as dust before the wind: and let the Angel of the Lord straiten them.

verses.lat: Fiat via illórum ténebræ et lúbricum: et Ángelus Dómini pérsequens eos.
verses.eng: Let their way become dark and slippery: and let the Angel of the Lord pursue them.

verses.lat: Quóniam gratis abscondérunt mihi intéritum láquei sui: supervácue exprobravérunt ánimam meam.
verses.eng: For without cause they have hidden their net for me unto destruction: without cause they have upbraided my soul.

verses.lat: Véniat illi láqueus quem ignórat: et cáptio quam abscóndit, apprehéndat eum: et in láqueum cadat in ipsum.
verses.eng: Let the snare which he knoweth not come upon him: and let the net which he hath hidden catch him: and into that very snare let him fall.

verses.lat: Ánima autem mea exsultábit in Dómino: et delectábitur super salutári suo.
verses.eng: But my soul shall rejoice in the Lord; and shall be delighted in His salvation.

verses.lat: Ómnia ossa mea dicent: Dómine, quis símilis tibi? Erípiens ínopem de manu fortiórum ejus: egénum et páuperem a diripiéntibus eum.
verses.eng: All my bones shall say: Lord, who is like to Thee? Who deliverest the poor from the hand of them that are stronger than he; the needy and the poor from them that strip him.

verses.lat: Surgéntes testes iníqui, quæ ignorábam interrogábant me.
verses.eng: Unjust witnesses rising up, asked me things I knew not.

verses.lat: Retribuébant mihi mala pro bonis: sterilitátem ánimæ meæ.
verses.eng: They repaid me evil for good: to the depriving me of my soul.

verses.lat: Ego autem, cum mihi molésti essent, induébar cilício. Humiliábam in jejúnio ánimam meam: et orátio mea in sinu meo convertétur.
verses.eng: But as for me, when they were troublesome to me, I was clothed with haircloth. I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer shall be turned into my bosom.

verses.lat: Quasi próximum, et quasi fratrem nostrum sic compla­cébam: quasi lugens et contristátus sic humiliábar.
verses.eng: As a neighbour, and as an own brother, so did I please: as one mourning and sorrowful so was I humbled.

verses.lat: Et advérsum me lætáti sunt, et convenérunt: congregáta sunt super me flagélla, et ignorávi.
verses.eng: But they rejoiced against me, and came together: scourges were gathered together upon me, and I knew not.

verses.lat: Dissipáti sunt, nec compúncti, tentavérunt me, subsannavérunt me subsannatióne: fremuérunt super me déntibus suis.
verses.eng: They were separated, and repented not: they tempted me, they scoffed at me with scorn: they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

verses.lat: Dómine, quando respícies? Restítue ánimam meam a malignitáte eórum, a leónibus únicam meam.
verses.eng: Lord, when wilt Thou look upon me? Rescue my soul from their malice: my only one from the lions.

verses.lat: Confitébor tibi in ecclésia magna, in pópulo gravi laudábo te.
verses.eng: I will give thanks to Thee in a great church; I will praise Thee in a strong people.

verses.lat: Non supergáudeant mihi qui adversántur mihi iníque: qui odérunt me gratis et ánnuunt óculis.
verses.eng: Let not them that are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: who have hated me without cause, and wink with the eyes.

verses.lat: Quóniam mihi quidem pacífice loquebántur: et in iracúndia terræ loquéntes, dolos cogitábant.
verses.eng: For they spoke indeed peaceably to me; and speaking in the anger of the earth they devised guile.

verses.lat: Et dilatavérunt super me os suum: dixérunt: Euge, euge, vidérunt óculi nostri.
verses.eng: And they opened their mouth wide against me; they said: Well done, well done, our eyes have seen it.

verses.lat: Vidísti, Dómine, ne síleas: Dómine, ne discédas a me.
verses.eng: Thou hast seen, O Lord, be not Thou silent: O Lord, depart not from me.

verses.lat: Exsúrge et inténde judício meo: Deus meus, et Dóminus meus, in causam meam.
verses.eng: Arise, and be attentive to my judgment: to my cause, my God, and my Lord.

verses.lat: Júdica me secúndum justítiam tuam, Dómine, Deus meus, et non supergáudeant mihi.
verses.eng: Judge me, O Lord my God, according to Thy justice, and let them not rejoice over me.

verses.lat: Non dicant in córdibus suis: Euge, euge, ánimæ nostræ: nec dicant: Devorávimus eum.
verses.eng: Let them not say in their hearts: It is well, it is well, to our mind: neither let them say: We have swallowed him up.

verses.lat: Erubéscant et revereántur simul, qui gratulántur malis meis. Induántur confusióne et reveréntia, qui magna loquúntur super me.
verses.eng: Let them blush and be ashamed together, who rejoice at my evils. Let them be clothed with confusion and shame, who speak great things against me.

verses.lat: Exsúltent et læténtur qui volunt justítiam meam: et dicant semper: Magnificétur Dóminus, qui volunt pacem servi ejus.
verses.eng: Let them rejoice and be glad, who are well pleased with my justice, and let them say always: The Lord be magnified, who delights in the peace of His servant.

verses.lat: Et lingua mea meditábitur justítiam tuam, tota die laudem tuam.
verses.eng: And my tongue shall meditate Thy justice, Thy praise all the day long.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Noli æmulári in malignántibus: neque zeláveris faciéntes iniquitátem.
verses.eng: Be not emulous of evildoers; nor envy them that work iniquity.

verses.lat: Quóniam tamquam fænum velóciter aréscent: et quemádmodum ólera herbárum cito décident.
verses.eng: For they shall shortly wither away as grass, and as the green herbs shall quickly fall.

verses.lat: Spera in Dómino, et fac bonitátem: et inhábita terram, et pascéris in divítiis ejus.
verses.eng: Trust in the Lord, and do good, and dwell in the land, and thou shalt be fed with its riches.

verses.lat: Delectáre in Dómino: et dabit tibi petitiónes cordis tui.
verses.eng: Delight in the Lord, and He will give thee the requests of thy heart.

verses.lat: Revéla Dómino viam tuam, et spera in eo: et ipse fáciet.
verses.eng: Commit thy way to the Lord, and trust in Him, and He will do it.

verses.lat: Et edúcet quasi lumen justítiam tuam: et judícium tuum tamquam merídiem: súbditus esto Dómino, et ora eum.
verses.eng: And He will bring forth thy justice as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday. Be subject to the Lord and pray to Him.

verses.lat: Noli æmulári in eo, qui prosperátur in via sua: in hómine faciénte injustítias.
verses.eng: Envy not the man who prospereth in his way; the man who doth unjust things.

verses.lat: Désine ab ira, et derelínque furórem: noli æmulári ut malignéris.
verses.eng: Cease from anger, and leave rage; have no emulation to do evil.

verses.lat: Quóniam qui malignántur, exterminabúntur: sustinéntes autem Dóminum, ipsi hereditábunt terram.
verses.eng: For evildoers shall be cut off: but they that wait upon the Lord shall inherit the land.

verses.lat: Et adhuc pusíllum, et non erit peccátor: et quæres locum ejus, et non invénies.
verses.eng: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: and thou shalt seek his place, and shalt not find it.

verses.lat: Mansuéti autem hereditábunt terram: et delectabúntur in multitúdine pacis.
verses.eng: But the meek shall inherit the land, and shall delight in abundance of peace.

verses.lat: Observábit peccátor justum: et stridébit super eum déntibus suis.
verses.eng: The sinner shall watch the just man: and shall gnash upon him with his teeth.

verses.lat: Dóminus autem irridébit eum: quóniam próspicit quod véniet dies ejus.
verses.eng: But the Lord shall laugh at him: for He foreseeth that his day shall come.

verses.lat: Gládium evaginavérunt peccatóres: intendérunt arcum suum, Ut dejíciant páuperem et ínopem: ut trucídent rectos corde.
verses.eng: The wicked have drawn out the sword: they have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill the upright of heart.

verses.lat: Gládius eórum intret in corda ipsórum: et arcus eórum confringátur.
verses.eng: Let their sword enter into their own hearts, and let their bow be broken.

verses.lat: Mélius est módicum justo, super divítias peccatórum multas.
verses.eng: Better is a little to the just, than the great riches of the wicked.

verses.lat: Quóniam bráchia peccatórum conteréntur: confírmat autem justos Dóminus.
verses.eng: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken in pieces; but the Lord strengtheneth the just.

verses.lat: Novit Dóminus dies immaculatórum: et heréditas eórum in ætérnum erit.
verses.eng: The Lord knoweth the days of the undefiled; and their inheritance shall be for ever.

verses.lat: Non confundéntur in témpore malo, et in diébus famis saturabúntur: quia peccatóres períbunt.
verses.eng: They shall not be confounded in the evil time; and in the days of famine they shall be filled: because the wicked shall perish.

verses.lat: Inimíci vero Dómini, mox ut honorificáti fúerint et exaltáti: deficiéntes, quemádmodum fumus defícient.
verses.eng: But the enemies of the Lord, presently after they shall be honoured and exalted, shall come to nothing and vanish like smoke.

verses.lat: Mutuábitur peccátor, et non solvet: justus autem miserétur et tríbuet.
verses.eng: The sinner shall borrow, and not pay again; but the just showeth mercy and shall give.

verses.lat: Quia benedicéntes ei hereditábunt terram: maledicéntes autem ei disperíbunt.
verses.eng: For such as bless Him shall inherit the land: but such as curse Him shall perish.

verses.lat: Apud Dóminum gressus hóminis dirigéntur: et viam ejus volet.
verses.eng: The steps of a man shall be directed by the Lord: and He shall like well his way.

verses.lat: Cum cecíderit, non collidétur: quia Dóminus suppónit manum suam.
verses.eng: When he shall fall he shall not be bruised, for the Lord putteth His hand under him.

verses.lat: Júnior fui, étenim sénui: et non vidi justum derelíctum, nec semen ejus quærens panem.
verses.eng: I have been young, and now am old; and I have not seen the just forsaken, nor his seed seeking bread.

verses.lat: Tota die miserétur et cómmodat: et semen illíus in benedictióne erit.
verses.eng: He showeth mercy, and lendeth all the day long; and his seed shall be in blessing.

verses.lat: Declína a malo, et fac bonum: et inhábita in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: Decline from evil and do good, and dwell for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Quia Dóminus amat judícium, et non derelínquet sanctos suos: in ætérnum conservabúntur. Injústi puniéntur: et semen impiórum períbit.
verses.eng: For the Lord loveth judgment, and will not forsake His saints: they shall be preserved for ever. The unjust shall be punished, and the seed of the wicked shall perish.

verses.lat: Justi autem hereditábunt terram: et inhabitábunt in sǽculum sǽculi super eam.
verses.eng: But the just shall inherit the land, and shall dwell therein for evermore.

verses.lat: Os justi meditábitur sapiéntiam: et lingua ejus loquétur judícium.
verses.eng: The mouth of the just shall meditate wisdom: and his tongue shall speak judgment.

verses.lat: Lex Dei ejus in corde ipsíus: et non supplantabúntur gressus ejus.
verses.eng: The law of his God is in his heart, and his steps shall not be supplanted.

verses.lat: Consíderat peccátor justum: et quærit mortificáre eum.
verses.eng: The wicked watcheth the just man, and seeketh to put him to death.

verses.lat: Dóminus autem non derelínquet eum in mánibus ejus: nec damnábit eum cum judicábitur illi.
verses.eng: But the Lord will not leave him in his hands; nor condemn him when he shall be judged.

verses.lat: Exspécta Dóminum, et custódi viam ejus: et exaltábit te ut hereditáte cápias terram: cum períerint peccatóres, vidébis.
verses.eng: Expect the Lord and keep His way: and He will exalt thee to inherit the land: when the sinners shall perish thou shalt see.

verses.lat: Vidi ímpium superexaltátum, et elevátum sicut cedros Líbani.
verses.eng: I have seen the wicked highly exalted, and lifted up like the cedars of Libanus.

verses.lat: Et transívi, et ecce non erat: et quæsívi eum, et non est invéntus locus ejus.
verses.eng: And I passed by, and lo, he was not: and I sought him and his place was not found.

verses.lat: Custódi innocéntiam, et vide æquitátem: quóniam sunt relíquiæ hómini pacífico.
verses.eng: Keep innocence, and behold justice: for there are remnants for the peaceable man.

verses.lat: Injústi autem disperíbunt simul: relíquiæ impiórum interíbunt.
verses.eng: But the unjust shall be destroyed together: the remnants of the wicked shall perish.

verses.lat: Salus autem justórum a Dómino: et protéctor eórum in témpore tribulatiónis.
verses.eng: But the salvation of the just is from the Lord, and He is their protector in the time of trouble.

verses.lat: Et adjuvábit eos Dóminus, et liberábit eos: et éruet eos a peccatóribus, et salvábit eos: quia speravérunt in eo.
verses.eng: And the Lord will help them and deliver them: and He will rescue them from the wicked, and save them, because they have hoped in Him.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, neque in ira tua corrípias me.
verses.eng: O Lord, rebuke me not in Thy indignation, nor chastise me in Thy wrath.

verses.lat: Quóniam sagíttæ tuæ infíxæ sunt mihi: et confirmásti super me manum tuam.
verses.eng: For Thy arrows are fastened in me: and Thy hand hath been strong upon me.

verses.lat: Non est sánitas in carne mea a fácie iræ tuæ: non est pax óssibus meis a fácie peccatórum meórum.
verses.eng: There is no health in my flesh, because of Thy wrath: there is no peace for my bones, because of my sins.

verses.lat: Quóniam iniquitátes meæ supergréssæ sunt caput meum: et sicut onus grave gravátæ sunt super me.
verses.eng: For my iniquities are gone over my head: and as a heavy burden are become heavy upon me.

verses.lat: Putruérunt et corrúptæ sunt cicatríces meæ, a fácie insipiéntiæ meæ.
verses.eng: My sores are putrified and corrupted, because of my foolishness.

verses.lat: Miser factus sum, et curvátus sum usque in finem: tota die contristátus ingrediébar.
verses.eng: I am become miserable, and am bowed down even to the end: I walked sorrowful all the day long.

verses.lat: Quóniam lumbi mei impléti sunt illusiónibus: et non est sánitas in carne mea.
verses.eng: For my loins are filled with illusions; and there is no health in my flesh.

verses.lat: Afflíctus sum, et humiliátus sum nimis: rugiébam a gémitu cordis mei.
verses.eng: I am afflicted and humbled exceedingly: I roared with the groaning of my heart.

verses.lat: Dómine, ante te omne desidérium meum: et gémitus meus a te non est abscónditus.
verses.eng: Lord, all my desire is before Thee, and my groaning is not hidden from Thee.

verses.lat: Cor meum conturbátum est, derelíquit me virtus mea: et lumen oculórum meórum, et ipsum non est mecum.
verses.eng: My heart is troubled, my strength hath left me, and the light of my eyes itself is not with me.

verses.lat: Amíci mei et próximi mei advérsum me appropinquavérunt, et stetérunt. Et qui juxta me erant, de longe stetérunt: et vim faciébant qui quærébant ánimam meam.
verses.eng: My friends and my neighbours have drawn near, and stood against me. And they that were near me stood afar off: and they that sought my soul used violence.

verses.lat: Et qui inquirébant mala mihi, locúti sunt vanitátes: et dolos tota die meditabántur.
verses.eng: And they that sought evils to me spoke vain things, and studied deceits all the day long.

verses.lat: Ego autem tamquam surdus non audiébam: et sicut mutus non apériens os suum.
verses.eng: But I, as a deaf man, heard not: and as a dumb man not opening his mouth.

verses.lat: Et factus sum sicut homo non áudiens: et non habens in ore suo redargutiónes.
verses.eng: And I became as a man that heareth not: and that hath no reproofs in his mouth.

verses.lat: Quóniam in te, Dómine, sperávi: tu exáudies, Dómine, Deus meus.
verses.eng: For in Thee, O Lord, have I hoped: Thou wilt hear me, O Lord my God.

verses.lat: Quia dixi: Nequándo supergáudeant mihi inimíci mei: et dum commovéntur pedes mei, super me magna locúti sunt.
verses.eng: For I said: Lest at any time my enemies rejoice over me: and whilst my feet are moved, they speak great things against me.

verses.lat: Quóniam ego in flagélla parátus sum: et dolor meus in conspéctu meo semper.
verses.eng: For I am ready for scourges: and my sorrow is continually before me.

verses.lat: Quóniam iniquitátem meam annuntiábo: et cogitábo pro peccáto meo.
verses.eng: For I will declare my iniquity: and I will think for my sin.

verses.lat: Inimíci autem mei vivunt, et confirmáti sunt super me: et multiplicáti sunt qui odérunt me iníque.
verses.eng: But my enemies live, and are stronger than I: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

verses.lat: Qui retríbuunt mala pro bonis, detrahébant mihi: quóniam sequébar bonitátem.
verses.eng: They that render evil for good, have detracted me, because I followed goodness.

verses.lat: Ne derelínquas me, Dómine, Deus meus: ne discésseris a me.
verses.eng: Forsake me not, O Lord my God: do not Thou depart from me.

verses.lat: Inténde in adjutórium meum, Dómine, Deus salútis meæ.
verses.eng: Attend unto my help, O Lord, the God of my salvation.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Dixi: Custódiam vias meas: ut non delínquam in lingua mea. Pósui ori meo custódiam, cum consísteret peccátor advérsum me.
verses.eng: I said: I will take heed to my ways: that I sin not with my tongue. I set a guard to my mouth, when the sinner stood against me.

verses.lat: Obmútui, et humiliátus sum, et sílui a bonis: et dolor meus renovátus est.
verses.eng: I was dumb, and was humbled, and kept silence from good things: and my sorrow was renewed.

verses.lat: Concáluit cor meum intra me: et in meditatióne mea exardéscet ignis.
verses.eng: My heart grew hot within me: and in my meditation a fire shall flame out.

verses.lat: Locútus sum in lingua mea: Notum fac mihi, Dómine, finem meum. Et númerum diérum meórum quis est: ut sciam quid desit mihi.
verses.eng: I spoke with my tongue: O Lord, make me know my end. And what is the number of my days: that I may know what is wanting to me.

verses.lat: Ecce mensurábiles posuísti dies meos: et substántia mea tamquam níhilum ante te. Verúmtamen univérsa vánitas, omnis homo vivens.
verses.eng: Behold Thou hast made my days measurable: and my substance is as nothing before Thee. And indeed all things are vanity: every man living.

verses.lat: Verúmtamen in imágine pertránsit homo: sed et frustra conturbátur. Thesaurízat: et ignórat cui congregábit ea.
verses.eng: Surely man passeth as an image: yea, and he is disquieted in vain. He storeth up: and he knoweth not for whom he shall gather these things.

verses.lat: Et nunc quæ est exspectátio mea? nonne Dóminus? et substántia mea apud te est.
verses.eng: And now what is my hope? Is it not the Lord? And my substance is with Thee.

verses.lat: Ab ómnibus iniquitátibus meis érue me: oppróbrium insipiénti dedísti me.
verses.eng: Deliver Thou me from all my iniquities: Thou hast made me a reproach to the fool.

verses.lat: Obmútui, et non apérui os meum, quóniam tu fecísti: ámove a me plagas tuas.
verses.eng: I was dumb, and I opened not my mouth, because Thou hast done it. Remove Thy scourges from me.

verses.lat: A fortitúdine manus tuæ ego deféci in increpatió­nibus: propter iniquitátem corripuísti hóminem. Et tabéscere fecísti sicut aráneam ánimam ejus: verúmtamen vane conturbátur omnis homo.
verses.eng: The strength of Thy hand hath made me faint in rebukes: Thou hast corrected man for iniquity. And Thou hast made his soul to waste away like a spider: surely in vain is any man disquieted.

verses.lat: Exáudi oratiónem meam, Dómine, et deprecatiónem meam: áuribus pércipe lácrimas meas. Ne síleas: quóniam ádvena ego sum apud te, et peregrínus, sicut omnes patres mei.
verses.eng: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and my supplication: give ear to my tears. Be not silent: for I am a stranger with Thee, and a sojourner as all my fathers were.

verses.lat: Remítte mihi, ut refrígerer priúsquam ábeam, et ámplius non ero.
verses.eng: O forgive me, that I may be refreshed, before I go hence, and be no more.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Beátus qui intéllegit super egénum et páuperem: in die mala liberábit eum Dóminus.
verses.eng: Blessed is he that understandeth concerning the needy and the poor: the Lord will deliver him in the evil day.

verses.lat: Dóminus consérvet eum, et vivíficet eum, et beátum fáciat eum in terra: et non tradat eum in ánimam inimicórum ejus.
verses.eng: The Lord preserve him and give him life, and make him blessed upon the earth: and deliver him not up to the will of his enemies.

verses.lat: Dóminus opem ferat illi super lectum dolóris ejus: univérsum stratum ejus versásti in infirmitáte ejus.
verses.eng: The Lord help him on his bed of sorrow: Thou hast turned all his couch in his sickness.

verses.lat: Ego dixi: Dómine, miserére mei: sana ánimam meam, quia peccávi tibi.
verses.eng: I said: O Lord, be Thou merciful to me: heal my soul, for I have sinned against Thee.

verses.lat: Inimíci mei dixérunt mala mihi: Quando moriétur, et períbit nomen ejus?
verses.eng: My enemies have spoken evils against me: When shall he die, and his name perish?

verses.lat: Et si ingrediebátur ut vidéret, vana loquebátur, cor ejus congregávit iniquitátem sibi. Egredie­bátur foras, et loquebátur in idípsum.
verses.eng: And if he came in to see me, he spoke vain things: his heart gathered together iniquity to itself. He went out and spoke to the same purpose.

verses.lat: Advérsum me susurrábant omnes inimíci mei: advérsum me cogitábant mala mihi.
verses.eng: All my enemies whispered together against me: they devised evils to me.

verses.lat: Verbum iníquum constituérunt advérsum me: Numquid qui dormit non adjíciet ut resúrgat?
verses.eng: They determined against me an unjust word: shall he that sleepeth rise again no more?

verses.lat: Etenim homo pacis meæ, in quo sperávi: qui edébat panes meos, magnificávit super me supplanta­tiónem.
verses.eng: For even the man of my peace, in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, hath greatly supplanted me.

verses.lat: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére mei, et resúscita me: et retríbuam eis.
verses.eng: But Thou, O Lord, have mercy on me, and raise me up again: and I will requite them.

verses.lat: In hoc cognóvi quóniam voluísti me: quóniam non gaudébit inimícus meus super me.
verses.eng: By this I know that Thou hast had a good will for me: because my enemy shall not rejoice over me.

verses.lat: Me autem propter innocéntiam suscepísti: et confirmásti me in conspéctu tuo in ætérnum.
verses.eng: But Thou hast upheld me by reason of my innocence: and hast established me in Thy sight for ever.

verses.lat: Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum. Fiat, fiat.
verses.eng: Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel, from eternity to eternity. So be it. So be it.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

vesperae.psalm1.label: Psalmus 138(1-13)
vesperae.psalm1.antiphonLat: Dómine, * probásti me et cognovísti me.
vesperae.psalm1.antiphonEng: Lord, * thou hast proved me, and known me.

verses.lat: 138:1 Dómine, probásti me, et cognovísti me: * (2) tu cognovísti sessiónem meam, et resurrectiónem meam.
verses.eng: 138:1 Lord, thou hast proved me, and known me: * (2) thou hast known my sitting down, and my rising up.

verses.lat: 138:3 Intellexísti cogitatiónes meas de longe: * sémitam meam, et funículum meum investigásti.
verses.eng: 138:3 Thou hast understood my thoughts afar off: * my path and my life thou hast searched out.

verses.lat: 138:4 Et omnes vias meas prævidísti: * quia non est sermo in lingua mea.
verses.eng: 138:4 And thou hast foreseen all my ways: * for there is no speech on my tongue.

verses.lat: 138:5 Ecce, Dómine, tu cognovísti ómnia novíssima, et antíqua: * tu formásti me, et posuísti super me manum tuam.
verses.eng: 138:5 Behold, O Lord, thou hast known all things, the last and those of old: * thou hast formed me, and hast laid thy hand upon me.

verses.lat: 138:6 Mirábilis facta est sciéntia tua ex me: * confortáta est, et non pótero ad eam.
verses.eng: 138:6 Thy knowledge is become wonderful to me: * it is high, and I cannot reach to it.

verses.lat: 138:7 Quo ibo a spíritu tuo? * et quo a fácie tua fúgiam?
verses.eng: 138:7 Whither shall I go from thy spirit? * or whither shall I flee from thy face?

verses.lat: 138:8 Si ascéndero in cælum, tu illic es: * si descéndero in inférnum, ades.
verses.eng: 138:8 If I ascend into heaven, thou art there: * if I descend into hell, thou art present.

verses.lat: 138:9 Si súmpsero pennas meas dilúculo, * et habitávero in extrémis maris:
verses.eng: 138:9 If I take my wings early in the morning, * and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea:

verses.lat: 138:10 Étenim illuc manus tua dedúcet me: * et tenébit me déxtera tua.
verses.eng: 138:10 Even there also shall thy hand lead me: * and thy right hand shall hold me.

verses.lat: 138:11 Et dixi: Fórsitan ténebræ conculcábunt me: * et nox illuminátio mea in delíciis meis.
verses.eng: 138:11 And I said: Perhaps darkness shall cover me: * and night shall be my light in my pleasures.

verses.lat: 138:12 Quia ténebræ non obscurabúntur a te, † et nox sicut dies illuminábitur: * sicut ténebræ ejus, ita et lumen ejus.
verses.eng: 138:12 But darkness shall not be dark to thee, † and night shall be light as the day: * the darkness thereof, and the light thereof are alike to thee.

verses.lat: 138:13 Quia tu possedísti renes meos: * suscepísti me de útero matris meæ.
verses.eng: 138:13 For thou hast possessed my reins: * thou hast protected me from my mother’s womb.

vesperae.psalm2.label: Psalmus 138(14-24)
vesperae.psalm2.antiphonLat: Mirabília ópera tua, * Dómine, et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.
vesperae.psalm2.antiphonEng: Wonderful are thy works * and my soul knoweth right well.

verses.lat: 138:14 Confitébor tibi quia terribíliter magnificátus es: ‡ mirabília ópera tua, * et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.
verses.eng: 138:14 I will praise thee, for thou art fearfully magnified: ‡ wonderful are thy works, * and my soul knoweth right well.

verses.lat: 138:15 Non est occultátum os meum a te, quod fecísti in occúlto: * et substántia mea in inferióribus terræ.
verses.eng: 138:15 My bone is not hidden from thee, which thou hast made in secret: * and my substance in the lower parts of the earth.

verses.lat: 138:16 Imperféctum meum vidérunt óculi tui, † et in libro tuo omnes scribéntur: * dies formabúntur, et nemo in eis.
verses.eng: 138:16 Thy eyes did see my imperfect being, † and in thy book all shall be written: * days shall be formed, and no one in them.

verses.lat: 138:17 Mihi autem nimis honorificáti sunt amíci tui, Deus: * nimis confortátus est principátus eórum.
verses.eng: 138:17 But to me thy friends, O God, are made exceedingly honourable: * their principality is exceedingly strengthened.

verses.lat: 138:18 Dinumerábo eos, et super arénam multiplicabúntur: * exsurréxi, et adhuc sum tecum.
verses.eng: 138:18 I will number them, and they shall be multiplied above the sand: * I rose up and am still with thee.

verses.lat: 138:19 Si occíderis, Deus, peccatóres: * viri sánguinum, declináte a me:
verses.eng: 138:19 If thou wilt kill the wicked, O God: * ye men of blood, depart from me:

verses.lat: 138:20 Quia dícitis in cogitatióne: * Accípient in vanitáte civitátes tuas.
verses.eng: 138:20 Because you say in thought: * They shall receive thy cities in vain.

verses.lat: 138:21 Nonne qui odérunt te, Dómine, óderam? * et super inimícos tuos tabescébam?
verses.eng: 138:21 Have I not hated them, O Lord, that hated thee: * and pined away because of thy enemies?

verses.lat: 138:22 Perfécto ódio óderam illos: * et inimíci facti sunt mihi.
verses.eng: 138:22 I have hated them with a perfect hatred: * and they are become enemies to me.

verses.lat: 138:23 Proba me, Deus, et scito cor meum: * intérroga me, et cognósce sémitas meas.
verses.eng: 138:23 Prove me, O God, and know my heart: * examine me, and know my paths.

verses.lat: 138:24 Et vide, si via iniquitátis in me est: * et deduc me in via ætérna.
verses.eng: 138:24 And see if there be in me the way of iniquity: * and lead me in the eternal way.

vesperae.psalm3.label: Psalmus 139
