verses.eng: So is this great sea, which stretcheth wide its arms: there are creeping things without number. Creatures little and great:

verses.lat: illic naves pertransíbunt: draco iste, quem formásti ad illudéndum ei.
verses.eng: there the ships shall go. This sea dragon which Thou hast formed to play therein.

verses.lat: Ómnia a te exspéctant ut des illis escam in témpore.
verses.eng: All expect of Thee that Thou give them food in season.

verses.lat: Dante te illis, cólligent: aperiénte te manum tuam, ómnia implebúntur bonitáte.
verses.eng: What Thou givest to them they shall gather up: when Thou openest Thy hand, they shall all be filled with good.

verses.lat: Averténte autem te fáciem, turbabúntur: áuferes spíritum eórum, et defícient, et in púlverem suum reverténtur.
verses.eng: But if Thou turnest away Thy face, they shall be troubled: Thou shalt take away their breath, and they shall fail, and shall return to their dust.

verses.lat: Emíttes spíritum tuum, et creabúntur: et renovábis fáciem terræ.
verses.eng: Thou shalt send forth Thy spirit, and they shall be created: and Thou shalt renew the face of the earth.

verses.lat: Sit glória Dómini in sǽculum: lætábitur Dóminus in opéribus suis.
verses.eng: May the glory of the Lord endure for ever: the Lord shall rejoice in His works.

verses.lat: Qui réspicit terram, et facit eam trémere: qui tangit montes, et fúmigant.
verses.eng: He looketh upon the earth, and maketh it tremble: He toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.

verses.lat: Cantábo Dómino in vita mea: psallam Deo meo quámdiu sum.
verses.eng: I will sing to the Lord as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

verses.lat: Jucúndum sit ei elóquium meum: ego vero delectábor in Dómino.
verses.eng: Let my speech be acceptable to Him: but I will take delight in the Lord.

verses.lat: Defíciant peccatóres a terra, et iníqui ita ut non sint: bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.
verses.eng: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth, and the unjust, so that they be no more: O my soul, bless thou the Lord.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Confitémini Dómino, et invocáte nomen ejus: annuntiáte inter gentes ópera ejus.
verses.eng: Give glory to the Lord, and call upon His name: declare His deeds among the Gentiles.

verses.lat: Cantáte ei, et psállite ei: narráte ómnia mirabília ejus.
verses.eng: Sing to Him, yea sing praises to Him: relate all His wondrous works.

verses.lat: Laudámini in nómine sancto ejus: lætétur cor quæréntium Dóminum.
verses.eng: Glory ye in His holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.

verses.lat: Quǽrite Dóminum et confirmámini: quǽrite fáciem ejus semper.
verses.eng: Seek ye the Lord, and be strengthened: seek His face evermore.

verses.lat: Meméntote mirabílium ejus, quæ fecit: prodígia ejus, et judícia oris ejus.
verses.eng: Remember His marvellous works which He hath done; His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth.

verses.lat: Semen Abraham, servi ejus: fílii Jacob, elécti ejus.
verses.eng: O ye seed of Abraham His servant; ye sons of Jacob His chosen.

verses.lat: Ipse Dóminus Deus noster: in univérsa terra judícia ejus.
verses.eng: He is the Lord our God: His judgments are in all the earth.

verses.lat: Memor fuit in sǽculum testaménti sui: verbi, quod mandávit in mille generatiónes:
verses.eng: He hath remembered His covenant for ever: the word which He commanded to a thousand generations.

verses.lat: Quod dispósuit ad Abraham: et juraménti sui ad Isaac.
verses.eng: Which He made to Abraham: and His oath to Isaac.

verses.lat: Et státuit illud Jacob in præcéptum: et Israël in testaméntum ætérnum:
verses.eng: And He appointed it to Jacob for a law: and to Israel for an everlasting testament:

verses.lat: Dicens: Tibi dabo terram Chánaan: funículum hereditátis vestræ.
verses.eng: Saying: To thee will I give the land of Chanaan, the lot of your inheritance.

verses.lat: Cum essent número brevi, paucíssimi, et íncolæ ejus:
verses.eng: When they were but a small number: yea very few, and sojourners therein.

verses.lat: Et pertransiérunt de gente in gentem, et de regno ad pópulum álterum.
verses.eng: And they passed from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people.

verses.lat: Non relíquit hóminem nocére eis: et corrípuit pro eis reges.
verses.eng: He suffered no man to hurt them: and He reproved kings for their sakes.

verses.lat: Nolíte tangere christos meos: et in prophétis meis nolíte malignári.
verses.eng: Touch ye not My anointed: and do no evil to My prophets.

verses.lat: Et vocávit famem super terram: et omne firmaméntum panis contrívit.
verses.eng: And He called a famine upon the land: and He destroyed all the provision of bread.

verses.lat: Misit ante eos virum: in servum venúndatus est Joseph.
verses.eng: He sent a man before them: Joseph, who was sold for a slave.

verses.lat: Humiliavérunt in compédibus pedes ejus, ferrum pertránsiit ánimam ejus, donec veníret verbum ejus.
verses.eng: They humbled his feet in fetters: the iron pierced his soul, until his word came.

verses.lat: Elóquium Dómini inflammávit eum: misit rex, et sólvit eum: princeps populórum, et dimísit eum.
verses.eng: The word of the Lord inflamed him: the king sent and released him: the ruler of the people, and he set him at liberty.

verses.lat: Constítuit eum dóminum domus suæ: et príncipem omnis possessiónis suæ:
verses.eng: He made him master of his house, and ruler of all his possession.

verses.lat: Ut erudíret príncipes ejus sicut semetípsum: et senes ejus prudéntiam docéret.
verses.eng: That he might instruct his princes as himself, and teach his ancients wisdom.

verses.lat: Et intrávit Israël in Ægýptum: et Jacob áccola fuit in terra Cham.
verses.eng: And Israel went into Egypt: and Jacob was a sojourner in the land of Cham.

verses.lat: Et auxit pópulum suum veheménter: et firmávit eum super inimícos ejus.
verses.eng: And He increased His people exceedingly: and strengthened them over their enemies.

verses.lat: Convértit cor eórum ut odírent pópulum ejus: et dolum fácerent in servos ejus.
verses.eng: He turned their heart to hate His people: and to deal deceitfully with His servants.

verses.lat: Misit Móysen, servum suum: Aaron, quem elégit ipsum.
verses.eng: He sent Moses His servant: Aaron the man whom He had chosen.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Pósuit in eis verba signórum suórum, et prodigiórum in terra Cham.
verses.eng: He gave them power to show His signs, and His wonders in the land of Cham.

verses.lat: Misit ténebras, et obscurávit: et non exacerbávit sermónes suos.
verses.eng: He sent darkness, and made it obscure: and grieved not His words.

verses.lat: Convértit aquas eórum in sánguinem: et occídit pisces eórum.
verses.eng: He turned their waters into blood, and destroyed their fish.

verses.lat: Édidit terra eórum ranas: in penetrálibus regum ipsórum.
verses.eng: Their land brought forth frogs, in the inner chambers of their kings.

verses.lat: Dixit, et venit cœnomýia: et cínifes in ómnibus fínibus eórum.
verses.eng: He spoke, and there came divers sorts of flies and sciniphs in all their coasts.

verses.lat: Pósuit plúvias eórum grándinem: ignem comburéntem in terra ipsórum.
verses.eng: He gave them hail for rain, a burning fire in the land.

verses.lat: Et percússit víneas eórum, et ficúlneas eórum: et contrívit lignum fínium eórum.
verses.eng: And He destroyed their vineyards and their fig trees: and He broke in pieces the trees of their coasts.

verses.lat: Dixit, et venit locústa, et bruchus, cujus non erat númerus:
verses.eng: He spoke, and the locust came, and the bruchus, of which there was no number:

verses.lat: Et comédit omne fænum in terra eórum: et comédit omnem fructum terræ eórum.
verses.eng: And they devoured all the grass in their land, and consumed all the fruit of their ground.

verses.lat: Et percússit omne primogénitum in terra eórum: primítias omnis labóris eórum.
verses.eng: And He slew all the firstborn in their land: the firstfruits of all their labour.

verses.lat: Et edúxit eos cum argénto et auro: et non erat in tríbubus eórum infírmus.
verses.eng: And He brought them out with silver and gold: and there was not among their tribes one that was feeble.

verses.lat: Lætáta est Ægýptus in profectióne eórum: quia incúbuit timor eórum super eos.
verses.eng: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them lay upon them.

verses.lat: Expándit nubem in protectiónem eórum, et ignem ut lucéret eis per noctem.
verses.eng: He spread a cloud for their protection, and fire to give them light in the night.

verses.lat: Petiérunt, et venit cotúrnix: et pane cæli saturávit eos.
verses.eng: They asked, and the quail came: and He filled them with the bread of heaven.

verses.lat: Dirúpit petram, et fluxérunt aquæ: abiérunt in sicco flúmina.
verses.eng: He opened the rock, and waters flowed: rivers ran down in the dry land.

verses.lat: Quóniam memor fuit verbi sancti sui, quod hábuit ad Abraham, púerum suum.
verses.eng: Because He remembered His holy word, which He had spoken to His servant Abraham.

verses.lat: Et edúxit pópulum suum in exsultatióne, et eléctos suos in lætítia.
verses.eng: And He brought forth His people with joy, and His chosen with gladness.

verses.lat: Et dedit illis regiónes géntium: et labóres populórum possedérunt:
verses.eng: And He gave them the lands of the Gentiles: and they possessed the labours of the people:

verses.lat: Ut custódiant justificatiónes ejus, et legem ejus requírant.
verses.eng: That they might observe His justifications, and seek after His law.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Confitémini Dómino, quóniam bonus: quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Give glory to the Lord, for He is good: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Quis loquétur poténtias Dómini: audítas fáciet omnes laudes ejus?
verses.eng: Who shall declare the powers of the Lord? who shall set forth all His praises?

verses.lat: Beáti, qui custódiunt judícium, et fáciunt justítiam in omni témpore.
verses.eng: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and do justice at all times.

verses.lat: Meménto nostri, Dómine, in beneplácito pópuli tui: vísita nos in salutári tuo:
verses.eng: Remember us, O Lord, in the favour of Thy people: visit us with Thy salvation.

verses.lat: Ad vidéndum in bonitáte electórum tuórum, ad lætándum in lætítia gentis tuæ: ut laudéris cum hereditáte tua.
verses.eng: That we may see the good of Thy chosen, that we may rejoice in the joy of Thy nation: that Thou mayst be praised with Thy inheritance.

verses.lat: Peccávimus cum pátribus nostris: injúste égimus, iniquitátem fécimus.
verses.eng: We have sinned with our fathers: we have acted unjustly, we have wrought iniquity.

verses.lat: Patres nostri in Ægýpto non intellexérunt mirabília tua: non fuérunt mémores multitúdinis misericórdiæ tuæ. Et irritavérunt ascendéntes in mare, Mare Rubrum.
verses.eng: Our fathers understood not Thy wonders in Egypt: they remembered not the multitude of Thy mercies. And they provoked to wrath going up to the sea, even the Red Sea.

verses.lat: Et salvávit eos propter nomen suum: ut notam fáceret poténtiam suam.
verses.eng: And He saved them for His own name's sake: that He might make His power known.

verses.lat: Et incrépuit Mare Rubrum, et exsiccátum est: et dedúxit eos in abýssis sicut in desérto.
verses.eng: And He rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up: and He led them through the depths, as in a wilderness.

verses.lat: Et salvávit eos de manu odiéntium: et redémit eos de manu inimíci.
verses.eng: And He saved them from the hand of them that hated them: and He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

verses.lat: Et opéruit aqua tribulántes eos: unus ex eis non remánsit.
verses.eng: And the water covered them that afflicted them: there was not one of them left.

verses.lat: Et credidérunt verbis ejus: et laudavérunt laudem ejus.
verses.eng: And they believed His words: and they sang His praises.

verses.lat: Cito fecérunt, oblíti sunt óperum ejus: et non sustinuérunt consílium ejus.
verses.eng: They soon forgot His works: and they waited not for His counsel.

verses.lat: Et concupiérunt concupiscéntiam in desérto: et tentavérunt Deum in inaquóso.
verses.eng: And they coveted their desire in the desert: and they tempted God in the place without water.

verses.lat: Et dedit eis petitiónem ipsórum: et misit saturitátem in ánimas eórum.
verses.eng: And He gave them their request: and sent fulness into their souls.

verses.lat: Et irritavérunt Móysen in castris: Aaron, sanctum Dómini.
verses.eng: And they provoked Moses in the camp, Aaron the holy one of the Lord.

verses.lat: Apérta est terra, et deglutívit Dathan: et opéruit super congregatiónem Abíron.
verses.eng: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan: and covered the congregation of Abiron.

verses.lat: Et exársit ignis in synagóga eórum: flamma combússit peccatóres.
verses.eng: And a fire was kindled in their congregation: the flame burned the wicked.

verses.lat: Et fecérunt vítulum in Horeb: et adoravérunt scúlptile.
verses.eng: They made also a calf in Horeb: and they adored the graven thing.

verses.lat: Et mutavérunt glóriam suam in similitúdinem vítuli comedéntis fænum.
verses.eng: And they changed their glory into the likeness of a calf that eateth grass.

verses.lat: Oblíti sunt Deum, qui salvávit eos, qui fecit magnália in Ægýpto, mirabília in terra Cham: terribília in Mari Rubro.
verses.eng: They forgot God, who saved them, who had done great things in Egypt, wondrous works in the land of Cham: terrible things in the Red Sea.

verses.lat: Et dixit ut dispérderet eos: si non Móyses, eléctus ejus, stetísset in confractióne in conspéctu ejus: Ut avérteret iram ejus ne dispérderet eos:
verses.eng: And He said that He would destroy them: had not Moses His chosen stood before Him in the breach: To turn away His wrath, lest He should destroy them:

verses.lat: et pro níhilo habuérunt terram desiderá­bilem. Non credidérunt verbo ejus,
verses.eng: and they set at nought the desirable land. They believed not His word,

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: et murmuravérunt in tabernáculis suis: non exaudiérunt vocem Dómini.
verses.eng: and they murmured in their tents: they hearkened not to the voice of the Lord.

verses.lat: Et elevávit manum suam super eos: ut prostérneret eos in desérto:
verses.eng: And He lifted up His hand over them: to overthrow them in the desert:

verses.lat: Et ut dejíceret semen eórum in natiónibus: et dispérgeret eos in regiónibus.
verses.eng: And to cast down their seed among the nations, and to scatter them in the countries.

verses.lat: Et initiáti sunt Beélphegor: et comedérunt sacrifícia mortuórum.
verses.eng: They also were initiated to Beelphegor: and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

verses.lat: Et irritavérunt eum in adinventiónibus suis: et multiplicáta est in eis ruína.
verses.eng: And they provoked Him with their inventions: and destruction was multiplied among them.

verses.lat: Et stetit Phínees, et placávit: et cessávit quassátio.
verses.eng: Then Phinees stood up, and pacified Him: and the slaughter ceased.

verses.lat: Et reputátum est ei in justítiam: in generatiónem et generatiónem usque in sempitérnum.
verses.eng: And it was reputed to him unto justice, to generation and generation for evermore.

verses.lat: Et irritavérunt eum ad Aquas contradictiónis: et vexátus est Móyses propter eos: quia exacerbavérunt spíritum ejus.
verses.eng: They provoked Him also at the waters of contradiction: and Moses was afflicted for their sakes: because they exasperated his spirit.

verses.lat: Et distínxit in lábiis suis: non disperdidérunt gentes, quas dixit Dóminus illis.
verses.eng: And he distinguished with his lips: they did not destroy the nations of which the Lord spoke unto them.

verses.lat: Et commíxti sunt inter gentes, et didicérunt ópera eórum: et serviérunt sculptílibus eórum: et factum est illis in scándalum.
verses.eng: And they were mingled among the heathens, and learned their works: and served their idols, and it became a stumbling block to them.

verses.lat: Et immolavérunt fílios suos et fílias suas dæmóniis.
verses.eng: And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to devils.

verses.lat: Et effudérunt sánguinem innocéntem: sánguinem filiórum suórum et filiárum suárum, quas sacrificavérunt sculptílibus Chánaan. Et infécta est terra in sanguínibus,
verses.eng: And they shed innocent blood: the blood of their sons and of their daughters which they sacrificed to the idols of Chanaan. And the land was polluted with blood,

verses.lat: et contamináta est in opéribus eórum: et fornicáti sunt in adinventiónibus suis.
verses.eng: and was defiled with their works: and they went aside after their own inventions.

verses.lat: Et irátus est furóre Dóminus in pópulum suum: et abominátus est hereditátem suam.
verses.eng: And the Lord was exceedingly angry with His people: and He abhorred His inheritance.

verses.lat: Et trádidit eos in manus géntium: et domináti sunt eórum qui odérunt eos.
verses.eng: And He delivered them into the hands of the nations: and they that hated them had dominion over them.

verses.lat: Et tribulavérunt eos inimíci eórum, et humiliáti sunt sub mánibus eórum: sǽpe liberávit eos.
verses.eng: And their enemies afflicted them, and they were humbled under their hands: many times did He deliver them.

verses.lat: Ipsi autem exacerbavérunt eum in consílio suo: et humiliáti sunt in iniquitátibus suis.
verses.eng: But they provoked Him with their counsel: and they were brought low by their iniquities.

verses.lat: Et vidit cum tribularéntur: et audívit oratiónem eórum.
verses.eng: And He saw when they were in tribulation: and He heard their prayer.

verses.lat: Et memor fuit testaménti sui: et pœnítuit eum secúndum multitúdinem misericórdiæ suæ.
verses.eng: And He was mindful of His covenant: and repented according to the multitude of His mercies.

verses.lat: Et dedit eos in misericórdias in conspéctu ómnium qui céperant eos.
verses.eng: And He gave them unto mercies, in the sight of all those that had made them captives.

verses.lat: Salvos nos fac, Dómine, Deus noster: et cóngrega nos de natiónibus: Ut confiteámur nómini sancto tuo: et gloriémur in laude tua.
verses.eng: Save us, O Lord, our God: and gather us from among the nations: That we may give thanks to Thy holy name, and may glory in Thy praise.

verses.lat: Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum: et dicet omnis pópulus: Fiat, fiat.
verses.eng: Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say: So be it, so be it.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Confitémini Dómino, quóniam bonus: quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Give glory to the Lord, for He is good: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Dicant qui redémpti sunt a Dómino, quos redémit de manu inimíci: et de regiónibus congregávit eos:
verses.eng: Let them say so that have been redeemed by the Lord, whom He hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy: and gathered out of the countries.

verses.lat: A solis ortu et occásu: ab aquilóne et mari.
verses.eng: From the rising and the setting of the sun, from the north and from the sea.

verses.lat: Erravérunt in solitúdine in inaquóso: viam civitátis habitáculi non invenérunt.
verses.eng: They wandered in a wilderness, in a place without water: they found not the way of a city for their habitation.

verses.lat: Esuriéntes et sitiéntes: ánima eórum in ipsis defécit.
verses.eng: They were hungry and thirsty: their soul fainted in them.

verses.lat: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: et de necessitátibus eórum erípuit eos.
verses.eng: And they cried to the Lord in their tribulation: and He delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.lat: Et dedúxit eos in viam rectam: ut irent in civitátem habitatiónis.
verses.eng: And He led them into the right way: that they might go to a city of habitation.

verses.lat: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to Him: and His wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.lat: Quia satiávit ánimam inánem: et ánimam esuriéntem satiávit bonis.
verses.eng: For He hath satisfied the empty soul, and hath filled the hungry soul with good things.

verses.lat: Sedéntes in ténebris et umbra mortis: vinctos in mendicitáte et ferro.
verses.eng: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death: bound in want and in iron.

verses.lat: Quia exacerbavérunt elóquia Dei: et consílium Altíssimi irritavérunt.
verses.eng: Because they had exasperated the words of God: and provoked the counsel of the Most High.

verses.lat: Et humiliátum est in labóribus cor eórum: infirmáti sunt, nec fuit qui adjuváret.
verses.eng: And their heart was humbled with labours: they were weakened, and there was none to help them.

verses.lat: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
verses.eng: Then they cried to the Lord in their affliction: and He delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.lat: Et edúxit eos de ténebris et umbra mortis: et víncula eórum dirúpit.
verses.eng: And He brought them out of darkness, and the shadow of death; and broke their bonds in sunder.

verses.lat: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to Him, and His wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.lat: Quia contrívit portas ǽreas: et vectes férreos confrégit.
verses.eng: Because He hath broken gates of brass, and burst iron bars.

verses.lat: Suscépit eos de via iniquitátis eórum: propter injustítias enim suas humiliáti sunt.
verses.eng: He took them out of the way of their iniquity: for they were brought low for their injustices.

verses.lat: Omnem escam abomináta est ánima eórum: et appropinquavérunt usque ad portas mortis.
verses.eng: Their soul abhorred all manner of meat: and they drew nigh even to the gates of death.

verses.lat: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
verses.eng: And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: and He delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.lat: Misit verbum suum, et sanávit eos: et erípuit eos de interitiónibus eórum.
verses.eng: He sent His word, and healed them: and delivered them from their destructions.

verses.lat: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to Him: and His wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.lat: Et sacrifícent sacrifícium laudis: et annúntient ópera ejus in exsultatióne.
verses.eng: And let them sacrifice the sacrifice of praise: and declare His works with joy.

verses.lat: Qui descéndunt mare in návibus, faciéntes operatiónem in aquis multis.
verses.eng: They that go down to the sea in ships, doing business in the great waters:

verses.lat: Ipsi vidérunt ópera Dómini, et mirabília ejus in profúndo.
verses.eng: These have seen the works of the Lord, and His wonders in the deep.

verses.lat: Dixit, et stetit spíritus procéllæ: et exaltáti sunt fluctus ejus.
verses.eng: He said the word, and there arose a storm of wind: and the waves thereof were lifted up.

verses.lat: Ascéndunt usque ad cælos, et descéndunt usque ad abýssos: ánima eórum in malis tabescébat.
verses.eng: They mount up to the heavens, and they go down to the depths: their soul pined away with evils.

verses.lat: Turbáti sunt, et moti sunt sicut ébrius: et omnis sapiéntia eórum devoráta est.
verses.eng: They were troubled, and reeled like a drunken man; and all their wisdom was swallowed up.

verses.lat: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: et de necessitátibus eórum edúxit eos.
verses.eng: And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: and He brought them out of their distresses.

verses.lat: Et státuit procéllam ejus in auram: et siluérunt fluctus ejus.
verses.eng: And He turned the storm into a breeze: and its waves were still.

verses.lat: Et lætáti sunt quia siluérunt: et dedúxit eos in portum voluntátis eórum.
verses.eng: And they rejoiced because they were still: and He brought them to the haven which they wished for.

verses.lat: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to Him, and His wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.lat: Et exáltent eum in ecclésia plebis: et in cáthedra seniórum laudent eum.
verses.eng: And let them exalt Him in the church of the people: and praise Him in the chair of the ancients.

verses.lat: Pósuit flúmina in desértum: et éxitus aquárum in sitim.
verses.eng: He hath turned rivers into a wilderness: and the sources of waters into dry ground.

verses.lat: Terram fructíferam in salsúginem: a malítia inhabitántium in ea.
verses.eng: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

verses.lat: Pósuit desértum in stagna aquárum: et terram sine aqua in éxitus aquárum.
verses.eng: He hath turned a wilderness into pools of waters, and a dry land into water springs.

verses.lat: Et collocávit illic esuriéntes: et constituérunt civitátem habitatiónis.
verses.eng: And there He placed the hungry; and they made a city for their habitation.

verses.lat: Et seminavérunt agros, et plantavérunt víneas: et fecérunt fructum nativitátis.
verses.eng: And they sowed fields, and planted vineyards: and they yielded fruit of birth.

verses.lat: Et benedíxit eis, et multiplicáti sunt nimis: et juménta eórum non minorávit.
verses.eng: And He blessed them, and they were multiplied exceedingly: and their cattle He diminished not.

verses.lat: Et pauci facti sunt: et vexáti sunt a tribulatióne malórum et dolóre.
verses.eng: Then they were brought to be few: and they were afflicted through the trouble of evils and sorrow.

verses.lat: Effúsa est contémptio super príncipes: et erráre fecit eos in ínvio, et non in via.
verses.eng: Contempt was poured forth upon their princes: and He caused them to wander where there is no passing, and out of the way.

verses.lat: Et adjúvit páuperem de inópia: et pósuit sicut oves famílias.
verses.eng: And He helped the poor out of poverty: and made him families like a flock of sheep.

verses.lat: Vidébunt recti, et lætabúntur: et omnis iníquitas oppilábit os suum.
verses.eng: The just shall see, and shall rejoice, and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

verses.lat: Quis sápiens et custódiet hæc? et intélleget misericórdias Dómini?
verses.eng: Who is wise, and will keep these things: and will understand the mercies of the Lord?

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

vesperae.psalm1.label: Psalmus 143(1-8)
vesperae.psalm1.antiphonLat: Benedíctus Dóminus * suscéptor meus et liberátor meus.
vesperae.psalm1.antiphonEng: Blessed be the Lord * my support, and my deliverer.

verses.lat: 143:1 Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus meus, qui docet manus meas ad prǽlium, * et dígitos meos ad bellum.
verses.eng: 143:1 Blessed be the Lord my God, who teacheth my hands to fight, * and my fingers to war.

verses.lat: 143:2 Misericórdia mea, et refúgium meum: * suscéptor meus, et liberátor meus:
verses.eng: 143:2 My mercy, and my refuge: * my support, and my deliverer:

verses.lat: 143:2 Protéctor meus, et in ipso sperávi: * qui subdit pópulum meum sub me.
verses.eng: 143:2 My protector, and I have hoped in him: * who subdueth my people under me.

verses.lat: 143:3 Dómine, quid est homo, quia innotuísti ei? * aut fílius hóminis, quia réputas eum?
verses.eng: 143:3 Lord, what is man, that thou art made known to him? * or the son of man, that thou makest account of him?

verses.lat: 143:4 Homo vanitáti símilis factus est: * dies ejus sicut umbra prætéreunt.
verses.eng: 143:4 Man is like to vanity: * his days pass away like a shadow.

verses.lat: 143:5 Dómine, inclína cælos tuos, et descénde: * tange montes, et fumigábunt.
verses.eng: 143:5 Lord, bow down thy heavens and descend: * touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

verses.lat: 143:6 Fúlgura coruscatiónem, et dissipábis eos: * emítte sagíttas tuas, et conturbábis eos.
verses.eng: 143:6 Send forth lightning, and thou shalt scatter them: * shoot out thy arrows, and thou shalt trouble them.

verses.lat: 143:7 Emítte manum tuam de alto, éripe me, et líbera me de aquis multis: * de manu filiórum alienórum.
verses.eng: 143:7 Put forth thy hand from on high, take me out, and deliver me from many waters: * from the hand of strange children:

verses.lat: 143:8 Quorum os locútum est vanitátem: * et déxtera eórum, déxtera iniquitátis.
verses.eng: 143:8 Whose mouth hath spoken vanity: * and their right hand is the right hand of iniquity.

vesperae.psalm2.label: Psalmus 143(9-15)
vesperae.psalm2.antiphonLat: Beátus pópulus * cujus Dóminus Deus ejus.
vesperae.psalm2.antiphonEng: Happy is that people * whose God is the Lord.

verses.lat: 143:9 Deus, cánticum novum cantábo tibi: * in psaltério decachórdo psallam tibi.
verses.eng: 143:9 To thee, O God, I will sing a new canticle: * on the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings I will sing praises to thee.

verses.lat: 143:10 Qui das salútem régibus: * qui redemísti David, servum tuum, de gládio malígno: éripe me.
verses.eng: 143:10 Who givest salvation to kings: * who hast redeemed thy servant David from the malicious sword: Deliver me,

verses.lat: 143:11 Et érue me de manu filiórum alienórum, quorum os locútum est vanitátem: * et déxtera eórum, déxtera iniquitátis:
verses.eng: 143:11 And rescue me out of the hand of strange children; whose mouth hath spoken vanity: * and their right hand is the right hand of iniquity:

verses.lat: 143:12 Quorum fílii, sicut novéllæ plantatiónes * in juventúte sua.
verses.eng: 143:12 Whose sons are as new plants * in their youth:

verses.lat: 143:12 Fíliæ eórum compósitæ: * circumornátæ ut similitúdo templi.
verses.eng: 143:12 Their daughters decked out, * adorned round about after the similitude of a temple:

verses.lat: 143:13 Promptuária eórum plena, * eructántia ex hoc in illud.
verses.eng: 143:13 Their storehouses full, * flowing out of this into that.

verses.lat: 143:13 Oves eórum fœtósæ, abundántes in egréssibus suis: * boves eórum crassæ.
verses.eng: 143:13 Their sheep fruitful in young, abounding in their goings forth: * their oxen fat.

verses.lat: 143:14 Non est ruína macériæ, neque tránsitus: * neque clamor in platéis eórum.
verses.eng: 143:14 There is no breach of wall, nor passage, * nor crying out in their streets.

verses.lat: 143:15 Beátum dixérunt pópulum, cui hæc sunt: * beátus pópulus, cujus Dóminus Deus ejus.
verses.eng: 143:15 They have called the people happy, that hath these things: * but happy is that people whose God is the Lord.

vesperae.psalm3.label: Psalmus 144(1-7)
vesperae.psalm3.antiphonLat: Magnus Dóminus * et laudábilis nimis: et magnitúdinis ejus non est finis.
vesperae.psalm3.antiphonEng: For the Lord is great * and exceedingly to be praised: His greatness has no end.

verses.lat: 144:1 Exaltábo te, Deus meus, rex: * et benedícam nómini tuo in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: 144:1 I will extol thee, O God my king: * and I will bless thy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

verses.lat: 144:2 Per síngulos dies benedícam tibi: * et laudábo nomen tuum in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: 144:2 Every day will I bless thee: * and I will praise thy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

verses.lat: 144:3 Magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis: * et magnitúdinis ejus non est finis.
verses.eng: 144:3 Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: * and of his greatness there is no end.

verses.lat: 144:4 Generátio et generátio laudábit ópera tua: * et poténtiam tuam pronuntiábunt.
verses.eng: 144:4 Generation and generation shall praise thy works: * and they shall declare thy power.

verses.lat: 144:5 Magnificéntiam glóriæ sanctitátis tuæ loquéntur: * et mirabília tua narrábunt.
verses.eng: 144:5 They shall speak of the magnificence of the glory of thy holiness: * and shall tell thy wondrous works.

verses.lat: 144:6 Et virtútem terribílium tuórum dicent: * et magnitúdinem tuam narrábunt.
verses.eng: 144:6 And they shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: * and shall declare thy greatness.

verses.lat: 144:7 Memóriam abundántiæ suavitátis tuæ eructábunt: * et justítia tua exsultábunt.
verses.eng: 144:7 They shall publish the memory of the abundance of thy sweetness: * and shall rejoice in thy justice.

vesperae.psalm4.label: Psalmus 144(8-'13a')
vesperae.psalm4.antiphonLat: Suávis Dóminus * univérsis: et miseratiónes ejus super ómnia ópera ejus.
vesperae.psalm4.antiphonEng: The Lord is sweet * to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

verses.lat: 144:8 Miserátor, et miséricors Dóminus: * pátiens, et multum miséricors.
verses.eng: 144:8 The Lord is gracious and merciful: * patient and plenteous in mercy.

verses.lat: 144:9 Suávis Dóminus univérsis: * et miseratiónes ejus super ómnia ópera ejus.
verses.eng: 144:9 The Lord is sweet to all: * and his tender mercies are over all his works.

verses.lat: 144:10 Confiteántur tibi, Dómine, ómnia ópera tua: * et sancti tui benedícant tibi.
verses.eng: 144:10 Let all thy works, O Lord, praise thee: * and let thy saints bless thee.

verses.lat: 144:11 Glóriam regni tui dicent: * et poténtiam tuam loquéntur:
verses.eng: 144:11 They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom: * and shall tell of thy power:

verses.lat: 144:12 Ut notam fáciant fíliis hóminum poténtiam tuam: * et glóriam magnificéntiæ regni tui.
verses.eng: 144:12 To make thy might known to the sons of men: * and the glory of the magnificence of thy kingdom.

verses.lat: 144:13a Regnum tuum regnum ómnium sæculórum: * et dominátio tua in omni generatióne et generatiónem.
verses.eng: 144:13a Thy kingdom is a kingdom of all ages: * and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

verses.lat: 144:13b Fidélis Dóminus in ómnibus verbis suis: * et sanctus in ómnibus opéribus suis.
verses.eng: 144:13b The Lord is faithful in all his words: * and holy in all his works.

vesperae.antiphon.psalm1.label: Antíphona
vesperae.antiphon.psalm1.lat: Benedíctus Dóminus * suscéptor meus et liberátor meus.
vesperae.antiphon.psalm1.eng: Blessed be the Lord * my support, and my deliverer.

vesperae.antiphon.psalm2.label: Antíphona
vesperae.antiphon.psalm2.lat: Beátus pópulus * cujus Dóminus Deus ejus.
vesperae.antiphon.psalm2.eng: Happy is that people * whose God is the Lord.

vesperae.antiphon.psalm3.label: Antíphona
vesperae.antiphon.psalm3.lat: Magnus Dóminus * et laudábilis nimis: et magnitúdinis ejus non est finis.
vesperae.antiphon.psalm3.eng: For the Lord is great * and exceedingly to be praised: His greatness has no end.

vesperae.antiphon.psalm4.label: Antíphona
vesperae.antiphon.psalm4.lat: Suávis Dóminus * univérsis: et miseratiónes ejus super ómnia ópera ejus.
vesperae.antiphon.psalm4.eng: The Lord is sweet * to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

vesperae.psalm5.label: Psalmus 144('13b'-21)
vesperae.psalm5.antiphonLat: Fidélis Dóminus * in ómnibus verbis suis: et sanctus in ómnibus opéribus suis.
vesperae.psalm5.antiphonEng: The Lord is faithful * in all his words: and holy in all his works.

verses.lat: 144:13a Regnum tuum regnum ómnium sæculórum: * et dominátio tua in omni generatióne et generatiónem.
verses.eng: 144:13a Thy kingdom is a kingdom of all ages: * and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

verses.lat: 144:13b Fidélis Dóminus in ómnibus verbis suis: * et sanctus in ómnibus opéribus suis.
verses.eng: 144:13b The Lord is faithful in all his words: * and holy in all his works.

verses.lat: 144:14 Állevat Dóminus omnes qui córruunt: * et érigit omnes elísos.
verses.eng: 144:14 The Lord lifteth up all that fall: * and setteth up all that are cast down.

verses.lat: 144:15 Óculi ómnium in te sperant, Dómine: * et tu das escam illórum in témpore opportúno.
verses.eng: 144:15 The eyes of all hope in thee, O Lord: * and thou givest them meat in due season.

verses.lat: 144:16 Áperis tu manum tuam: * et imples omne ánimal benedictióne.
verses.eng: 144:16 Thou openest thy hand, * and fillest with blessing every living creature.

verses.lat: 144:17 Justus Dóminus in ómnibus viis suis: * et sanctus in ómnibus opéribus suis.
verses.eng: 144:17 The Lord is just in all his ways: * and holy in all his works.

verses.lat: 144:18 Prope est Dóminus ómnibus invocántibus eum: * ómnibus invocántibus eum in veritáte.
verses.eng: 144:18 The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon him: * to all that call upon him in truth.

verses.lat: 144:19 Voluntátem timéntium se fáciet: ‡ et deprecatiónem eórum exáudiet: * et salvos fáciet eos.
verses.eng: 144:19 He will do the will of them that fear him: ‡ and he will hear their prayer, * and save them.

verses.lat: 144:20 Custódit Dóminus omnes diligéntes se: * et omnes peccatóres dispérdet.
verses.eng: 144:20 The Lord keepeth all them that love him; * but all the wicked he will destroy.

verses.lat: 144:21 Laudatiónem Dómini loquétur os meum: * et benedícat omnis caro nómini sancto ejus in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: 144:21 My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord: * and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

vesperae.antiphon.psalm5.label: Antíphona
vesperae.antiphon.psalm5.lat: Fidélis Dóminus * in ómnibus verbis suis: et sanctus in ómnibus opéribus suis.
vesperae.antiphon.psalm5.eng: The Lord is faithful * in all his words: and holy in all his works.

ant_prima.label: Antíphona
ant_prima.lat: Exaltáre, Dómine, * qui júdicas terram: redde retributiónem supérbis.
ant_prima.eng: Lift up thyself, O Lord, * thou that judgest the earth: render retribution to the proud.

verses.lat: 93:1 Deus ultiónum Dóminus: * Deus ultiónum líbere egit.
verses.eng: 93:1 The Lord is the God to whom revenge belongeth: * the God of revenge hath acted freely.

verses.lat: 93:2 Exaltáre, qui júdicas terram: * redde retributiónem supérbis.
verses.eng: 93:2 Lift up thyself, thou that judgest the earth: * render a reward to the proud.

verses.lat: 93:3 Úsquequo peccatóres, Dómine, * úsquequo peccatóres gloriabúntur:
verses.eng: 93:3 How long shall sinners, O Lord: * how long shall sinners glory?

verses.lat: 93:4 Effabúntur, et loquéntur iniquitátem: * loquéntur omnes, qui operántur injustítiam?
verses.eng: 93:4 Shall they utter, and speak iniquity: * shall all speak who work injustice?

verses.lat: 93:5 Pópulum tuum, Dómine, humiliavérunt: * et hereditátem tuam vexavérunt.
verses.eng: 93:5 Thy people, O Lord, they have brought low: * and they have afflicted thy inheritance.

verses.lat: 93:6 Víduam, et ádvenam interfecérunt: * et pupíllos occidérunt.
verses.eng: 93:6 They have slain the widow and the stranger: * and they have murdered the fatherless.

verses.lat: 93:7 Et dixérunt: Non vidébit Dóminus, * nec intélleget Deus Jacob.
verses.eng: 93:7 And they have said: The Lord shall not see: * neither shall the God of Jacob understand.

verses.lat: 93:8 Intellégite, insipiéntes in pópulo: * et stulti, aliquándo sápite.
verses.eng: 93:8 Understand, ye senseless among the people: * and, you fools, be wise at last.

verses.lat: 93:9 Qui plantávit aurem, non áudiet? * aut qui finxit óculum, non consíderat?
verses.eng: 93:9 He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? * or he that formed the eye, doth he not consider?

verses.lat: 93:10 Qui córripit gentes, non árguet: * qui docet hóminem sciéntiam?
verses.eng: 93:10 He that chastiseth nations, shall he not rebuke: * he that teacheth man knowledge?

verses.lat: 93:11 Dóminus scit cogitatiónes hóminum, * quóniam vanæ sunt.
verses.eng: 93:11 The Lord knoweth the thoughts of men, * that they are vain.

verses.lat: 93:12 Beátus homo, quem tu erudíeris, Dómine: * et de lege tua docúeris eum,
verses.eng: 93:12 Blessed is the man whom thou shalt instruct, O Lord: * and shalt teach him out of thy law.

verses.lat: 93:13 Ut mítiges ei a diébus malis: * donec fodiátur peccatóri fóvea.
verses.eng: 93:13 That thou mayst give him rest from the evil days: * till a pit be dug for the wicked.

verses.lat: 93:14 Quia non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: * et hereditátem suam non derelínquet.
verses.eng: 93:14 For the Lord will not cast off his people: * neither will he forsake his own inheritance.

verses.lat: 93:15 Quoadúsque justítia convertátur in judícium: * et qui juxta illam omnes qui recto sunt corde.
verses.eng: 93:15 Until justice be turned into judgment: * and they that are near it are all the upright in heart.

verses.lat: 93:16 Quis consúrget mihi advérsus malignántes? * aut quis stabit mecum advérsus operántes iniquitátem?
verses.eng: 93:16 Who shall rise up for me against the evildoers? * or who shall stand with me against the workers of iniquity?

verses.lat: 93:17 Nisi quia Dóminus adjúvit me: * paulo minus habitásset in inférno ánima mea.
verses.eng: 93:17 Unless the Lord had been my helper, * my soul had almost dwelt in hell.

verses.lat: 93:18 Si dicébam: Motus est pes meus: * misericórdia tua, Dómine, adjuvábat me.
verses.eng: 93:18 If I said: My foot is moved: * thy mercy, O Lord, assisted me.

verses.lat: 93:19 Secúndum multitúdinem dolórum meórum in corde meo: * consolatiónes tuæ lætificavérunt ánimam meam.
verses.eng: 93:19 According to the multitude of my sorrows in my heart, * thy comforts have given joy to my soul.

verses.lat: 93:20 Numquid adhǽret tibi sedes iniquitátis: * qui fingis labórem in præcépto?
verses.eng: 93:20 Doth the seat of iniquity stick to thee, * who framest labour in commandment?

verses.lat: 93:21 Captábunt in ánimam justi: * et sánguinem innocéntem condemnábunt.
verses.eng: 93:21 They will hunt after the soul of the just, * and will condemn innocent blood.

verses.lat: 93:22 Et factus est mihi Dóminus in refúgium: * et Deus meus in adjutórium spei meæ.
verses.eng: 93:22 But the Lord is my refuge: * and my God the help of my hope.

verses.lat: 93:23 Et reddet illis iniquitátem ipsórum: et in malítia eórum dispérdet eos: * dispérdet illos Dóminus, Deus noster.
verses.eng: 93:23 And he will render them their iniquity: and in their malice he will destroy them: * the Lord our God will destroy them.

verses.lat: 107:2 Parátum cor meum, Deus, parátum cor meum: * cantábo, et psallam in glória mea.
verses.eng: 107:2 My heart is ready, O God, my heart is ready: * I will sing, and will give praise, with my glory.

verses.lat: 107:3 Exsúrge, glória mea, exsúrge, psaltérium et cíthara: * exsúrgam dilúculo.
verses.eng: 107:3 Arise, my glory; arise, psaltery and harp * I will arise in the morning early.

verses.lat: 107:4 Confitébor tibi in pópulis, Dómine: * et psallam tibi in natiónibus.
verses.eng: 107:4 I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: * and I will sing unto thee among the nations.

verses.lat: 107:5 Quia magna est super cælos misericórdia tua: * et usque ad nubes véritas tua:
verses.eng: 107:5 For thy mercy is great above the heavens: * and thy truth even unto the clouds.

verses.lat: 107:6 Exaltáre super cælos, Deus, et super omnem terram glória tua: * ut liberéntur dilécti tui.
verses.eng: 107:6 Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, and thy glory over all the earth: * that thy beloved may be delivered.

verses.lat: 107:7 Salvum fac déxtera tua, et exáudi me: * Deus locútus est in sancto suo:
verses.eng: 107:7 Save with thy right hand and hear me. * God hath spoken in his holiness.

verses.lat: 107:8 Exsultábo, et dívidam Síchimam, * et convállem tabernaculórum dimétiar.
verses.eng: 107:8 I will rejoice, and I will divide Sichem * and I will mete out the vale of tabernacles.

verses.lat: 107:9 Meus est Gálaad, et meus est Manásses: * et Éphraim suscéptio cápitis mei.
verses.eng: 107:9 Galaad is mine: and Manasses is mine: * and Ephraim the protection of my head.

verses.lat: 107:10 Juda rex meus: * Moab lebes spei meæ.
verses.eng: 107:10 Juda is my king: * Moab the pot of my hope.

verses.lat: 107:10 In Idumǽam exténdam calceaméntum meum: * mihi alienígenæ amíci facti sunt.
verses.eng: 107:10 Over Edom I will stretch out my shoe: * the aliens are become my friends.

verses.lat: 107:11 Quis dedúcet me in civitátem munítam? * quis dedúcet me usque in Idumǽam?
verses.eng: 107:11 Who will bring me into the strong city? * who will lead me into Edom?

verses.lat: 107:12 Nonne tu, Deus, qui repulísti nos, * et non exíbis, Deus, in virtútibus nostris?
verses.eng: 107:12 Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? * and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our armies?

verses.lat: 107:13 Da nobis auxílium de tribulatióne: * quia vana salus hóminis.
verses.eng: 107:13 O grant us help from trouble: * for vain is the help of man.

verses.lat: 107:14 In Deo faciémus virtútem: * et ipse ad níhilum dedúcet inimícos nostros.
verses.eng: 107:14 Through God we shall do mightily: * and he will bring our enemies to nothing.

ant_tertia.label: Antíphona
ant_tertia.lat: Clamor meus, * Dómine, ad te pervéniat: non avértas fáciem tuam a me.
ant_tertia.eng: Let my cry reach unto thee, O Lord: * turn not away thy face from me.

verses.lat: 101:2 Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam: * et clamor meus ad te véniat.
verses.eng: 101:2 Hear, O Lord, my prayer: * and let my cry come to thee.

verses.lat: 101:3 Non avértas fáciem tuam a me: * in quacúmque die tríbulor, inclína ad me aurem tuam.
verses.eng: 101:3 Turn not away thy face from me: * in the day when I am in trouble, incline thy ear to me.

verses.lat: 101:3 In quacúmque die invocávero te, * velóciter exáudi me.
verses.eng: 101:3 In what day soever I shall call upon thee, * hear me speedily.

verses.lat: 101:4 Quia defecérunt sicut fumus dies mei: * et ossa mea sicut crémium aruérunt.
verses.eng: 101:4 For my days are vanished like smoke: * and my bones are grown dry like fuel for the fire.

verses.lat: 101:5 Percússus sum ut fænum, et áruit cor meum: * quia oblítus sum comédere panem meum.
verses.eng: 101:5 I am smitten as grass, and my heart is withered: * because I forgot to eat my bread.

verses.lat: 101:6 A voce gémitus mei * adhǽsit os meum carni meæ.
verses.eng: 101:6 Through the voice of my groaning, * my bone hath cleaved to my flesh.

verses.lat: 101:7 Símilis factus sum pellicáno solitúdinis: * factus sum sicut nyctícorax in domicílio.
verses.eng: 101:7 I am become like to a pelican of the wilderness: * I am like a night raven in the house.

verses.lat: 101:8 Vigilávi, * et factus sum sicut passer solitárius in tecto.
verses.eng: 101:8 I have watched, * and am become as a sparrow all alone on the housetop.

verses.lat: 101:9 Tota die exprobrábant mihi inimíci mei: * et qui laudábant me, advérsum me jurábant.
verses.eng: 101:9 All the day long my enemies reproached me: * and they that praised me did swear against me.

verses.lat: 101:10 Quia cínerem tamquam panem manducábam, * et potum meum cum fletu miscébam.
verses.eng: 101:10 For I did eat ashes like bread, * and mingled my drink with weeping.

verses.lat: 101:11 A fácie iræ et indignatiónis tuæ: * quia élevans allisísti me.
verses.eng: 101:11 Because of thy anger and indignation: * for having lifted me up thou hast thrown me down.

verses.lat: 101:12 Dies mei sicut umbra declinavérunt: * et ego sicut fænum árui.
verses.eng: 101:12 My days have declined like a shadow, * and I am withered like grass.

verses.lat: 101:13 Tu autem, Dómine, in ætérnum pérmanes: * et memoriále tuum in generatiónem et generatiónem.
verses.eng: 101:13 But thou, O Lord, endurest for ever: * and thy memorial to all generations.

verses.lat: 101:14 Tu exsúrgens miseréberis Sion: * quia tempus miseréndi ejus, quia venit tempus.
verses.eng: 101:14 Thou shalt arise and have mercy on Sion: * for it is time to have mercy on it, for the time is come.

verses.lat: 101:15 Quóniam placuérunt servis tuis lápides ejus: * et terræ ejus miserebúntur.
verses.eng: 101:15 For the stones thereof have pleased thy servants: * and they shall have pity on the earth thereof.

verses.lat: 101:16 Et timébunt gentes nomen tuum, Dómine, * et omnes reges terræ glóriam tuam.
verses.eng: 101:16 And the Gentiles shall fear thy name, O Lord, * and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

verses.lat: 101:17 Quia ædificávit Dóminus Sion: * et vidébitur in glória sua.
verses.eng: 101:17 For the Lord hath built up Sion: * and he shall be seen in his glory.

verses.lat: 101:18 Respéxit in oratiónem humílium: * et non sprevit precem eórum.
verses.eng: 101:18 He hath had regard to the prayer of the humble: * and he hath not despised their petition.

verses.lat: 101:19 Scribántur hæc in generatióne áltera: * et pópulus, qui creábitur, laudábit Dóminum:
verses.eng: 101:19 Let these things be written unto another generation: * and the people that shall be created shall praise the Lord:

verses.lat: 101:20 Quia prospéxit de excélso sancto suo: * Dóminus de cælo in terram aspéxit:
verses.eng: 101:20 Because he hath looked forth from his high sanctuary: * from heaven the Lord hath looked upon the earth.

verses.lat: 101:21 Ut audíret gémitus compeditórum: * ut sólveret fílios interemptórum:
verses.eng: 101:21 That he might hear the groans of them that are in fetters: * that he might release the children of the slain:

verses.lat: 101:22 Ut annúntient in Sion nomen Dómini: * et laudem ejus in Jerúsalem.
verses.eng: 101:22 That they may declare the name of the Lord in Sion: * and his praise in Jerusalem;

verses.lat: 101:23 In conveniéndo pópulos in unum, * et reges ut sérviant Dómino.
verses.eng: 101:23 When the people assemble together, * and kings, to serve the Lord.

verses.lat: 101:24 Respóndit ei in via virtútis suæ: * Paucitátem diérum meórum núntia mihi.
verses.eng: 101:24 He answered him in the way of his strength: * Declare unto me the fewness of my days.

verses.lat: 101:25 Ne révoces me in dimídio diérum meórum: * in generatiónem et generatiónem anni tui.
verses.eng: 101:25 Call me not away in the midst of my days: * thy years are unto generation and generation.

verses.lat: 101:26 Inítio tu, Dómine, terram fundásti: * et ópera mánuum tuárum sunt cæli.
verses.eng: 101:26 In the beginning, O Lord, thou foundedst the earth: * and the heavens are the works of thy hands.

verses.lat: 101:27 Ipsi períbunt, tu autem pérmanes: * et omnes sicut vestiméntum veteráscent.
verses.eng: 101:27 They shall perish but thou remainest: * and all of them shall grow old like a garment:

verses.lat: 101:28 Et sicut opertórium mutábis eos, et mutabúntur: * tu autem idem ipse es, et anni tui non defícient.
verses.eng: 101:28 And as a vesture thou shalt change them, and they shall be changed. * But thou art always the selfsame, and thy years shall not fail.

verses.lat: 101:29 Fílii servórum tuórum habitábunt: * et semen eórum in sǽculum dirigétur.
verses.eng: 101:29 The children of thy servants shall continue: * and their seed shall be directed for ever.

ant_sexta.label: Antíphona
ant_sexta.lat: Dómine, Deus meus * magnificátus es veheménter.
ant_sexta.eng: O Lord, my God, * thou art exceedingly great.

verses.lat: 103:1 Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * Dómine, Deus meus, magnificátus es veheménter.
verses.eng: 103:1 Bless the Lord, O my soul: * O Lord my God, thou art exceedingly great.

verses.lat: 103:1 Confessiónem, et decórem induísti: * amíctus lúmine sicut vestiménto:
verses.eng: 103:1 Thou hast put on praise and beauty: * and art clothed with light as with a garment.

verses.lat: 103:2 Exténdens cælum sicut pellem: * qui tegis aquis superióra ejus.
verses.eng: 103:2 Who stretchest out the heaven like a pavilion: * who coverest the higher rooms thereof with water.

verses.lat: 103:3 Qui ponis nubem ascénsum tuum: * qui ámbulas super pennas ventórum.
verses.eng: 103:3 Who makest the clouds thy chariot: * who walkest upon the wings of the winds.

verses.lat: 103:4 Qui facis ángelos tuos, spíritus: * et minístros tuos ignem uréntem.
verses.eng: 103:4 Who makest thy angels spirits: * and thy ministers a burning fire.

verses.lat: 103:5 Qui fundásti terram super stabilitátem suam: * non inclinábitur in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: 103:5 Who hast founded the earth upon its own bases: * it shall not be moved for ever and ever.

verses.lat: 103:6 Abýssus, sicut vestiméntum, amíctus ejus: * super montes stabunt aquæ.
verses.eng: 103:6 The deep like a garment is its clothing: * above the mountains shall the waters stand.

verses.lat: 103:7 Ab increpatióne tua fúgient: * a voce tonítrui tui formidábunt.
verses.eng: 103:7 At thy rebuke they shall flee: * at the voice of thy thunder they shall fear.

verses.lat: 103:8 Ascéndunt montes: et descéndunt campi * in locum, quem fundásti eis.
verses.eng: 103:8 The mountains ascend, and the plains descend * into the place which thou hast founded for them.

verses.lat: 103:9 Términum posuísti, quem non transgrediéntur: * neque converténtur operíre terram.
verses.eng: 103:9 Thou hast set a bound which they shall not pass over; * neither shall they return to cover the earth.

verses.lat: 103:10 Qui emíttis fontes in convállibus: * inter médium móntium pertransíbunt aquæ.
verses.eng: 103:10 Thou sendest forth springs in the vales: * between the midst of the hills the waters shall pass.

verses.lat: 103:11 Potábunt omnes béstiæ agri: * exspectábunt ónagri in siti sua.
verses.eng: 103:11 All the beasts of the field shall drink: * the wild asses shall expect in their thirst.

verses.lat: 103:12 Super ea vólucres cæli habitábunt: * de médio petrárum dabunt voces.
verses.eng: 103:12 Over them the birds of the air shall dwell: * from the midst of the rocks they shall give forth their voices.

verses.lat: 103:13 Rigans montes de superióribus suis: * de fructu óperum tuórum satiábitur terra:
verses.eng: 103:13 Thou waterest the hills from thy upper rooms: * the earth shall be filled with the fruit of thy works:

verses.lat: 103:14 Prodúcens fænum juméntis, * et herbam servitúti hóminum:
verses.eng: 103:14 Bringing forth grass for cattle, * and herb for the service of men.

verses.lat: 103:14 Ut edúcas panem de terra: * et vinum lætíficet cor hóminis:
verses.eng: 103:14 That thou mayst bring bread out of the earth: * and that wine may cheer the heart of man.

verses.lat: 103:15 Ut exhílaret fáciem in óleo: * et panis cor hóminis confírmet.
verses.eng: 103:15 That he may make the face cheerful with oil: * and that bread may strengthen man’s heart.

verses.lat: 103:16 Saturabúntur ligna campi, et cedri Líbani, quas plantávit: * illic pásseres nidificábunt.
verses.eng: 103:16 The trees of the field shall be filled, and the cedars of Libanus which he hath planted: * there the sparrows shall make their nests.

verses.lat: 103:17 Heródii domus dux est eórum: * montes excélsi cervis: petra refúgium herináciis.
verses.eng: 103:17 The highest of them is the house of the heron. * The high hills are a refuge for the harts, the rock for the irchins.

verses.lat: 103:19 Fecit lunam in témpora: * sol cognóvit occásum suum.
verses.eng: 103:19 He hath made the moon for seasons: * the sun knoweth his going down.

verses.lat: 103:20 Posuísti ténebras, et facta est nox: * in ipsa pertransíbunt omnes béstiæ silvæ.
verses.eng: 103:20 Thou hast appointed darkness, and it is night: * in it shall all the beasts of the woods go about:

verses.lat: 103:21 Cátuli leónum rugiéntes, ut rápiant, * et quærant a Deo escam sibi.
verses.eng: 103:21 The young lions roaring after their prey, * and seeking their meat from God.

verses.lat: 103:22 Ortus est sol, et congregáti sunt: * et in cubílibus suis collocabúntur.
verses.eng: 103:22 The sun ariseth, and they are gathered together: * and they shall lie down in their dens.

verses.lat: 103:23 Exíbit homo ad opus suum: * et ad operatiónem suam usque ad vésperum.
verses.eng: 103:23 Man shall go forth to his work, * and to his labour until the evening.

verses.lat: 103:24 Quam magnificáta sunt ópera tua, Dómine! * ómnia in sapiéntia fecísti: impléta est terra possessióne tua.
verses.eng: 103:24 How great are thy works, O Lord? * thou hast made all things in wisdom: the earth is filled with thy riches.

verses.lat: 103:25 Hoc mare magnum, et spatiósum mánibus: * illic reptília, quorum non est númerus.
verses.eng: 103:25 So is this great sea, which stretcheth wide its arms: * there are creeping things without number:

verses.lat: 103:26 Animália pusílla cum magnis: * illic naves pertransíbunt.
verses.eng: 103:26 Creatures little and great. * There the ships shall go.

verses.lat: 103:27 Draco iste, quem formásti ad illudéndum ei: * ómnia a te exspéctant ut des illis escam in témpore.
verses.eng: 103:27 This sea dragon which thou hast formed to play therein. * All expect of thee that thou give them food in season.

verses.lat: 103:28 Dante te illis, cólligent: * aperiénte te manum tuam, ómnia implebúntur bonitáte.
verses.eng: 103:28 What thou givest to them they shall gather up: * when thou openest thy hand, they shall all be filled with good.

verses.lat: 103:29 Averténte autem te fáciem, turbabúntur: * áuferes spíritum eórum, et defícient, et in púlverem suum reverténtur.
verses.eng: 103:29 But if thou turnest away thy face, they shall be troubled: * thou shalt take away their breath, and they shall fail, and shall return to their dust.

verses.lat: 103:30 Emíttes spíritum tuum, et creabúntur: * et renovábis fáciem terræ.
verses.eng: 103:30 Thou shalt send forth thy spirit, and they shall be created: * and thou shalt renew the face of the earth.

verses.lat: 103:31 Sit glória Dómini in sǽculum: * lætábitur Dóminus in opéribus suis:
verses.eng: 103:31 May the glory of the Lord endure for ever: * the Lord shall rejoice in his works.

verses.lat: 103:32 Qui réspicit terram, et facit eam trémere: * qui tangit montes, et fúmigant.
verses.eng: 103:32 He looketh upon the earth, and maketh it tremble: * he toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.

verses.lat: 103:33 Cantábo Dómino in vita mea: * psallam Deo meo, quámdiu sum.
verses.eng: 103:33 I will sing to the Lord as long as I live: * I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

verses.lat: 103:34 Jucúndum sit ei elóquium meum: * ego vero delectábor in Dómino.
verses.eng: 103:34 Let my speech be acceptable to him: * but I will take delight in the Lord.

verses.lat: 103:35 Defíciant peccatóres a terra, et iníqui ita ut non sint: * bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.
verses.eng: 103:35 Let sinners be consumed out of the earth, and the unjust, so that they be no more: * O my soul, bless thou the Lord.

ant_nona.label: Antíphona
ant_nona.lat: Ne tacúeris Deus, * quia sermónibus ódii circumdedérunt me.
ant_nona.eng: O God, be thou not silent * for the mouth of the wicked man is opened against me.

verses.lat: 108:2 Deus, laudem meam ne tacúeris: * quia os peccatóris, et os dolósi super me apértum est.
verses.eng: 108:2 God, be not thou silent in my praise: * for the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful man is opened against me.

verses.lat: 108:3 Locúti sunt advérsum me lingua dolósa, et sermónibus ódii circumdedérunt me: * et expugnavérunt me gratis.
verses.eng: 108:3 They have spoken against me with deceitful tongues; and they have compassed me about with words of hatred; * and have fought against me without cause.

verses.lat: 108:4 Pro eo ut me dilígerent, detrahébant mihi: * ego autem orábam.
verses.eng: 108:4 Instead of making me a return of love, they detracted me: * but I gave myself to prayer.

verses.lat: 108:5 Et posuérunt advérsum me mala pro bonis: * et ódium pro dilectióne mea.
verses.eng: 108:5 And they repaid me evil for good: * and hatred for my love.

verses.lat: 108:6 Constítue super eum peccatórem: * et diábolus stet a dextris ejus.
verses.eng: 108:6 Set thou the sinner over him: * and may the devil stand at his right hand.

verses.lat: 108:7 Cum judicátur, éxeat condemnátus: * et orátio ejus fiat in peccátum.
verses.eng: 108:7 When he is judged, may he go out condemned; * and may his prayer be turned to sin.

verses.lat: 108:8 Fiant dies ejus pauci: * et episcopátum ejus accípiat alter.
verses.eng: 108:8 May his days be few: * and his bishopric let another take.

verses.lat: 108:9 Fiant fílii ejus órphani: * et uxor ejus vídua.
verses.eng: 108:9 May his children be fatherless, * and his wife a widow.

verses.lat: 108:10 Nutántes transferántur fílii ejus, et mendícent: * et eiciántur de habitatiónibus suis.
verses.eng: 108:10 Let his children be carried about vagabonds, and beg; * and let them be cast out of their dwellings.

verses.lat: 108:11 Scrutétur fænerátor omnem substántiam ejus: * et dirípiant aliéni labóres ejus.
verses.eng: 108:11 May the usurer search all his substance: * and let strangers plunder his labours.

verses.lat: 108:12 Non sit illi adjútor: * nec sit qui misereátur pupíllis ejus.
verses.eng: 108:12 May there be none to help him: * nor none to pity his fatherless offspring.

verses.lat: 108:13 Fiant nati ejus in intéritum: * in generatióne una deleátur nomen ejus.
verses.eng: 108:13 May his posterity be cut off; * in one generation may his name be blotted out.

verses.lat: 108:14 In memóriam rédeat iníquitas patrum ejus in conspéctu Dómini: * et peccátum matris ejus non deleátur.
verses.eng: 108:14 May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered in the sight of the Lord: * and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

verses.lat: 108:15 Fiant contra Dóminum semper, et dispéreat de terra memória eórum: * pro eo quod non est recordátus fácere misericórdiam.
verses.eng: 108:15 May they be before the Lord continually, and let the memory of them perish from the earth: * because he remembered not to shew mercy,

verses.lat: 108:17 Et persecútus est hóminem ínopem, et mendícum, * et compúnctum corde mortificáre.
verses.eng: 108:17 But persecuted the poor man and the beggar; * and the broken in heart, to put him to death.

verses.lat: 108:18 Et diléxit maledictiónem, et véniet ei: * et nóluit benedictiónem, et elongábitur ab eo.
verses.eng: 108:18 And he loved cursing, and it shall come unto him: * and he would not have blessing, and it shall be far from him.

verses.lat: 108:18 Et índuit maledictiónem sicut vestiméntum, * et intrávit sicut aqua in interióra ejus, et sicut óleum in óssibus ejus.
verses.eng: 108:18 And he put on cursing, like a garment: * and it went in like water into his entrails, and like oil in his bones.

verses.lat: 108:19 Fiat ei sicut vestiméntum, quo operítur: * et sicut zona, qua semper præcíngitur.
verses.eng: 108:19 May it be unto him like a garment which covereth him; * and like a girdle with which he is girded continually.

verses.lat: 108:20 Hoc opus eórum, qui détrahunt mihi apud Dóminum: * et qui loquúntur mala advérsus ánimam meam.
verses.eng: 108:20 This is the work of them who detract me before the Lord; * and who speak evils against my soul.

verses.lat: 108:21 Et tu, Dómine, Dómine, fac mecum propter nomen tuum: * quia suávis est misericórdia tua.
verses.eng: 108:21 But thou, O Lord, do with me for thy name’s sake: * because thy mercy is sweet.

verses.lat: 108:22 Líbera me quia egénus, et pauper ego sum: * et cor meum conturbátum est intra me.
verses.eng: 108:22 Do thou deliver me, for I am poor and needy, * and my heart is troubled within me.

verses.lat: 108:23 Sicut umbra cum declínat, ablátus sum: * et excússus sum sicut locústæ.
verses.eng: 108:23 I am taken away like the shadow when it declineth: * and I am shaken off as locusts.

verses.lat: 108:24 Génua mea infirmáta sunt a jejúnio: * et caro mea immutáta est propter óleum.
verses.eng: 108:24 My knees are weakened through fasting: * and my flesh is changed for oil.

verses.lat: 108:25 Et ego factus sum oppróbrium illis: * vidérunt me, et movérunt cápita sua.
verses.eng: 108:25 And I am become a reproach to them: * they saw me and they shaked their heads.

verses.lat: 108:26 Ádjuva me, Dómine, Deus meus: * salvum me fac secúndum misericórdiam tuam.
verses.eng: 108:26 Help me, O Lord my God; * save me according to thy mercy.

verses.lat: 108:27 Et sciant quia manus tua hæc: * et tu, Dómine, fecísti eam.
verses.eng: 108:27 And let them know that this is thy hand: * and that thou, O Lord, hast done it.

verses.lat: 108:28 Maledícent illi, et tu benedíces: * qui insúrgunt in me, confundántur: servus autem tuus lætábitur.
verses.eng: 108:28 They will curse and thou wilt bless: * let them that rise up against me be confounded: but thy servant shall rejoice.

verses.lat: 108:29 Induántur qui détrahunt mihi, pudóre: * et operiántur sicut diplóide confusióne sua.
verses.eng: 108:29 Let them that detract me be clothed with shame: * and let them be covered with their confusion as with a double cloak.

verses.lat: 108:30 Confitébor Dómino nimis in ore meo: * et in médio multórum laudábo eum.
verses.eng: 108:30 I will give great thanks to the Lord with my mouth: * and in the midst of many I will praise him.

verses.lat: 108:31 Quia ástitit a dextris páuperis, * ut salvam fáceret a persequéntibus ánimam meam.
verses.eng: 108:31 Because he hath stood at the right hand of the poor, * to save my soul from persecutors.

completorium.antiphon.label: Antíphona
completorium.antiphon.lat: Intret orátio mea * in conspéctu tuo, Dómine.
completorium.antiphon.eng: May my request * come before thee, O Lord.

verses.lat: 87:2 Dómine, Deus salútis meæ: * in die clamávi, et nocte coram te.
verses.eng: 87:2 Lord, the God of my salvation: * I have cried in the day, and in the night before thee.

verses.lat: 87:3 Intret in conspéctu tuo orátio mea: * inclína aurem tuam ad precem meam:
verses.eng: 87:3 Let my prayer come in before thee: * incline thy ear to my petition.

verses.lat: 87:4 Quia repléta est malis ánima mea: * et vita mea inférno appropinquávit.
verses.eng: 87:4 For my soul is filled with evils: * and my life hath drawn nigh to hell.

verses.lat: 87:5 Æstimátus sum cum descendéntibus in lacum: * factus sum sicut homo sine adjutório, inter mórtuos liber.
verses.eng: 87:5 I am counted among them that go down to the pit: * I am become as a man without help, free among the dead.

verses.lat: 87:6 Sicut vulneráti dormiéntes in sepúlcris, quorum non es memor ámplius: * et ipsi de manu tua repúlsi sunt.
verses.eng: 87:6 Like the slain sleeping in the sepulchres, whom thou rememberest no more: * and they are cast off from thy hand.

verses.lat: 87:7 Posuérunt me in lacu inferióri: * in tenebrósis, et in umbra mortis.
verses.eng: 87:7 They have laid me in the lower pit: * in the dark places, and in the shadow of death.

verses.lat: 87:8 Super me confirmátus est furor tuus: * et omnes fluctus tuos induxísti super me.
verses.eng: 87:8 Thy wrath is strong over me: * and all thy waves thou hast brought in upon me.

verses.lat: 87:9 Longe fecísti notos meos a me: * posuérunt me abominatiónem sibi.
verses.eng: 87:9 Thou hast put away my acquaintance far from me: * they have set me an abomination to themselves.

verses.lat: 87:9 Tráditus sum, et non egrediébar: * óculi mei languérunt præ inópia.
verses.eng: 87:9 I was delivered up, and came not forth: * my eyes languished through poverty.

verses.lat: 87:10 Clamávi ad te, Dómine, tota die: * expándi ad te manus meas.
verses.eng: 87:10 All the day I cried to thee, O Lord: * I stretched out my hands to thee.

verses.lat: 87:11 Numquid mórtuis fácies mirabília: * aut médici suscitábunt, et confitebúntur tibi?
verses.eng: 87:11 Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? * or shall physicians raise to life, and give praise to thee?

verses.lat: 87:12 Numquid narrábit áliquis in sepúlcro misericórdiam tuam, * et veritátem tuam in perditióne?
verses.eng: 87:12 Shall any one in the sepulchre declare thy mercy: * and thy truth in destruction?

verses.lat: 87:13 Numquid cognoscéntur in ténebris mirabília tua, * et justítia tua in terra obliviónis?
verses.eng: 87:13 Shall thy wonders be known in the dark; * and thy justice in the land of forgetfulness?

verses.lat: 87:14 Et ego ad te, Dómine, clamávi: * et mane orátio mea prævéniet te.
verses.eng: 87:14 But I, O Lord, have cried to thee: * and in the morning my prayer shall prevent thee.

verses.lat: 87:15 Ut quid, Dómine, repéllis oratiónem meam: * avértis fáciem tuam a me?
verses.eng: 87:15 Lord, why castest thou off my prayer: * why turnest thou away thy face from me?

verses.lat: 87:16 Pauper sum ego, et in labóribus a juventúte mea: * exaltátus autem, humiliátus sum et conturbátus.
verses.eng: 87:16 I am poor, and in labours from my youth: * and being exalted have been humbled and troubled.

verses.lat: 87:17 In me transiérunt iræ tuæ: * et terróres tui conturbavérunt me.
verses.eng: 87:17 Thy wrath hath come upon me: * and thy terrors have troubled me.

verses.lat: 87:18 Circumdedérunt me sicut aqua tota die: * circumdedérunt me simul.
verses.eng: 87:18 They have come round about me like water all the day: * they have compassed me about together.

verses.lat: 87:19 Elongásti a me amícum et próximum: * et notos meos a miséria.
verses.eng: 87:19 Friend and neighbour thou hast put far from me: * and my acquaintance, because of misery.

verses.lat: 102:1 Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et ómnia, quæ intra me sunt, nómini sancto ejus.
verses.eng: 102:1 Bless the Lord, O my soul: * and let all that is within me bless his holy name.

verses.lat: 102:2 Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et noli oblivísci omnes retributiónes ejus.
verses.eng: 102:2 Bless the Lord, O my soul, * and never forget all he hath done for thee.

verses.lat: 102:3 Qui propitiátur ómnibus iniquitátibus tuis: * qui sanat omnes infirmitátes tuas.
verses.eng: 102:3 Who forgiveth all thy iniquities: * who healeth all thy diseases.

verses.lat: 102:4 Qui rédimit de intéritu vitam tuam: * qui corónat te in misericórdia et miseratiónibus.
verses.eng: 102:4 Who redeemeth thy life from destruction: * who crowneth thee with mercy and compassion.

verses.lat: 102:5 Qui replet in bonis desidérium tuum: * renovábitur ut áquilæ juvéntus tua:
verses.eng: 102:5 Who satisfieth thy desire with good things: * thy youth shall be renewed like the eagle’s.

verses.lat: 102:6 Fáciens misericórdias Dóminus: * et judícium ómnibus injúriam patiéntibus.
verses.eng: 102:6 The Lord doth mercies, * and judgment for all that suffer wrong.

verses.lat: 102:7 Notas fecit vias suas Móysi, * fíliis Israël voluntátes suas.
verses.eng: 102:7 He hath made his ways known to Moses: * his wills to the children of Israel.

verses.lat: 102:8 Miserátor, et miséricors Dóminus: * longánimis, et multum miséricors.
verses.eng: 102:8 The Lord is compassionate and merciful: * longsuffering and plenteous in mercy.

verses.lat: 102:9 Non in perpétuum irascétur: * neque in ætérnum comminábitur.
verses.eng: 102:9 He will not always be angry: * nor will he threaten for ever.

verses.lat: 102:10 Non secúndum peccáta nostra fecit nobis: * neque secúndum iniquitátes nostras retríbuit nobis.
verses.eng: 102:10 He hath not dealt with us according to our sins: * nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

verses.lat: 102:11 Quóniam secúndum altitúdinem cæli a terra: * corroborávit misericórdiam suam super timéntes se.
verses.eng: 102:11 For according to the height of the heaven above the earth: * he hath strengthened his mercy towards them that fear him.

verses.lat: 102:12 Quantum distat ortus ab occidénte: * longe fecit a nobis iniquitátes nostras.
verses.eng: 102:12 As far as the east is from the west, * so far hath he removed our iniquities from us.

verses.lat: 102:13 Quómodo miserétur pater filiórum, misértus est Dóminus timéntibus se: * quóniam ipse cognóvit figméntum nostrum.
verses.eng: 102:13 As a father hath compassion on his children, so hath the Lord compassion on them that fear him: * for he knoweth our frame.

verses.lat: 102:14 Recordátus est quóniam pulvis sumus: * homo, sicut fænum dies ejus, tamquam flos agri sic efflorébit.
verses.eng: 102:14 He remembereth that we are dust: * man’s days are as grass, as the flower of the field so shall he flourish.

verses.lat: 102:16 Quóniam spíritus pertransíbit in illo, et non subsístet: * et non cognóscet ámplius locum suum.
verses.eng: 102:16 For the spirit shall pass in him, and he shall not be: * and he shall know his place no more.

verses.lat: 102:17 Misericórdia autem Dómini ab ætérno, * et usque in ætérnum super timéntes eum.
verses.eng: 102:17 But the mercy of the Lord is from eternity * and unto eternity upon them that fear him:

verses.lat: 102:17 Et justítia illíus in fílios filiórum, * his qui servant testaméntum ejus:
verses.eng: 102:17 And his justice unto children’s children, * to such as keep his covenant,

verses.lat: 102:18 Et mémores sunt mandatórum ipsíus, * ad faciéndum ea.
verses.eng: 102:18 And are mindful of his commandments * to do them.

verses.lat: 102:19 Dóminus in cælo parávit sedem suam: * et regnum ipsíus ómnibus dominábitur.
verses.eng: 102:19 The Lord hath prepared his throne in heaven: * and his kingdom shall rule over all.

verses.lat: 102:20 Benedícite Dómino, omnes Ángeli ejus: * poténtes virtúte, faciéntes verbum illíus, ad audiéndam vocem sermónum ejus.
verses.eng: 102:20 Bless the Lord, all ye his angels: * you that are mighty in strength, and execute his word, hearkening to the voice of his orders.

verses.lat: 102:21 Benedícite Dómino, omnes virtútes ejus: * minístri ejus, qui fácitis voluntátem ejus.
verses.eng: 102:21 Bless the Lord, all ye his hosts: * you ministers of his that do his will.

verses.lat: 102:22 Benedícite Dómino, ómnia ópera ejus: * in omni loco dominatiónis ejus, bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.
verses.eng: 102:22 Bless the Lord, all his works: * in every place of his dominion, O my soul, bless thou the Lord.

tertia.capitulum.label: Capitulum
tertia.capitulum.lat: Sana me, Dómine, et sanábor: salvum me fac, et salvus ero: quóniam laus mea tu es.
tertia.capitulum.eng: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed: save me, and I shall be saved, for Thou art my praise.

responsory_breve_tertia.label: Responsory
responsory_breve_tertia.lat:
℟.br. Sana ánimam meam, * quia peccávi tibi.
℣. Ego dixi: Dómine, miserére mei.
℟. Quia peccávi tibi.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Sana ánimam meam, * quia peccávi tibi.
responsory_breve_tertia.eng:
℟.br. Heal my soul, * for I have sinned against Thee.
℣. I said: O Lord, be Thou merciful to me.
℟. For I have sinned against Thee.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Heal my soul, * for I have sinned against Thee.

capitulum_sexta.label: Capitulum
capitulum_sexta.lat: Némini quidquam debeátis, nisi ut ínvicem diligátis: qui enim díligit próximum, legem implévit.
capitulum_sexta.eng: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another. For he that loveth his neighbour, hath fulfilled the law.

responsory_breve_sexta.label: Responsory
responsory_breve_sexta.lat:
℟.br. Benedícam Dóminum * in omni témpore.
℣. Semper laus ejus in ore meo.
℟. In omni témpore.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Benedícam Dóminum * in omni témpore.
responsory_breve_sexta.eng:
℟.br. I will bless the Lord * at all times.
℣. His praise shall be always in my mouth.
℟. At all times.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. I will bless the Lord * at all times.

capitulum_nona.label: Capitulum
capitulum_nona.lat: In timóre incolátus vestri témpore conversámini: sciéntes quod non corruptibílibus auro vel argénto redémpti estis, sed pretióso sánguine quasi Agni immaculáti Christi.
capitulum_nona.eng: Converse in fear during the time of your sojourning here. Knowing that you were not redeemed with corruptible things as gold or silver, but with the precious blood of Christ.

responsory_breve_nona.label: Responsory
responsory_breve_nona.lat:
℟.br. Rédime me, Dómine, * et miserére mei.
℣. Pes enim meus stetit in via recta.
℟. Et miserére mei.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Rédime me, Dómine, * et miserére mei.
responsory_breve_nona.eng:
℟.br. Redeem me, O Lord, * and have mercy on me.
℣. For my feet stood in the right way.
℟. And have mercy on me.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Redeem me, O Lord, * and have mercy on me.

laudes.psalm1.label: Psalmus 149
laudes.psalm1.antiphonLat: Fílii Sion * exsúltent in Rege suo.
laudes.psalm1.antiphonEng: Let the children of Sion * be joyful in their king.

verses.lat: 149:1 Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * laus ejus in ecclésia sanctórum.
verses.eng: 149:1 Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: * let his praise be in the church of the saints.

verses.lat: 149:2 Lætétur Israël in eo, qui fecit eum: * et fílii Sion exsúltent in rege suo.
verses.eng: 149:2 Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: * and let the children of Sion be joyful in their king.

verses.lat: 149:3 Laudent nomen ejus in choro: * in týmpano, et psaltério psallant ei:
verses.eng: 149:3 Let them praise his name in choir: * let them sing to him with the timbrel and the psaltery.

verses.lat: 149:4 Quia beneplácitum est Dómino in pópulo suo: * et exaltábit mansuétos in salútem.
verses.eng: 149:4 For the Lord is well pleased with his people: * and he will exalt the meek unto salvation.

verses.lat: 149:5 Exsultábunt sancti in glória: * lætabúntur in cubílibus suis.
verses.eng: 149:5 The saints shall rejoice in glory: * they shall be joyful in their beds.

verses.lat: 149:6 Exaltatiónes Dei in gútture eórum: * et gládii ancípites in mánibus eórum.
verses.eng: 149:6 The high praises of God shall be in their mouth: * and two-edged swords in their hands:

verses.lat: 149:7 Ad faciéndam vindíctam in natiónibus: * increpatiónes in pópulis.
verses.eng: 149:7 To execute vengeance upon the nations, * chastisements among the people:

verses.lat: 149:8 Ad alligándos reges eórum in compédibus: * et nóbiles eórum in mánicis férreis.
verses.eng: 149:8 To bind their kings with fetters, * and their nobles with manacles of iron.

verses.lat: 149:9 Ut fáciant in eis judícium conscríptum: * glória hæc est ómnibus sanctis ejus.
verses.eng: 149:9 To execute upon them the judgment that is written: * this glory is to all his saints.

laudes.antiphon.psalm1.label: Antíphona
laudes.antiphon.psalm1.lat: Fílii Sion * exsúltent in Rege suo.
laudes.antiphon.psalm1.eng: Let the children of Sion * be joyful in their king.

laudes.psalm2.label: Psalmus 91
laudes.psalm2.antiphonLat: Quam magnificáta * sunt ópera tua, Dómine.
laudes.psalm2.antiphonEng: O Lord, * how great are thy works!
